local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleMainPartBSection14')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastleMainPartB @
		Comment = 4스테이지 보스 재생실 A @
		Index = 13 @
		NextSections = 14 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_state = {
		-- 초기 상태
		idle = 0,
		-- 공주 기사 이벤트 발생
		see_princess_guardian_event = 1,
		-- 로레인 머리 이벤트 발생
		see_lorain_head_appear_event = 2,
		-- 실험관 이벤트 발생
		enter_tube_room = 3,
		-- 모든 이벤트 종료
		end_progress = 4
	}

	-- 현재 진행도
	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.idle

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = "futurecastle_part2_1_5"

	-- 대사
	self.main_script = 'futurecastle_part2_s14_'
	self.boss_title_script = 'futurecastle_part2_s14_boss_title_'
	self.boss_subtitle_script = 'futurecastle_part2_s14_boss_subtitle_'

	-- 시험관 클리어 횟수
	self.tube_clear_num = 0

	-- 공주
	self.princess = nil

	-- 꼬마 공주와 가디언 이벤트 NPC
	self.little_princess = nil
	self.little_guardian = nil
	self.queen = nil
	self.lab_researcher = nil

	-- 시험관 인베이더 리스트
	self.tube_invader_list = {}

	-- 보스 리스트
	self.boss_list = nil

	-- 로레인 머리
	self.lorain_head = nil

	-- 로레인 머리 스파인 컨트롤러
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller = nil

	-- 스파인 애니메이션 Base Track 레퍼런스
	self.base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	-- 시험관 리스트
	self.tube_list = nil

	-- 기타 상수
	self.tube_num = 3
	self.tube_door_num = 4

	-- 타일맵 캐릭터 이름
	self.princess_name = 'princess'
	self.little_princess_name = 'little_princess'
	self.little_guardian_name = 'little_guardian'
	self.queen_name = 'queen'
	self.lab_researcher_name = 'lab_researcher'
	self.tube_invader_name = 'tube_invader_1_'
	self.boss_name = 'boss_1_'

	-- 타일맵 필드오브젝트 이름
	self.lorain_head_name = 'lorain_head'
	self.tube_name = 'tube_1_'
	self.tube_door_name = 'tube_door_1_'

	-- 타일맵 마커 이름
	self.monster_battle_player_marker_name = 'monster_battle_player'
	self.monster_battle_monster_marker_name = 'monster_battle_monster'

	-- 타일맵 존 이름
	self.princess_and_guardian_event_zone_name = 'princess_and_guardian'
	self.lorain_head_appear_event_zone_name = 'lorain_head_appear'
	self.tube_room_event_zone_name = 'tube_room_a'

	-- 배틀 그룹 이름
	self.boss_battle_group_name = 'boss'

	-- 퀘스트 마커, 트래커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'futurecastle_part2_main'
	self.quest_tracker_name = 'futurecastle_part2_s14_tracker_0'

	-- 이펙트 프리셋 이름
	self.hit_effect_preset = "FX_hit"
	self.impact_hit_effect_preset = "FX_lasthit"


	-- 시험관 룸 카메라 그리드
	self.tube_room_grid_name = 'tube_room_a_grid'
	-- 시험관 룸 카메라 그리드에 입장하였는가
	self.in_tube_room = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	self.princess = get_character(self.princess_name)

	self.little_princess = get_character(self.little_princess_name)
	self.little_princess.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.little_princess, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.little_princess, 0.7, 0)
	character_util.set_position(self.little_princess, vector(0, 0, 13))
	character_util.set_direction(self.little_princess, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.little_princess, { name = 'seat' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.little_princess, { name = 'tired' })

	self.little_guardian = get_character(self.little_guardian_name)
	self.little_guardian.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.little_guardian, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.little_guardian, 0.7, 0)
	character_util.set_position(self.little_guardian, vector(0, 0, 11))
	character_util.set_direction(self.little_guardian, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(self.little_guardian, { name = 'hurt' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.little_guardian, { name = 'tired' })

	self.queen = get_character(self.queen_name)
	self.queen.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.queen, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.queen, 0.7, 0)
	character_util.set_position(self.queen, vector(-0.7, 0, 13))
	character_util.set_direction(self.queen, 'down')

	self.lab_researcher = get_character(self.lab_researcher_name)
	self.lab_researcher.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.lab_researcher, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.lab_researcher, 0.7, 0)
	character_util.set_position(self.lab_researcher, vector(-0.7, 0, 12))
	character_util.set_direction(self.lab_researcher, 'up')

	self.lorain_head = get_field_object(self.lorain_head_name)
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller = self.lorain_head.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	self.lorain_head.Position = vector(-10, 1, 26.5)
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'idle', true)

	self.tube_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 1, self.tube_num do
		local cur_tube = get_field_object(self.tube_name..i)
		cur_tube.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		--region 시험관 유리 색상 변경
		local cur_renderer = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(cur_tube.transform,
				'obj_glasstube'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))

		local cur_mat = cur_renderer.material
		local mesh_color = cur_mat:GetColor("_TintColor")
		-- R 0 G 142 B 45 A 36 계산한 수치
		mesh_color = unity_color({0, 0.55686, 0.17647, 0.14117})
		cur_mat:SetColor("_TintColor", mesh_color)
		--endregion

		self.tube_list:Add(cur_tube)
	end

	for i = 1, self.tube_num do
		local cur_invader = get_character(self.tube_invader_name..i)

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(cur_invader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character_util.set_position(cur_invader,
				self.tube_list[i - 1].Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), true)
		cur_invader.SpineController:AddColor(cur_invader.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
		character_util.set_scale_factor(cur_invader, cur_invader.Name, 0.8)
		character_util.set_direction(cur_invader, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(cur_invader, { name = 'idle', loop = false, scale = 0.2 })

		table.insert(self.tube_invader_list, cur_invader)
	end

	self.boss_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.tube_num do
		self.boss_list:Add(get_character(self.boss_name..i))
	end

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어온 경우
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 13 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
	end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(10.5, 0, 247))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.princess = nil

	self.little_princess = nil
	self.little_guardian = nil
	self.queen = nil
	self.lab_researcher = nil

	self.tube_list = nil
	self.tube_invader_list = nil
	self.boss_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_princess_guardian_event and
			zone_name == self.princess_and_guardian_event_zone_name then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_princess_guardian_event

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.princess_and_guardian_event, self))
	elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_lorain_head_appear_event and
			zone_name == self.lorain_head_appear_event_zone_name then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_lorain_head_appear_event

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lorain_head_appear_event, self))
	elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_tube_room and
			zone_name == self.tube_room_event_zone_name then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_tube_room

		self:enter_tube_room_event()
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.tube_room_grid_name) == false then
		return
	end

	if self.in_tube_room == false then
		self.in_tube_room = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.float_invader, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.tube_room_grid_name) == false then
		return
	end

	self.in_tube_room = false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 0, self.tube_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.tube_list[i]) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_tube_event, self, i))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if string.find(e.BattleGroupName, self.boss_battle_group_name) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_boss, self, e.BattleGroupName))
	end
end

-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어온 경우 실행되는 게임 시작 이벤트
function local_class:start_event()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v2_10_futurecastle_part2/audio/music:bgm_futurecastle2_dungeon', state = 'field' })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1,  'linear')

	character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			0.5, nil, true, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "victory_get", loop = false})

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name));

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
end

-- 공주와 기사 이벤트
function local_class:princess_and_guardian_event()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_anim(self.lab_researcher, { name = 'cast2' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.queen, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.queen, { name = 'tired' })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.lab_researcher)

	character_util.set_anim(self.queen, { name = 'nod' })
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.queen)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_direction(self.queen, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.queen)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.queen, { name = 'tired' })

	character_util.move_to_async(self.lab_researcher, self.lab_researcher.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			nil, 0.7, true, true)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.little_guardian)

	character_util.set_direction(self.lab_researcher, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.lab_researcher, { name = 'push' })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.move_to(self.lab_researcher, self.lab_researcher.Position + vector(0, 0, -6),
			nil, 1.5, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(3)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.lab_researcher, 0, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_baby_cry_01'
	, play_pos = self.little_princess.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	character_util.set_emotion(self.little_princess, { name = 'cry' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01'
	, play_pos = self.little_guardian.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	character_util.jump(self.little_guardian, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(self.little_guardian, 'up')

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	character_util.move_to_async(self.little_guardian, self.little_guardian.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			2, nil, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.move_to_async(self.little_guardian, self.little_guardian.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			2, nil, false, true)

	character_util.set_direction(self.little_guardian, 'down')

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	character_util.move_to(self.little_guardian, self.little_guardian.Position + vector(0, 0, -6),
			4, nil, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(3)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.little_guardian, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.queen, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.little_princess, 0, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_02'
	, play_pos = self.little_princess.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

-- 로레인 머리 굴러가는 이벤트
function local_class:lorain_head_appear_event()
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:Jump(1, 0.5)
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'jump', false, 1, nil, nil, 'idle')
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetEmotion('mad', true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_head_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.lorain_head_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'walk', true)
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetEmotion('idle', true)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = 1

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(6, 12.3, 0, 0)

	local start_pos = self.lorain_head.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, -1, 2.5)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		self.lorain_head.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos,
				(unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / move_duration) + vector(0, dist_y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Position = end_pos
	local current_anim_entry = self.lorain_head_spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation.state:GetCurrent(self.base_track)
	current_anim_entry.TimeScale = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gell_01', type_priority = 'event'
	, player_priority = 'object', parent = self.lorain_head })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			self.lorain_head.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			self.lorain_head.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.lorain_head_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:Jump(1, 0.5)
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'jump', false, 1, nil, nil, 'idle')
	current_anim_entry = self.lorain_head_spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation.state:GetCurrent(self.base_track)
	current_anim_entry.TimeScale = 1

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local roll_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gell_fall_down_01'
	, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object', parent = self.lorain_head })

	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'walk', true)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	move_duration = 6

	start_pos = self.lorain_head.Position
	end_pos = start_pos + vector(35, 0, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration do
		self.lorain_head.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos,
				(unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / move_duration)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Position = end_pos

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.5

	start_pos = self.lorain_head.Position
	end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, -0.5, -0.2)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		self.lorain_head.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos,
				(unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fall_duration)
		self.lorain_head.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one *
				(1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fall_duration)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	roll_sfx:Stop()

	self.lorain_head.Position = vector(200, 0, 0)
	self.lorain_head.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'idle', true)
end

-- 시험관 방에 들어가면 발생하는 이벤트
function local_class:enter_tube_room_event()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_01')
	-- 상하 문 닫힘
	for i = 1, self.tube_door_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.tube_door_name..i, false))
	end
end

-- 시험관 인베이더 둥둥 떠다니는 연출
function local_class:float_invader()
	local deg = 0
	local start_y = 0.1
	local move_y = 0.25
	local duration = 3

	local dir = 1

	while self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.end_progress do
		if self.in_tube_room == false then
			for i = 1, #self.tube_invader_list do
				self.tube_invader_list[i].SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
			end

			break
		end

		if deg >= 90 then
			dir = -1
		elseif deg < 0 then
			dir = 1
		end

		deg = deg + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 90 / duration * dir

		local cur_y = start_y + move_y * math.sin(deg * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)

		for i = 1, #self.tube_invader_list do

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_tube_room and
			zone_name == self.tube_room_event_zone_name then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_tube_room

		self:enter_tube_room_event()
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.tube_room_grid_name) == false then
		return
	end

	if self.in_tube_room == false then
		self.in_tube_room = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.float_invader, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.tube_room_grid_name) == false then
		return
	end

	self.in_tube_room = false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 0, self.tube_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.tube_list[i]) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_tube_event, self, i))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:float_invader()

	local move_y = 0.25
	local duration = 3

	local dir = 1

		if self.in_tube_room == false then
			for i = 1, #self.tube_invader_list do
				self.tube_invader_list[i].SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
			end

			break
		end

		if deg >= 90 then
			dir = -1
		elseif deg < 0 then
			dir = 1
		end

		deg = deg + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 90 / duration * dir

		local cur_y = start_y + move_y * math.sin(deg * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)

		for i = 1, #self.tube_invader_list do
			if self.tube_invader_list[i].ActiveState ~= active_state('disabled') then
				self.tube_invader_list[i].SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)
			end
		end

	end

function local_class:rolling_lorain_head_event()
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'walk', true, 1.8)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local start_pos = self.lorain_head.Position
	local start_pos_z = start_pos.z
	local end_pos_z = start_pos_z + 32
	local speed = 4

	local roll_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_gell_fall_down_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	while self.lorain_head.Position.z < end_pos_z do
		self.lorain_head.Position = self.lorain_head.Position +
				vector(0, 0, 1) * unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed

		-- 플레이어가 접근하면 속도 빨라짐, 멀어지면 속도 느려짐
		local dist = (user_party_leader.Position - self.lorain_head.Position).magnitude

		if dist > 4 then
			speed = 4
		elseif dist < 2 then
			speed = 7
		else
			speed = 10 - 1.5 * dist
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_slide_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	roll_duration = 1

	start_pos = self.lorain_head.Position
	start_pos_z = start_pos.z
	end_pos_z = start_pos_z + 4

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(20, 8, 0, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < roll_duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / roll_duration

		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		self.lorain_head.Position = vector(start_pos.x, dist_y, start_pos_z + (end_pos_z - start_pos_z) * normalized)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	roll_sfx:FadeOut()

	self.lorain_head.Position = vector(200, 0, 0)
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'idle', true)
end

-- 하늘에서 클론들 떨어지는 연출
function local_class:fall_down_clone(clone)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.5

	local start_pos = clone.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, -start_pos.y, 0)

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, clone.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(
				clone, vector(start_pos.x, start_pos.y + dist_y, start_pos.z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gell_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_hit_name):Instantiate(clone.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_impact_hit_name):Instantiate(clone.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	clone.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true
	character_util.set_position(clone, end_pos)

	character_util.convert_to_monster(clone)
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(clone, user_party_leader, 'battle')
end

-- 인베이더 공격 이벤트
function local_class:invader_attack_event(clone_list)
	local real_lorain = get_character(self.lorain_name)

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 관련 처리
	local basic_rifle_id = 9030011;
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData');
	local rifle_data = item_data:GetSpec(basic_rifle_id).Data;
	local rifle_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(rifle_data, 'ShootOffset', 0.5);

	local projectile_data = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Object)
	projectile_data:Add("Columns", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(1))
	projectile_data:Add("SpreadAngle", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(0))
	projectile_data:Add("Parallel", true)
	projectile_data:Add("Projectile", 'rifle_bullet_long_dist')
	projectile_data:Add("ShootOffset", rifle_offset)

	local shoot_helper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ShootHelper)

	local spec = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_spec(projectile_data)

-- 인베이더 공격 연출
function local_class:invader_attack(invader)
	local center_x = 10.5
	local rand_anim = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 4))

	if invader.Name == 'demon_hulk' then
		rand_anim = 2
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
	else
		if rand_anim == 0 then
			invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'tutorial_sword_normal')
			character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })
		elseif rand_anim == 1 then
			invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'head_crusher')
			character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })
		elseif rand_anim == 2 then
			invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
			character_util.set_anim(invader,
					{ name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })
		else
			invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
			character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'gauntlet_kick2', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })
		end
	end

	if rand_anim ~= 2 then
		if invader.Position.x < center_x then
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(invader, vector(0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
		else
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(invader, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_light_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)

	local lorain = get_character(self.lorain_name)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_effect_preset):Instantiate(lorain.Position)

	if invader.Position.x < center_x then
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(lorain, vector(0.2, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.1)
	else
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(lorain, vector(-0.2, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.1)
	end

	lorain.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.5)
	lorain.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	if rand_anim <= 1 then
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'sword_idle' })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'idle' })
	end
end

	-- 일정 시간마다 흔들리면서 낙석 떨어짐

	local talker = get_character(self.lorain_name)

	while not self.finished_loop_event do

		if timer >= shake_cycle then
			timer = 0

			camera_util.shake(0.2, 1)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_down_rock, self))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

-- 로레인 & 매드팬더가 주기적으로 소리치는 연출
function local_class:repeat_speech_routine(talker)
	local talk_timer = 3
	local talk_cycle = 1
	local is_not_first_time = true
	local past_talk_num = -1
	local talk_start = 39
	-- 사용 스트링 키 : futurecastle_part2_s16_39 ~ futurecastle_part2_s16_40
	local talk_end = 39

	-- 트리오 퀘스트 클리어 여부 확인
	local trio_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(204)
	-- 트리오 퀘스트 클리어 시 트리오 대사도 추가됨
	if trio_quest ~= nil and trio_quest.IsComplete then
		-- 사용 스트링 키 : futurecastle_part2_s16_39 ~ futurecastle_part2_s16_43
		talk_end = 42
	end

	while not self.finished_loop_event do
		if is_not_first_time then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		talk_timer = talk_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if talk_timer >= talk_cycle then
			talk_timer = 0

			local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-50, 50)
			if rand_x < 0 then
				rand_x = rand_x - 200
			else
				rand_x = rand_x + 50
			end

			local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(150, 300)

			local rand_talk
			if is_not_first_time then
				rand_talk = random_util.get_random_int(talk_start, talk_end)
				-- 같은 대화 두 번 안 나오게, 이전 번호보다 크거나 같은 경우 1 증가
				if rand_talk >= past_talk_num then
					rand_talk = rand_talk + 1
				end
			else
				is_not_first_time = true
				music_player_util.play_sfx(
						{ sfx_name = '01_camera_emphasize_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
				rand_talk = random_util.get_random_int(talk_start, talk_end + 1)
			end

			past_talk_num = rand_talk

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker,
					{
						key = self.main_script..rand_talk,
						screen_pos = vector(rand_x, rand_z),
						bubble_type = "shout",
						type_speed = 0
					})
		end
	end
end

-- 낙석 떨어지는 연출
function local_class:fall_down_rock()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(10, 11)
	local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-1, 1)

	local cur_rock = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(
			self.falling_rock_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			vector(rand_x, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z + rand_z))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 2

	while not self.finished_loop_event and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	cur_rock:Dispose()
end

-- 스테이지 나가는 이벤트
function local_class:exit_event()
	self.finished_loop_event = true

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	local loading_mode_enum = screen_util.get_loading_mode(loading_mode)
	local ip = screen_util.get_interpolations(interpolations)

	local routine = wait_all({
		music_player:PlayAndWaitUntilSfxFinish('01_stage_clear_01'),
		CS.Oak.CircularScreenTransition.Instance:FadeOutAsync(0.6, ip, loading_mode_enum)
	})

	coroutine.yield(routine)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	-- 스테이지 종료
	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToWorldmap(self.exit_stage_name, 'passage_11_4', nil, true, nil)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

-- 낙석 떨어짐 + 틴트
function local_class:campfire_scene_once(no_rock)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 1)

	if not no_rock then
		self:fall_down_rock()
	end
end

-- 캠프파이어 화면 연출
function local_class:campfire_scene()
	-- 일정 시간마다 흔들리면서 낙석 떨어짐
	local shake_cycle = 3.5
	local timer = 2.3

	while self.is_campfire_scene do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= shake_cycle then
			timer = 0

			if not self.shrink_shake_in_campfire_scene then
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 1)
			else
				camera_util.shake(0.03, 1)
			end

			self:fall_down_rock()
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 낙석 떨어지는 연출
function local_class:fall_down_rock()
	if not self.mute_rock_sfx then
		music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	end

	local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-4, 4)
	local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-2, 2)

	local cur_rock = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.falling_rock_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z))
	cur_rock.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
end

function local_class:battle_templete_hang(char_1, char_2, char_3, target, vtr)
	character_util.set_direction(target, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(target, vtr)
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'damaged' })

	local table =
	{
		char_1,
		char_2,
		char_3
	}

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local num = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-15, 15)

		character_util.set_emotion(table[i], { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.spine_rotate(table[i], num, 0)
	end

	character_util.set_position(char_1, target.Position + vector(0.3, 0.5, 0))
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'sword_attack_dash' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_1, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_direction(char_1, 'left')

	character_util.set_position(char_2, target.Position + vector(0.5, 1.5, 0))
	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'sword_attack_dash' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_direction(char_2, 'left')

	character_util.set_position(char_3, target.Position + vector(-1, 0.9, 0))
	character_util.set_anim(char_3, { name = 'sword_attack_dash' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_3, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_direction(char_3, 'right')

	while self.scene_end == false do
		local x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-12, 12)
		local y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-10, 10)

		x = x/10.0 - 0.25
		y = y/10.0 + 1

		target.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		target.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.3)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(x, y, 0))
		wait_for_sec(0.35)
	end
end

function local_class:battle_template_struggle_aisha(char_1, char_2, vtr)

	character_util.set_position(char_1, vtr + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(char_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(char_2, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(char_1, { name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'attack'})

	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'sword_attack_dash', loop = true})

	while not self.scene_end do
		character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'damaged', loop = true})
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(-0.1, 0.3, 0.1))
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(char_2, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(char_2, 1.2, 0.8, 1, 0.2)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		if self.aisha_attack == false then
			break
		end
		character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'damaged2', loop = true})
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(0.1, 0.3, -0.1))
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(char_2, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(char_2, 0.8, 1.2, 1, 0.2)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (서로 힘겨루기하며 밀고 당김)
function local_class:battle_template_power_struggle(char_1, char_2, vtr, direction)
	local cur_dist = 0.5
	local cur_duration = 2
	local cur_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(direction, true)

	if cur_dir == true then
		character_util.set_position(char_1, vtr + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.05))
		character_util.set_position(char_2, vtr + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(char_1, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(char_2, 'left')
	else
		character_util.set_position(char_2, vtr + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(char_1, vtr + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(char_2, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(char_1, 'left')
	end

	local dir_1 = (char_2.Position - char_1.Position).normalized
	local dir_2 = (char_1.Position - char_2.Position).normalized

	character_util.shake(char_1, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_1, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.shake(char_2, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.move_to_async(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist,
			0.1, nil, false, false)

	while not self.scene_end do
		character_util.move_to(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		character_util.move_to(char_2, char_2.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while not self.scene_end and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < cur_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.move_to(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_2 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		character_util.move_to(char_2, char_2.Position + dir_2 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while not self.scene_end and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < cur_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:knockback_craig_and_invader()
	local craig = self.optimized_npcs['craig']
	local super_invader = self.optimized_npcs['super']

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
			'physics', true, vector(1, 0, 0), 22000, 0.05,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(craig, knock_back_info)
	craig.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
			'physics', true, vector(1, 0, 0), 22000, 0.05,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
	ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(super_invader, knock_back_info)
	super_invader.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

		wait_for_sec(0.1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.lorain_explosion_count = self.lorain_explosion_count + 1

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	self.lorain_explosion_count = self.lorain_explosion_count + 1
end

-- 인베이더 공격 연출
function local_class:invader_attack(invader, is_hulk)
	local center_x = 10.5
	local rand_anim = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 4))

	if is_hulk then
		rand_anim = 2
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
	else
		if rand_anim == 0 then
			invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'tutorial_sword_normal')
			character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })
		elseif rand_anim == 1 then
			invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'head_crusher')
			character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })
		elseif rand_anim == 2 then
			invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
			character_util.set_anim(invader,
					{ name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })
		else
			invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
			character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'gauntlet_kick2', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })
		end
	end

	if rand_anim ~= 2 then
		if invader.Position.x < center_x then
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(invader, vector(0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
		else
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(invader, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)

	local lorain = self.optimized_npcs['lorain']

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(lorain.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(lorain.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	if invader.Position.x < center_x then
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(lorain, vector(0.2, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.1)
	else
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(lorain, vector(-0.2, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.1)
	end

	lorain.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.5)
	lorain.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	if rand_anim <= 1 then
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'sword_idle' })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'idle' })
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_event')


	-- 보스 타이틀 이펙트 프리로드
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

	self:load_resource_routine()

	self:setting()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	if self.current_state <= 0 then
		-- 처음 스테이지5 입장했을 때
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_event, self)
	else
		self.is_fade_out_vampireidol_bgm = true

		-- 미래공주, 베스 이벤트 대사 감상 후 재입장 했을 때
		-- 보스방 앞에서 시작하도록 설정
		-- 베스전투 인트로 만약 봤을 경우에도 넘길 수 있도록 설정
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_routine, self))
	end

end


function local_class:exit()
	self.is_loop = false

	self.future_princess = nil
	self.beth = nil

	character_util.set_active_state(self.queen, 'disabled')
	self.queen = nil

	character_util.set_active_state(self.riri, 'disabled')
	self.riri = nil

	if self.rock_effect ~= nil then
		self.rock_effect:Dispose()
		self.rock_effect = nil
	end

	if self.fairy_effect ~= nil then
		self.fairy_effect:Dispose()
		self.fairy_effect = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil


	if self.rock_effect ~= nil then
		self.rock_effect:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	local princess = get_character('princess')
	local leader = user_party_leader

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_1' and not self.beth_battle_start then
			self.beth_battle_start = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.beth_battle_start_event, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'illusion' and not self.see_illusion_event then
			self.see_illusion_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.illusion_event, self))
		end
		return true
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if not self.is_fade_out_vampireidol_bgm and
				type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.top_floor_grid_name) then
			self.is_fade_out_vampireidol_bgm = true

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1 })
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_1' and not self.beth_battle_end then
			self.beth_battle_end = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.beth_battle_end_event, self))
		end

		return true
	end

	--[[
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
			if leader.Position.z + 1.5 > princess.Position.z then
				character_util.stop(princess)
				character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'walk'})
				character_util.move_waypoint(princess, princess.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.1), 4, false, nil, nil, nil, true)
			else
				character_util.remove_anim(princess)
			end
		end
		return true
	end
	]]

	return false
end

-- 요정 사라지는 이벤트
function local_class:fairy_gone()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local fairy = get_character(self.fairy_name)

	start_pos = fairy.Position
	local fade_timer = 0
	local is_fade = false

	while self.is_loop do
		if is_fade then
			fade_timer = fade_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if fade_timer >= 2 then
				break
			end
		else
			fade_timer = fade_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if fade_timer >= 6 then
				fade_timer = 0
				is_fade = true

				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fairy, 0, 2)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.fairy_effect ~= nil then
		self.fairy_effect:Dispose()
		self.fairy_effect = nil
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(fairy, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:shake_loop()
	while self.is_loop do
		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < 3 do
			if self.is_loop == false then
				break
			end
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		if self.is_loop == false then
			break
		end

		if self.rock_effect ~= nil then
			self.rock_effect:Dispose()
		end
		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-100, 200)
		local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-200, 700)
		rand_x = rand_x /100
		if rand_x < 0.75 and rand_x > 0.25 then
			if rand_x > 0.5 then
				rand_x = 2
			else
				rand_x = -1
			end
		end
		rand_z = rand_z /100

		music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_02', volume = 0.35, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

		self.rock_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cp11_rock_landslide_purple_small'):Instantiate(vector(rand_x, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z + rand_z))


		camera_util.shake(0.1, 1)
		while time_passed < 4 do
			if self.is_loop == false then
				break
			end
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:beth_battle_start_event()
	local beth = self.beth
	local leader = user_party_leader
	local princess = self.future_princess

	self.is_loop = false

	field:RemoveTint(nil, 1)

	-- 만약 커스텀 스테이트가 베스 이벤트를 본 이후라면 타이틀만 출력
	if self.current_state == self.stage6_event_state.talk_beth then
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

		character_util.move_to(leader, vector(-1, 0, 92), 1, nil, true, true)
		character_util.move_to(princess, vector(2, 0, 92), 1, nil, true, true)

		camera_util.move_async(beth.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 1)

		screen_util.show_boss_title(self.boss_title[1], self.boss_title[2], 2, false)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(beth)

		wait_for_sec(2)

		camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 1, {end_target = leader})
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.beth_marker)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(beth))

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'combat', mix = 0})

		character_util.convert_to_monster(beth, 'BATTLE_1')
		character_util.set_active_state(beth, 'enabled')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(beth, leader, 'battle')

		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()

	else
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

		beth:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'idle', loop = true })

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

		character_util.move_to(leader, vector(0, 0, 91), nil, 2, true, true)
		character_util.move_to(princess, vector(1, 0, 91), nil, 2, true, true)

		local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', volume = 0.65, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player', fade_in_time = 2 })
		wait_for_sec(6)
		-- ...늦어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s18_12_0', skip = true})

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_2' then
			--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.dragon_battle_end_event, self))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.dragon_phase_2, self))
		end

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.dragon_battle_end_event, self))
			--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.dragon_phase_2, self))
		end

		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
		if e.FieldObject == user_party.Leader then
			user_party.Leader.Position = dragon_marker.position
			camera_util.move(dragon_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 4), 0)
			camera_util.resize_to(6, 0.5)
		end

		return true

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do

function local_class:copy_camera_from(to, from)
	to.orthographic = from.orthographic
	to.orthographicSize = from.orthographicSize
	to.nearClipPlane = from.nearClipPlane
	to.farClipPlane = from.farClipPlane
	to.useOcclusionCulling = from.useOcclusionCulling
end

function local_class:dragon_dissolve(chr, time, mat_index)
	mat_index = lua_helper.get_or_default(mat_index, 1)
	self:set_material(chr, self.mat_container.MaterialList[mat_index])

	local mat = self:get_material(chr)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < time do
		if mat ~= nil then
			mat:SetFloat("_DissolveProgress", (time_passed / time))
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:dragon_shake(chr, mat_index)
	mat_index = lua_helper.get_or_default(mat_index, 1)
	self:set_material(chr, self.mat_container.MaterialList[mat_index])

	local mat = self:get_material(chr)

	if mat ~= nil then
		mat:SetFloat("_WaveSpeed", 1)
		mat:SetFloat("_WaveLength", 0.3)
		mat:SetFloat("_Amplitude", 0.1)
	end
end

function local_class:get_material(character)
	return character.SpineController.MaterialOverride
end

function local_class:set_material(character, material)
	character.SpineController.MaterialOverride = CS.UnityEngine.Material(material)
end

function local_class:load_material_container()
	if self.mat_container == nil then
		self.mat_container_obj = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.resholder,
				'ondemand/v2_10_futurecastle_part2/theatres_6', 'future_stage6_material_container')

	end

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleMainPartBSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastleMainPartB @
		Comment = 벨트 스크롤 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = "futurecastle_part2_1_1"
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 0 then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, {'section2_start'}))
		self.controller:dispose_bug_end_effect()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'section2_finished' then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progressing_section, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:progressing_section()
	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, {'section2_section_progressed'}))
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	self:load_resource_routine()
	self:setting()

	coroutine.yield(self:load_effect())
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	if self.current_state == self.stage6_event_state.last_scene then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.last_scene_start, self))
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:staff_roll_test()
	self:load_effect()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	get_character(self.future_princess_name).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	self:staff_roll()
end


function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.inn_camera = nil
	if is_unity_null(self.inn_scene) == false then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.inn_scene)
	end
	self.inn_scene = nil
	self.inn_camera = nil

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
	end

	if self.floating_rock_effect ~= nil then
		self.floating_rock_effect:Dispose()
	end

	self.stage_audio_listener = nil

	self.season_1_fin = nil
	self.fin_ui_texture = nil
	self.camera_pivot = nil
	self.future_princess = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	if self.hero_list ~=nil then
		self.hero_list = nil
	end

	if self.rain_sfx ~= nil then
		self.rain_sfx:Stop()
		self.rain_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.rain_screen_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.rain_screen_effect)
		self.rain_screen_effect = nil
	end

	if self.rain_ground_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.rain_ground_effect)
		self.rain_ground_effect = nil
	end

	-- 만약 사운드가 꺼져있는데, 사운드를 재차 끄게되면 문제 없을지 확인이 필요함
	self.portal_loop_sound:Stop()

	local trio_boss = get_character('trio_boss')
	local trio_man = get_character('trio_man')
	local trio_panda = get_character('trio_panda')

	if trio_boss.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		trio_boss.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	if trio_man.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		trio_man.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	if trio_panda.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		trio_panda.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.throne) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.farewell_ending_choose, self))
			return true
		end

		if not self.trio_talk_flag and ( lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('trio_boss')) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('trio_man')) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('trio_panda')) ) then
			self.trio_talk_flag = true

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.loraine_dead_event, self)
		end

		-- if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('lana')) then
		-- 	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lana_oneline, self))
		-- end


	end

	return false
end

		end

	end

	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_1_35', skip = true})

	character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'idle'})
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})

	character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'idle'})
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_1_38', skip = true})

	character_util.move_to(princess, vector(54.5, 0, 33), 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(aisha, vector(56.5, 0, 33), 1, nil, true, true)

function local_class:farewell_ending_choose()
	local princess = self.future_princess
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	for i = 1, #self.hero_list do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.hero_list[i])
	end
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(princess)

	if not self.throne_event_flag then
		camera_util.move_async(princess.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 0.8)
		-- 처음 1 번에 한해서 align 하기 전에 카메라가 공주로 이동, 대사를 보여준다.

		-- 공주: {주인공}
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')
		character_util.look_at(leader, princess)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = { 'futurecastle_part2_s20_7', user.Name }, skip = true})

		-- 공주 : 내가 아까 한 말… 잊지 말아줘.
		-- self:set_char_action(princess, 'left', 'cast', 'sleep_deep')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_8', skip = true})
		-- self:set_char_action(princess, 'left', 'idle', 'tired')
		camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0.8, {end_target = leader})

		self.throne_event_flag = true
	end

	-- 포탈 앞 위치에 align
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, self.throne.Position + vector(0, 0.25, - 0.45), 0.5, nil, true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	-- 과거로 돌아간다.
	-- 미래 세계에 남는다.
	-- 아직 결정하지 않았다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'futurecastle_part2_s20_9_1', 'intellect' },
														{ 'futurecastle_part2_s20_9_2', 'forced' },
														{ 'futurecastle_part2_s20_9_3', 'normal' }})

	-- 위의 두 선택지를 고르면 나레이션 박스 “정말로 이 선택지를 고르시겠습니까?”
	-- 이후 선택지 “예” / “아니오”. 위에서 “ 아직 결정하지 못했다” 를 골랐을 때와 동일.

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 과거로 돌아간다.
		-- 정말로 이 선택지를 고르시겠습니까?
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_9_4'})

		local choose_result_2 = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'futurecastle_part2_s20_9_5', 'mercy' },
																{ 'futurecastle_part2_s20_9_6', 'normal' }})

		if choose_result_2 == 1 then
			-- 진엔딩 이벤트 돌입
			self:farewell_ending_last_scene()

		else
			character_util.move_to_async(leader, self.throne.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.0), 0.5, nil, true, true)
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
			user_party:ResetControllers()

		end


	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 미래 세계에 남는다.

		-- 정말로 이 선택지를 고르시겠습니까?
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_9_4'})

		local choose_result_2 = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'futurecastle_part2_s20_9_5', 'mercy' },
																{ 'futurecastle_part2_s20_9_6', 'normal' }})

		if choose_result_2 == 1 then
			-- 주인공 아래로 돌아서서 밑으로 내려온다.
			character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')
			leader:HideWeapon(true)
			camera_util.move(vector(54.5, 0, 33), 2)

			character_util.move_to_async(leader, vector(54.5, 0, 34), 2, nil, true, true)
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

			-- 공주 : …{주인공}...?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = { 'futurecastle_part2_s20_45', user.Name }, skip = true})

			-- 주인공 공주 왼쪽으로 오고 공주 살짝 오른쪽으로 뒷걸음질해서 둘이서 가운데 정렬로 서로 마주보도록.
			character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
			character_util.move_to(leader, vector(54, 0, 33), 1, nil, true, true)
			character_util.move_to_async(princess, vector(55, 0, 33), 1, nil, false, true)

			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

			-- 공주 : ….
			character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'idle'})
			character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'idle'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_46', skip = true})

			-- 공주 : 정말… 괜찮겠어?
			character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'cast'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_47', skip = true})

			-- 공주 : 네가 돌아오지 않는다면..
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_48', skip = true})

			-- 공주 : (슬픈 표정) 정말 슬퍼할 아이가 있어.
			character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_49', skip = true})

			-- 공주 : 아주 많이.
			character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
			character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'idle'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_50', skip = true})

			-- 공주 : ...난 그 기분을 잘 알아.
			character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'idle'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_51', skip = true})


			-- 선택지
			-- 나는 이미 결정했어요.
			-- 그렇게 말씀하시니 또 마음이 흔들리네요.
			local choose_result_3 = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'futurecastle_part2_s20_52', 'mercy' },
																	{ 'futurecastle_part2_s20_53', 'normal' }})

			if choose_result_3 == 1 then
				-- 어나더 엔딩 이벤트 돌입
				self:another_ending()

			else
				-- 공주 : …..
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_54', skip = true})

				-- 공주 : ..확실히 정해지면 말해줘...
				character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_part2_s20_55', skip = true})
				-- (공주 다시 오른쪽으로 이동 원위치. 주인공에게 컨트롤 돌아오고 포탈로 마커)
				camera_util.move(vector(54.5, 0, 34.5), 1, {end_target = leader})
				character_util.move_to(princess, vector(54.5, 0, 33), 0.5, nil, false, true)
				character_util.move_to_async(leader, vector(54.5, 0, 34.5), 1.0, nil, true, true)
				character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
				character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')
				leader:HideWeapon(false)

				stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
				user_party:ResetControllers()

			end


		else
			character_util.move_to_async(leader, self.throne.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.0), 0.5, nil, true, true)
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
			user_party:ResetControllers()

		end


	else
		-- 아직 결정하지 않았다.
		-- 선택 대기
		character_util.move_to_async(leader, self.throne.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.0), 0.5, nil, true, true)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end

end

-- 플레이어 회전하는 연출
function local_class:rotate_player()
	local angle = 20

	character_util.spine_rotate(user_party_leader, 20, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	while self.rotate_stat do
		angle = angle * -1

		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party_leader, angle, 2)

		wait_for_sec(2)
	end
end

	character_util.set_emotion(fo, {name = emotion})
end

function local_class:set_part(scene, character_name, part_name, type_name, fade)
	local part = scene.transform:Find('background').transform:Find('characters').transform:Find(character_name).transform:Find(part_name).transform
	local child_count = part.childCount
	for i = 0, child_count - 1 do
		local child = part:GetChild(i)
		if child.name == type_name then
			if fade then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sprite_fade_in, self, child))
			else
				child.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end
		else
			if fade then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sprite_fade_out, self, child))
			else
				child.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end
		end
	end
	if fade then
		wait_for_sec(0.55)
	end
end

--- 시간에 맞춰 text 를 단어 단위로 Fade In 함
--- @param string_key string 자막에 표시할 스트링 키 + 패러미터
--- @param fade_in_duration number 첫 단어가 fade in 하는 시간부터 마지막 단어가 fade in 시작할 때까지의 간격
--- @param fade_in_time number 단어 하나가 fade in 되는 시간
--- @param keep_duration number 모든 단어가 fade in 된 이후 유지되는 시간
--- @param fade_out_duration number 첫 단어가 fade out 하는 시간부터 마지막 단어가 fade out 시작할 때까지의 간격
--- @param fade_out_time number 단어 하나가 fade out 되는 시간
--- @param color string 텍스트의 기본 색상
--- @param additional_option string 추가적으로 앞에 붙일 옵션
function local_class:fade_wordbreak_subtitle(string_key, fade_in_duration, fade_in_time, keep_duration, fade_out_duration, fade_out_time, color, additional_option)
	-- 텍스트로 변환
	local text
	local dialogue_key
	if type_util.is_array(string_key) then
		text = game_string:FormatWithReservedKeywords(table.unpack(string_key))
		dialogue_key = string_key[1]
	else
		text = game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(string_key)
		dialogue_key = string_key
	end

	-- 보이스 출력
	if dialogue_key then
		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlayDialogue(dialogue_key)
	end

	local words = {}
	-- 공백으로 text 를 잘라서 words 리스트에 넣는다.
	for token in string.gmatch(text, "[^%s]+") do
		table.insert(words, token)
	end
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	-- 전체 시간
	local total_duration = fade_in_duration + fade_in_time + keep_duration + fade_out_duration + fade_out_time
	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < total_duration do
		local progress_time = unity_class.time.time - start_time
		if progress_time < fade_in_duration + fade_in_time then
			-- fade in
			local fade_in_period = fade_in_duration
			if #words > 1 then
				fade_in_period = fade_in_duration / (#words - 1)
			end
			local faded_text = nil
			for i = 1, #words do
				local fade_in_start_time = fade_in_period * (i - 1)
				local fade_in_end_time = fade_in_start_time + fade_in_time
				local faded_word
				if color == nil then
					if progress_time > fade_in_end_time then
						faded_word = '[FF]' .. words[i] .. '[-]'
					elseif progress_time < fade_in_start_time then
						faded_word = '[00]' .. words[i] .. '[-]'
					else
						local progress = (progress_time - fade_in_start_time) / fade_in_time
						faded_word = string.format("[%02x]%s[-]", math.floor(progress * 255 + 0.5), words[i])
					end
				else
					if progress_time > fade_in_end_time then
						faded_word = '[' .. color .. 'FF]' .. words[i] .. '[-]'
					elseif progress_time < fade_in_start_time then
						faded_word = '[' .. color .. '00]' .. words[i] .. '[-]'
					else
						local progress = (progress_time - fade_in_start_time) / fade_in_time
						faded_word = string.format('[%s%02x]%s[-]', color, math.floor(progress * 255 + 0.5), words[i])
					end
				end
				if faded_text ~= nil then
					faded_text = faded_text .. ' ' .. faded_word
				else
					faded_text = faded_word
				end
			end
			if additional_option ~= nil then
				faded_text = additional_option .. faded_text
			end
			CS.Oak.UI.MediaSubtitleController.Instance:SetSubtitle(faded_text, 9999)
		elseif progress_time < total_duration - fade_out_duration - fade_out_time then
			-- keep
			local faded_text = nil
			for i = 1, #words do
				local faded_word
				if color == nil then
					faded_word = '[FF]' .. words[i] .. '[-]'
				else
					faded_word = '[' .. color .. ']' .. words[i] .. '[-]'
				end
				if faded_text ~= nil then
					faded_text = faded_text .. ' ' .. faded_word
				else
					faded_text = faded_word
				end
			end
			if additional_option ~= nil then
				faded_text = additional_option .. faded_text
			end
			CS.Oak.UI.MediaSubtitleController.Instance:SetSubtitle(faded_text, 9999)
		else
			-- fade out
			local fade_out_period = fade_out_duration
			if #words > 1 then
				fade_out_period = fade_out_duration / (#words - 1)
			end
			local faded_text = nil
			for i = 1, #words do
				local fade_out_start_time = fade_in_duration + fade_in_time + keep_duration + fade_out_period * (i - 1)
				local fade_out_end_time = fade_out_start_time + fade_out_time
				local faded_word
				if color == nil then
					if progress_time > fade_out_end_time then
						faded_word = '[00]' .. words[i] .. '[-]'
					elseif progress_time < fade_out_start_time then
						faded_word = '[FF]' .. words[i] .. '[-]'
					else
						local progress = 1 - (progress_time - fade_out_start_time) / fade_out_time
						faded_word = string.format("[%02x]%s[-]", math.floor(progress * 255 + 0.5), words[i])
					end
				else
					if progress_time > fade_out_end_time then
						faded_word = '[' .. color .. '00]' .. words[i] .. '[-]'
					elseif progress_time < fade_out_start_time then
						faded_word = '[' .. color .. 'FF]' .. words[i] .. '[-]'
					else
						local progress = 1 - (progress_time - fade_out_start_time) / fade_out_time
						faded_word = string.format("[%s%02x]%s[-]", color, math.floor(progress * 255 + 0.5), words[i])
					end
				end
				if faded_text ~= nil then
					faded_text = faded_text .. ' ' .. faded_word
				else
					faded_text = faded_word
				end
			end
			if additional_option ~= nil then
				faded_text = additional_option .. faded_text
			end
			CS.Oak.UI.MediaSubtitleController.Instance:SetSubtitle(faded_text, 9999)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	CS.Oak.UI.MediaSubtitleController.Instance:ReleaseAllSubtitles()
end

function local_class:staff_roll_helper()
	-- 엔딩 크레딧으로 사용할 타이핑 텍스트
	local typing_text_asset_bundle_name = 'ondemand/v2_10_futurecastle_part2/ui'
	local typing_text_asset_name = 'typing_text_bold'

	local resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local typing_text = nil
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			resholder, typing_text_asset_bundle_name, typing_text_asset_name, function(prefab)
				typing_text = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(
						stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))
				typing_text.Label.fontSize = 24
				typing_text.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Left
			end)

	self.staff_roll_progress = {
		background_fade_in = 1,
		light_orb = 2,
		show_credits = 3,
		moving_out = 4,
		waiting = 5,
		done = 6
	}

	self.staff_roll_started = true

	-- 스탭롤 진행도
	self.current_staff_roll_progress = self.staff_roll_progress.background_fade_in

	-- 스탭롤의 총 재생 시간
	local staff_roll_duration = 102.5

	-- 한번에 출력할 텍스트의 갯수 테이블
	-- 첫 번째에 있는 0은 부서 출력을 뜻함.
	local displaying_at_once = {
		0, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3,
		0, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 2,
		0, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 1,
		0, 3, 3, 3, 1,
		0, 1,
		0, 3, 2
	}

	local displaying_at_once = {
		0, 6, 6, 6, 6, 3,
		0, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 5,
		0, 6, 6, 6, 4,
		0, 6, 4,
		0, 1,
		0, 5
	}

	local title_count = 0
	for i = 1, #displaying_at_once do
		if displaying_at_once[i] == 0 then
			title_count = title_count + 1
		end
	end

	local displaying_at_once_index = 1

	-- 각각의 스태프들의 이름이 노출되는 시간.
	local displaying_duration = staff_roll_duration / (#displaying_at_once - title_count)

	-- 현재까지 스탭롤이 재생된 시간
	self.total_staff_roll_time_passed = 0

	-- 스탭 이름이 출력 되어야하는 위치 enum
	local text_direction = {
		down = 1,
		up = 2
	}

	local current_text_direction = text_direction.down

	local set_next_direction = function(cur_dir, text_dir)
		if cur_dir == text_dir.up then
			return text_dir.down
		elseif cur_dir == text_dir.down then
			return text_dir.up
		end
	end

	local resolution_rate = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height

	local manual_width_half = (stage.UIRoot.manualWidth / 2)
	local manual_height_half = (stage.UIRoot.manualHeight / 2)

	-- [1] -> 아래에서 출력된 이름의 웨이포인트
	-- [2] -> 위에서 출력된 이름의 웨이포인트
	local text_dests = nil

	if resolution_rate <= 1.34 then
		text_dests = 	{
			{
				vector(manual_width_half * 0.5, -manual_height_half, 0),
				vector(manual_width_half * 0.5, -manual_height_half * 0.5, 0),
				vector(manual_width_half * 1.5, -manual_height_half * 0.5, 0)
			},
			{
				vector(manual_width_half * 1.5, manual_height_half * 1.1, 0),
				vector(manual_width_half * 0.5, manual_height_half * 1.1, 0),
				vector(manual_width_half * 0.5, manual_height_half * 1.6, 0),
			},
		}
	else
		text_dests = 	{
			{
				vector(manual_width_half * 0.6, -manual_height_half, 0),
				vector(manual_width_half * 0.6, -manual_height_half * 0.4, 0),
				vector(manual_width_half * 1.5, -manual_height_half * 0.4, 0)
			},
			{
				vector(manual_width_half * 1.5, manual_height_half * 0.9, 0),
				vector(manual_width_half * 0.6, manual_height_half * 0.9, 0),
				vector(manual_width_half * 0.6, manual_height_half * 1.4, 0),
			},
		}
	end

	-- 스탭롤의 나타나고 사라지는 시간의 비율 (0 ~ 1)
	-- @index [1] -> 이름이 나타나는데 걸리는 시간의 비율
	-- @index [2] -> 나타난 이름이 화면에서 유지되는 시간의 비율
	-- @index [3] -> 이름이 사라지는데 걸리는 시간의 비율
	local display_duration_rate = {
		0.2 * displaying_duration,
		0.6 * displaying_duration,
		0.2 * displaying_duration
	}

	local is_in_range = function(time_passed, range_type, rate)
		if range_type == 1 then
			return time_passed > 0 and time_passed <= rate[1]
		elseif range_type == 2 then
			return time_passed > rate[1] and time_passed <= rate[1] + rate[2]
		elseif range_type == 3 then
			return time_passed > rate[1] + rate[2] and time_passed <= rate[1] + rate[2] + rate[3]
		elseif range_type == 'end' then
			return time_passed > rate[1] + rate[2] + rate[3]
		end

	local staff_roll_text_key = 's1_staff_roll_'
