			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, typing_text:SetTypedText(
					credit_text, 1000, 0, 999))


		elseif count == 6 then
			local credit_text = string.format("[c][EAA032]%s[-][/c]\n\n%s, %s\n\n%s, %s\n\n%s, %s",
					current_title,
					game_string:GetString(staff_roll_text_key .. current_showing_staff_name_index),
					game_string:GetString(staff_roll_text_key .. current_showing_staff_name_index + 1),
					game_string:GetString(staff_roll_text_key .. current_showing_staff_name_index + 2),
					game_string:GetString(staff_roll_text_key .. current_showing_staff_name_index + 3),
					game_string:GetString(staff_roll_text_key .. current_showing_staff_name_index + 4),
					game_string:GetString(staff_roll_text_key .. current_showing_staff_name_index + 5)
			)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, typing_text:SetTypedText(
					credit_text, 1000, 0, 999))
		end

		local init = text_dests[current_text_direction][1]
		typing_text.Label.transform.localPosition = init
		typing_text.Label.color = text_color
	end

	local music_on = false

	-- 빛의 구체 로컬 움직임용 타이머
	local light_orb_horizontal_time_passed = 0
	local continuous_end = false

	while (self.current_staff_roll_progress ~= self.staff_roll_progress.done) do
		local old_time = self.total_staff_roll_time_passed
		self.total_staff_roll_time_passed = self.total_staff_roll_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.current_staff_roll_progress == self.staff_roll_progress.background_fade_in then
			local color = particle_system.main.startColor.color
			color.a = (self.total_staff_roll_time_passed / background_fade_in_duration)

			if self.total_staff_roll_time_passed >= background_fade_in_duration then
				color.a = 1

				if self.total_staff_roll_time_passed >= background_fade_in_duration + 2 then
					self.current_staff_roll_progress = self.staff_roll_progress.light_orb
					self.total_staff_roll_time_passed = 0
				end
			end

			particle_system.main.startColor = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(color)

		elseif self.current_staff_roll_progress == self.staff_roll_progress.light_orb then
			if not music_on then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music(
						{ name = 'ondemand/v2_10_futurecastle_part2/audio/music:bgm_idol_panorama_01', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
				music_on = true
			end

			self.staff_roll_light_orb:SetActive(true)
			local duration = self.total_staff_roll_time_passed / light_orb_move_duration
			local capped_dur = duration
			if capped_dur > 1 then
				capped_dur = 1
			end
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(self.total_staff_roll_time_passed, 0, 1, light_orb_move_duration)
			self.staff_roll_light_orb.transform.localPosition
					= unity_class.vector3.Lerp(light_orb_init_pos, light_orb_dest_pos, progress)

			if self.total_staff_roll_time_passed >= light_orb_move_duration + 0.7 then
				self.current_staff_roll_progress = self.staff_roll_progress.show_credits
				self.total_staff_roll_time_passed = 0
				self.last_light_orb_pos = self.staff_roll_light_orb.transform.localPosition
			end

		-- 크래딧을 출력하는 단계
		elseif self.current_staff_roll_progress == self.staff_roll_progress.show_credits then
			local count = displaying_at_once[displaying_at_once_index]
			if count == 0 then
				current_title = game_string:GetString(staff_roll_text_key .. current_showing_staff_name_index)
				displaying_at_once_index = displaying_at_once_index + 1
				current_showing_staff_name_index = current_showing_staff_name_index + 1
				count = displaying_at_once[displaying_at_once_index]
			end

			light_orb_horizontal_time_passed = light_orb_horizontal_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local light_orb_offset = vector(0, -unity_class.mathf.Sin(light_orb_horizontal_time_passed * 1.25) * 0.7, 0)
			--self.staff_roll_light_orb.transform.localPosition = light_orb_dest_pos + light_orb_offset
			self.staff_roll_light_orb.transform.localPosition = self.last_light_orb_pos + light_orb_offset
			if cur_text_time_passed == 0 then
				set_text(count)
			end

			cur_text_time_passed = cur_text_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			-- 처음 위치 -> 나타나는 구간
			if is_in_range(cur_text_time_passed, 1, display_duration_rate) then
				typing_text.Label.transform.localPosition = text_dests[current_text_direction][2]
				local c = unity_class.color.white
				c.a = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 1, cur_text_time_passed / 0.3)
				typing_text.Label.color = c
				-- 대기하는 구간
			elseif is_in_range(cur_text_time_passed, 2, display_duration_rate) then
				if count == 0 then count = 1 end
				typing_text.Label.transform.localPosition = text_dests[current_text_direction][2]

				-- 대기 -> 없어지는 구간
			elseif is_in_range(cur_text_time_passed, 3, display_duration_rate) then
				local re_ranged_cur_time_passed = cur_text_time_passed - (display_duration_rate[1] + display_duration_rate[2])
				local c = unity_class.color.white
				c.a = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0, re_ranged_cur_time_passed / 0.3)
				typing_text.Label.color = c
			elseif is_in_range(cur_text_time_passed, 'end', display_duration_rate) then
				cur_text_time_passed = 0
				current_showing_staff_name_index = current_showing_staff_name_index + ((count == 0 and 1 or count))
				current_text_direction = set_next_direction(current_text_direction, text_direction)
				displaying_at_once_index = displaying_at_once_index + 1
			end

			-- 스탭롤 재생이 전부가 끝났을 경우
			if (self.total_staff_roll_time_passed >= staff_roll_duration and displaying_at_once_index == #displaying_at_once + 1) then
				self.current_staff_roll_progress = self.staff_roll_progress.waiting
				self.total_staff_roll_time_passed = 0
			end
		elseif self.current_staff_roll_progress == self.staff_roll_progress.waiting then
			light_orb_horizontal_time_passed = light_orb_horizontal_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local light_orb_offset = vector(0, -unity_class.mathf.Sin(light_orb_horizontal_time_passed * 1.25) * 0.7, 0)
			self.staff_roll_light_orb.transform.localPosition = self.last_light_orb_pos + light_orb_offset

			if (self.total_staff_roll_time_passed >= 0.5) then
				self.current_staff_roll_progress = self.staff_roll_progress.moving_out
				self.total_staff_roll_time_passed = 0
				continuous_end = true
			end
		elseif self.current_staff_roll_progress == self.staff_roll_progress.moving_out then
			if continuous_end then
				light_orb_horizontal_time_passed = light_orb_horizontal_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local light_orb_offset = vector(0, -unity_class.mathf.Sin(light_orb_horizontal_time_passed * 1.25) * 0.7, 0)
				self.staff_roll_light_orb.transform.localPosition = self.last_light_orb_pos + light_orb_offset
			end

			typing_text:ForceFinish()
			----프롤로그 주인공/공주 추락 씬에 쓰였던 바람 가르는 이펙트가 나온다 - 방향은 반대로 위로 올라가는 것으로.
			self.staff_roll_wind_fail:SetActive(true)
			local duration = self.total_staff_roll_time_passed / wind_effect_move_duration
			self.staff_roll_wind_fail.transform.localPosition
					= unity_class.vector3.Lerp(wind_effect_init_pos, wind_effect_dest_pos, duration)

			if old_time < 1.0 and self.total_staff_roll_time_passed >= 1.0 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fade_out_01')
				screen_util.fade_out(2, unity_class.color.white, "linear")
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fade_out_01')
			elseif old_time < 3.0 and self.total_staff_roll_time_passed >= 3.0 then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1.5 })
			elseif old_time < 5.0 and self.total_staff_roll_time_passed >= 5.0 then
				self.current_staff_roll_progress = self.staff_roll_progress.done
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	resholder:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType ~= CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		return false
	end

	if not self.staff_roll_overlayed and self.current_staff_roll_progress ~= nil
			and self.current_staff_roll_progress < self.staff_roll_progress.moving_out then
		self.staff_roll_overlayed = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff_roll_touch, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:staff_roll_touch()
	local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.PopUpState()
	popup_state.NoticePopUp = false
	popup_state.Title = game_string:GetString("s1_staff_roll_message")
	popup_state.Text = game_string:GetString('s1_staff_roll_exit')
	popup_state.DontPopOverlay = false
	local wait_for_exit = true
	popup_state.OnYesOrNoClicked = function (ok)
		wait_for_exit = false
		if ok then
			self.current_staff_roll_progress = self.staff_roll_progress.moving_out
			self.total_staff_roll_time_passed = 0
		end
	end
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.PopUp.Instance, popup_state)

	while wait_for_exit do
		if self.current_staff_roll_progress ~= nil and self.current_staff_roll_progress == self.staff_roll_progress.moving_out then
			wait_for_exit = false
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	self.staff_roll_overlayed = false
end

function local_class:inn_camera_move(target_pos, duration)
	-- self.inn_camera.localPosition = vector(1.5, 0, -15)
	target_pos = self:get_inn_camera_pos(target_pos)

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = self.inn_camera.localPosition
	local layer_pos_infos = {}
	for i = 1, #self.inn_layer_infos do
		local layer_start_pos = self.inn_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition
		layer_pos_infos[i] = {
			start_pos = layer_start_pos,
			target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(layer_start_pos, vector_util.get_0yz(layer_start_pos, target_pos.x),
					self.inn_layer_infos[i].move_ratio)
		}
	end

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		self.inn_camera.localPosition = cur_pos
		self.camera_pivot.position = self.inn_camera.position + self.camera_pivot_offset
		for i = 1, #self.inn_layer_infos do
			self.inn_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
					layer_pos_infos[i].start_pos, layer_pos_infos[i].target_pos, progress)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.inn_camera.localPosition = target_pos
	self.camera_pivot.position = self.inn_camera.position + self.camera_pivot_offset

	for i = 1, #self.inn_layer_infos do
		self.inn_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition = layer_pos_infos[i].target_pos
	end
end

-- x축 방향으로 움직이는 경우만 산정
function local_class:get_inn_camera_pos(target_pos)
	if target_pos.x + self.inn_camera_half_width + self.inn_camera_max_shake > self.inn_background_x_max then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(target_pos,
				self.inn_background_x_max - self.inn_camera_half_width - self.inn_camera_max_shake)
	elseif target_pos.x - self.inn_camera_half_width - self.inn_camera_max_shake < self.inn_background_x_min then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(target_pos,
				self.inn_background_x_min + self.inn_camera_half_width + self.inn_camera_max_shake)
	end

	return target_pos
end

function local_class:inn_camera_shake(val, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local origin_pos = self.inn_camera.localPosition
	local layer_start_pos_list = {}
	for i = 1, #self.inn_layer_infos do
		layer_start_pos_list[i] = self.inn_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition
	end

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		-- 랜덤한 x,y축 진동
		local rand_x = random_util.get_random_int(0, val) / 1000
		local rand_y = random_util.get_random_int(0, val) / 1000
		local move_dif = vector(rand_x, rand_y, 0)

		self.inn_camera.localPosition = origin_pos + move_dif
		self.camera_pivot.position = self.inn_camera.position + self.camera_pivot_offset

		for i = 1, #self.inn_layer_infos do
			self.inn_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition = layer_start_pos_list[i]
					+ move_dif * self.inn_layer_infos[i].move_ratio
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.inn_camera.localPosition = origin_pos
	self.camera_pivot.position = self.inn_camera.position + self.camera_pivot_offset
	for i = 1, #self.inn_layer_infos do
		self.inn_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition = layer_start_pos_list[i]
	end
end

function local_class:inn_cloud_move_routine()
	while self.is_cloud_moving do
		for _, info in pairs(self.inn_cloud_layer_infos) do
			info.transform.localPosition = info.transform.localPosition
					+ vector(info.move_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime, 0, 0)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:inn_camera_y_move(target_pos, duration, use_stage_camera)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = self.inn_camera.localPosition
	target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(target_pos, start_pos.x)
	local layer_pos_infos = {}
	for i = 1, #self.inn_back_layer_infos do
		local layer_start_pos = self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition
		layer_pos_infos[i] = {
			start_pos = layer_start_pos,
			target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(layer_start_pos, vector_util.get_x0z(layer_start_pos, target_pos.y),
					self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].move_ratio)
		}
	end
	use_stage_camera = lua_helper.get_or_default(use_stage_camera, true)

	while time_passed < duration do
		local time_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		-- 보간법 적용
		local cur_cam_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine(
				time_progress, start_pos.y, target_pos.y - start_pos.y, 1)
		local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos, cur_cam_y)

		self.inn_camera.localPosition = cur_pos
		if use_stage_camera then
			self.camera_pivot.position = self.inn_camera.position + self.camera_pivot_offset
		end

		for i = 1, #self.inn_back_layer_infos do
			local cur_y_pos = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine(
					time_progress, layer_pos_infos[i].start_pos.y,
					layer_pos_infos[i].target_pos.y - layer_pos_infos[i].start_pos.y, 1)

			self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(
					layer_pos_infos[i].start_pos, cur_y_pos)
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.inn_camera.localPosition = target_pos
	if use_stage_camera then
		self.camera_pivot.position = self.inn_camera.position + self.camera_pivot_offset
	end

	for i = 1, #self.inn_back_layer_infos do
		self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition = layer_pos_infos[i].target_pos
	end
end

function local_class:fin_ui_fade_async(target_alpha, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_alpha = self.fin_ui_texture.color.a

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_alpha = start_alpha * (1 - progress) + target_alpha * progress
		self.fin_ui_texture.color = unity_color({1, 1, 1, cur_alpha})

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.fin_ui_texture.color = unity_color({1, 1, 1, target_alpha})
end

	self.damage_count = 8000

	self.damage_effect_lv1 = nil

	self.damage_level = 0

	-- 인베이더 전함 colliders
	self.colliders = nil

	self.get_knight_gatling = function()
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			return get_character('knight_male_gatling')
		end

		return get_character('knight_female_gatling')
	end

	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end

	self.princess_parent = nil

	self.game_start = false

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	self.knight_parent = self.get_knight_gatling().Transform.parent
	self.princess_parent = self.get_princess().Transform.parent

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'shot_cross_hair',
			'fx_stage1_chase_player_bullet',
			'fx_stage1_chase_player_gunfire',
			'fx_stage1_ship_damaged_fire',
			'fx_stage1_chase_ship_hit',
			'fx_stage1_chase_ship_hit_big')

	if self.res_holder == nil then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

		-- 진행중에는 StageCameraPivot에 달려있는 AudioListener를 꺼준다.
		self.stage_audio_listner = stage_camera:GetComponentInParent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.AudioListener))
		self.stage_audio_listner.enabled = false

		self.prefab_scene = self.controller.prefab_scene
		self.prefab_scene.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.prefab_scene.transform.localPosition = self.scene_pos

		-- 인베이더 함선의 collider 저장
		self.invader_ship = self.prefab_scene.transform:Find('invader_ship')
		self.colliders = {}
		local child = self.invader_ship.transform:Find('body')
		table.insert(self.colliders, child.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider)))
		child = self.invader_ship.transform:Find('wing_left')
		table.insert(self.colliders, child.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider)))
		child = self.invader_ship.transform:Find('wing_right')
		table.insert(self.colliders, child.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider)))
		child = self.invader_ship.transform:Find('engine_left')
		table.insert(self.colliders, child.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider)))
		child = self.invader_ship.transform:Find('engine_right')
		table.insert(self.colliders, child.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider)))

		-- 인베이더 함선의 발사 위치
		self.invader_shot_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.prefab_scene.transform, 'fx_stage1_chase_gun_groundhit')

		-- 인베이더 함선 피격 이펙트 저장
		local fx = self.invader_ship.transform:Find('fx')
		self.damage_effect_lv1 = fx.transform:Find('fx_stage1_ship_damaged_fire_1')
		self.damage_effect_lv2 = fx.transform:Find('fx_stage1_ship_damaged_fire_2')

		--region 바이크 관련 설정
		local character = self.prefab_scene.transform:Find('character')
		character = character.transform:Find('character')
		local bike = character.transform:Find('futurecastle2_bike')

		-- 개틀링건, 회전 정보 저장
		self.gatlinggun = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(bike.transform, 'part4'):Find('obj_gatlinggun')
		self.gatlinggun_transform = self.gatlinggun.transform
		-- 개틀링건 발사 위치 저장
		self.shot_tarnsform = self.gatlinggun_transform:Find('shot_transform').transform

		self.in_bike_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(bike.transform, 'knight_transform')
		--endregion

		-- 스테이지 카메라의 background와 같이 출력하기 위해 프리팹 카메라 clearFlags를 depth로 변경
		local prefab_camera = self.prefab_scene.transform:Find('Camera').transform:Find('Camera').transform:Find('Camera')
		prefab_camera.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera)).clearFlags = CS.UnityEngine.CameraClearFlags.Depth

		-- 스테이지 배경화면 cullingMask와 stage_camera의 cullingMask 대상 변경
		self.cur_camera_mask = stage_camera.Camera.cullingMask
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(get_field_object('back_background').transform, 'SpecialEvents')
		stage_camera.Camera.cullingMask = 1 << CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('SpecialEvents')

		--region HP 세팅
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder, 'ui/battle/base', 'top_hp_bar_xmas', function(prefab)
					self.hp_bar = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					self.boss_hp = self.hp_bar.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBar2))
				end)

		self.boss_hp.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.boss_hp.MaxHP = math.floor(self.damage_count)
		self.boss_hp.HP = math.floor(self.damage_count)
		--endregion
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v2_10_futurecastle_part2/audio/music:bgm_futurecastle2_shooting', state = 'field', mix = 0 })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scroll_scene_routine, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad)

	if self.anim_event_handler ~= nil then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.anim_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent))
		self.anim_event_handler = nil
	end

	-- 스파인 회전, 무기 다시 되돌림
	local knight = self.get_knight_gatling()
	knight.Transform:SetParent(self.knight_parent)
	knight.SpineController:UseBend(true)
	knight.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, 0))

	local princess = self.get_princess()
	princess.Transform:SetParent(self.princess_parent)
	princess.SpineController:UseBend(true)
	princess.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, 0))

	self.knight_parent = nil
	self.princess_parent = nil

	self.invader_ship = nil
	self.animator = nil
	self.colliders = nil
	self.shot_tarnsform = nil
	self.damage_effect_lv1 = nil
	self.damage_effect_lv2 = nil
	self.gatlinggun_transform = nil
	self.gatlinggun = nil

	-- 껐던 Stage의 AudioListener를 다시 켜준다.
	self.stage_audio_listner.enabled = true

	-- 카메라 layer를 다시 돌려준다
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(get_field_object('back_background').transform, 'Default')
	stage_camera.Camera.cullingMask = 1--self.cur_camera_mask
	self.cur_camera_mask = nil

	if self.fire_effect ~= nil then
		self.fire_effect:Dispose()
		self.fire_effect = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.hp_bar) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.hp_bar.gameObject)
		self.hp_bar = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.res_holder) then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

-- 기사 움직임 제어
function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if self.game_start then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		local add = e.StickDirection * unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime * self.knight_move_speed

		self.knight_move_pos = self.knight_move_pos + add
		self.knight_move_pos.x = math.max(self.knight_move_pos.x, -4)
		self.knight_move_pos.x = math.min(self.knight_move_pos.x, 4)
		self.knight_move_pos.y = 0
		self.knight_move_pos.z = 0

		local knight = self.get_knight_gatling()
		knight.Position = self.knight_pos + self.knight_move_pos
	end
end

-- 기사가 오토바이 타기까지의 루틴
function local_class:ride_bike()
	local blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01'
	, loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'default', player_priority = 'default' })

	self.gatlinggun.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local knight = self.get_knight_gatling()
	local character = self.prefab_scene.transform:Find('character')
	local sorting_group = knight.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform.gameObject
			:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Rendering.SortingGroup))
	sorting_group.sortingOrder = 5
	sorting_group.sortingLayerName = 'Top Effects'

	character = character.transform:Find('character')
	local bike = character.transform:Find('futurecastle2_bike')
	local bike_knight_pos = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(bike.transform, 'knight_pos')
	local bike_princess_pos = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(bike.transform, 'princess_pos')
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	bike.transform:Find('mesh').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('idle')

	princess.Transform:SetParent(bike_princess_pos)
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(princess, vector(0,0,0))
	princess.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(13, 0, 0))
	princess.SpineController:UseBend(false)

	local check_dist = false
	local dist = (knight.Position - self.in_bike_transform.position).magnitude
	while not self.game_start and dist > 1.3 do
		dist = (knight.Position - self.in_bike_transform.position).magnitude
		if dist <= 1.3 then
			check_dist = true
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- Dpad도 조작에서 제거
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	local dir = (knight.Position - self.in_bike_transform.position).normalized
	if dir.x > 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	end

	-- 아직 오토바이를 안 탔다면
	if not check_dist then
		character_util.move_to_async(knight, self.in_bike_transform.position + dir * 1.5, nil, 6)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'get', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.jump(knight, 1.2, 0.6)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bike_somersault_01')

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = knight.Position
	while time_passed < 0.6 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, self.in_bike_transform.position, time_passed / 0.6)
		character_util.set_position(knight, cur_pos)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	sorting_group.sortingOrder = 0
	sorting_group.sortingLayerName = 'Default'

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'up')
	knight.Transform:SetParent(bike_knight_pos)
	character_util.set_position(knight, vector(0,0,0))
	knight.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(13, 0, 0)


	self.gatlinggun.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.bike_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_bike_loop_01",
												 loop = true, type_priority = 'default',
												 player_priority = 'default' })

	blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_targeted_03')
	-- 게임 시작
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	self:hide_top_ui()

	-- UI 추가
	self.boss_hp:AppearBossHp()
	-- 아이콘 및 조작 루틴
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.update_icon, self))
	-- 머신건 발사 루틴
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shot_bullet_routine, self))
end

function local_class:scroll_scene_routine()
	coroutine.yield()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 스테이지 컨트롤러에서 불필요하게 불리는 코루틴 끄기 위해서 커스텀 이벤트 전송
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(knight, { 'section_5' }))

	-- 기사 세팅
	local knight = self.get_knight_gatling()
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'damaged' })
	knight.Position = self.scene_pos + vector(-1.5, -17.25, -31)
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'run' })
	knight.SpineController:UseBend(false)
	knight.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(-30, 0, 0))

	--region 기존 조작 제거
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	-- state 체인지 동안 한 프레임 기다려 줌
	coroutine.yield()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(princess, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(knight, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)
	--endregion

	-- 등장에 맞춰 재생
	-- animator:Play 이후 바로 길이를 읽어올 수 없으므로 coroutine.yield 호출
	self.animator = self.prefab_scene:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	self.animator:Play('futurecastle_part2_stage1_interlude', -1)
	coroutine.yield()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_08')
	coroutine.yield()

	character_util.move_to(knight, self.knight_pos, 3.7)

	while not self.animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0):IsName('futurecastle_part2_stage1_appear') do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	self:hide_top_ui()

	--region 사운드 작업
	self.anim_event_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)

			if e.EventName == 'bike_start' then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bike_rush_01')
			elseif e.EventName == 'bike_down' then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drift_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bike_cast_01')
			elseif e.EventName == 'bike_move' then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bike_somersault_01')
			elseif e.EventName == 'shot_start' then
				self.shot_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_05', loop = true, type_priority = 'battle_attack' })
			elseif e.EventName == 'shot_end' then
				if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
					self.shot_sfx:Stop()
					self.shot_sfx = nil
				end
			elseif e.EventName == 'aircraft' then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_04')
			elseif e.EventName == 'earthquake_start' then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_02')
				self.shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_06', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
			elseif e.EventName == 'earthquake_end' then
				if self.shake_sfx ~= nil then
					self.shake_sfx:Stop()
					self.shake_sfx = nil
				end
			elseif e.EventName == 'heavy_slash' then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavy_slash_01')
			elseif e.EventName == 'stomp_fire' then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
			elseif e.EventName == 'boom' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					for i = 1, 4 do
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_fire_01')
						wait_for_sec(0.15)
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')
						coroutine.yield()
					end
				end))
			elseif e.EventName == 'boss_die' then
				self.end1_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_loop_01', loop = true })
				self.end2_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
				self.end3_sfx =  music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01', loop = false, fade_out_time = 2})
			elseif e.EventName == 'fade_out' then
				self.end1_sfx:FadeOut(2)
				self.end2_sfx:FadeOut(2)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_02')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_imperial_explosion_01')
			elseif e.EventName == 'ship_dead' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_explosion_02')
					wait_for_sec(2)
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_explosion_02')
					wait_for_sec(2)
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_explosion_02')
				end))
			elseif e.EventName == 'aircraft_big' then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_04')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_09')
			elseif e.EventName == 'aircraft_2' then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_09')
			elseif e.EventName == 'aircraft_go' then
				self.air_time = 6.5
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_09')
			elseif e.EventName == 'scene_end' then
				--self.air_time = 10
			elseif e.EventName == 'check_out' then
				self.air_time = -1
			elseif e.EventName == 'follow' then
				self.follow = true
			elseif e.EventName == 'follow_end' then
				self.follow = false
			end
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self.anim_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'callback')
	--endregion

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ride_bike, self))
	wait_for_sec(7)
	-- 여기야, {0}!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader,
			{ key = { 'futurecastle_part2_s5_1', user.Name }
			, world_pos = self.knight_pos + vector(3, 1, 0), bubble_type = 'shout'
			, euler_angle = vector(-30, 0, 0), scale = 4 })

	wait_for_sec(3)
	self.game_start = true

	while not self.animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0):IsName('futurecastle_part2_stage1_scroll') do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 대사 루틴
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_routine, self))

	-- 추격씬 종료 애니메이션 실행 전 까지 대기
	while not self.animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0):IsName('futurecastle_part2_stage1_end') do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 보스 체력 0로 만들고
	while self.damage_count > 0 and self.animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).normalizedTime < 0.6 do
		local cur_count = self.damage_count
		self.damage_count = math.max(self.damage_count - 30, 0)
		self.boss_hp.HP = math.floor(self.damage_count)
		self.boss_hp.Diff = math.floor(cur_count)
		wait_for_sec(0.02)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	while self.animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).normalizedTime < 0.6 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 추격씬 종료
	self.scene_end_check = true

	-- 총구 이펙트 제거
	if self.fire_effect then
		self.fire_effect:Dispose()
		self.fire_effect = nil
	end

	if self.player_shoot_sfx then
		self.player_shoot_sfx:Stop()
		self.player_shoot_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.hit_loop_sfx then
		self.hit_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.hit_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.hit_loop_sfx_2 then
		self.hit_loop_sfx_2:Stop()
		self.hit_loop_sfx_2 = nil
	end

	self.bike_sfx:Stop()
	self.bike_sfx = nil

	-- 보스 hp바 제거
	self.boss_hp.HP = 0
	self.boss_hp.Diff = math.floor(self.damage_count)
	self.boss_hp:BossHpDispose()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	camera_util.move(vector(1500,0, 0), 0)
	self.end3_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	wait_for_sec(3.5)
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.anim_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent))
	self.anim_event_handler = nil
	self.prefab_scene.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)


	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:shot_bullet_routine()
	local shot_delay = 0.05
	local time_passed = shot_delay
	self.player_shoot_sfx = nil
	self.hit_loop_sfx = nil
	self.damage_sound = 0
	self.damage_sound_2 = 0
	while not self.scene_end_check do
		if self.input_check then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if time_passed >= shot_delay then
				time_passed = 0

				if self.fire_effect == nil then
					self.fire_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_stage1_chase_player_gunfire'):Instantiate(
							self.shot_tarnsform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.shot_tarnsform)

					self.player_shoot_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_05'
					, loop = true, type_priority = 'battle_attack', player_priority = 'object' })
				end

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.shot_bullet, self, self.shot_tarnsform.position, self.shot_pos))
			end
		else
			time_passed = shot_delay

			if self.fire_effect then
				self.player_shoot_sfx:Stop()
				self.player_shootplayer_shoot_sfx = nil
				self.fire_effect:Dispose()
				self.fire_effect = nil
			end
		end

		if self.damage_sound > 0 then
			self.damage_sound = self.damage_sound - unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if self.hit_loop_sfx == nil then
				self.hit_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_craft_01'
				, loop = true, type_priority = 'ui', player_priority = 'object' })
			end
		else
			if self.hit_loop_sfx ~= nil then
				self.hit_loop_sfx:Stop()
				self.hit_loop_sfx = nil
			end
		end

		if self.damage_sound_2 > 0 then
			self.damage_sound_2 = self.damage_sound_2 - unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if self.hit_loop_sfx_2 == nil then
				self.hit_loop_sfx_2 = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_craft_02'
				, loop = true, type_priority = 'ui', player_priority = 'object' })
			end
		else
			if self.hit_loop_sfx_2 ~= nil then
				self.hit_loop_sfx_2:Stop()
				self.hit_loop_sfx_2 = nil
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:shot_bullet(start_pos, target_pos)
	local bullet = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_stage1_chase_player_bullet'):Instantiate(start_pos)

	-- 랜덤 위치 발사 되도록 조정
	local x = 0--unity_class.random.Range(-10, 10)
	local y = 0--unity_class.random.Range(-10, -10)
	local z = 0--unity_class.random.Range(-10, 10)
	target_pos = target_pos + vector(x, y, z)

	local shoot_dir = (target_pos - (start_pos)).normalized
	local end_pos = start_pos + shoot_dir * 40
	bullet.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)
	bullet.transform.localScale = vector(2,2,2)

	self.damage = 4
	local bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(bullet.transform.position, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.01)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < 0.25 and not self.scene_end_check do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		bullet.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed * 2)
		bound.center = bullet.transform.position

		for i, collider in ipairs(self.colliders) do
			if collider.bounds:Intersects(bound) then
				local is_not_engine = i < 4
				local dmg_factor = 2.4
				if is_not_engine then
					dmg_factor = 0.8
				end


				-- 데미지 처리
				local cur_count = self.damage_count
				self.damage_count = self.damage_count - self.damage * dmg_factor
				self.boss_hp.HP = math.floor(self.damage_count)
				self.boss_hp.Diff = math.floor(cur_count)

				-- 이펙트 부착 처리
				if self.damage_count <= self.boss_hp.MaxHP * 0.9 and self.damage_level == 0 then
					self.damage = 2
					self.damage_level = 1
					self.damage_effect_lv1.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				elseif self.damage_count <= self.boss_hp.MaxHP * 0.8 and self.damage_level == 1 then
					self.damage = 2
					self.damage_level = 2
					self.damage_effect_lv2.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				elseif self.damage_count <= self.boss_hp.MaxHP * 0.2 then
					self.damage = 2
				end

				-- 피격 이펙트
				if is_not_engine then
					self.damage_sound = 0.1
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_stage1_chase_ship_hit'):Instantiate(bullet.transform.position)
				else
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_stage1_chase_ship_hit_big'):Instantiate(bullet.transform.position)
					self.damage_sound_2 = 0.1
				end

				bullet:Dispose()
				return
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	bullet:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_icon()
	local width = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width
	local height = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height
	local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height
	local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight)


	-- 버튼 생성
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad)

	local side_pad_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(user_party)[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad]
	local button = side_pad_ui.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShotButton))

	-- 버튼 콜라이더 가져오기
	local button_collider = side_pad_ui.transform:Find('Touch').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
	button_collider.size = vector(300, 100)

	-- 락온 프리팹 생성
	local shot_icon = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("shot_cross_hair"):Instantiate(self.scene_pos)
	local icon_sprite = shot_icon.transform:Find('ic').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(shot_icon.transform, "FieldUI")

	self.testcamera = self.prefab_scene.transform:Find('Camera').transform:Find('Camera').transform:Find('Camera')
	self.air_time = 0
	self.follow = false

	while not self.scene_end_check do
		-- 버튼 눌러진 상태 가져옴
		self.input_check = button.Pressed

		-- 보정 값
		local x_size = button.Ratio.x * 0.9

		-- 개틀링건 회전
		self.gatlinggun_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, x_size * 90 - 90, 25)

		self.air_time = self.air_time - unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local aim_pos = self.colliders[1].transform.position

		if aim_pos.z < self.shot_tarnsform.position.z + 8 then
			aim_pos.z = self.shot_tarnsform.position.z + 8
		end

		if aim_pos.y < self.shot_tarnsform.position.y then
			aim_pos.y = self.shot_tarnsform.position.y
		end

		local test_pos = self.testcamera.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera)):WorldToViewportPoint(aim_pos)
		local target_pos = field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera:ViewportToWorldPoint(test_pos)

		if target_pos.y > target_size.y * 0.3 then
			target_pos.y = target_size.y * 0.3
		end

		local icon_pos =  vector(x_size * (target_size.x * 0.5),  target_pos.y, 0)
		shot_icon.transform.position = icon_pos

		local view_pos = icon_pos
		view_pos.z = target_pos.z

		local vp2 = field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera:WorldToViewportPoint(view_pos)
		self.shot_pos = self.testcamera.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera)):ViewportToWorldPoint(vp2)

		if self.input_check then
			icon_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0.47843, 0.86666, 0.20392, 1 })

function local_class:battle_template_attack_repeat(char_1, char_2, vtr, direction)

	local cur_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(direction, true)

	char_1:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
			CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName('tutorial_sword_normal')))

	character_util.set_position(char_1, vtr + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(char_2, vtr + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(char_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(char_2, 'left')

	if cur_dir == true then
		character_util.set_position(char_1, vtr + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(char_2, vtr + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(char_1, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(char_2, 'left')
	else
		character_util.set_position(char_2, vtr + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(char_1, vtr + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(char_2, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(char_1, 'left')
	end

	local rand = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(1, 150))
	rand = rand/100
	wait_for_sec(rand)

	while true do
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_normal(char_1, char_2))

		coroutine.yield(self:attack_normal(char_2, char_1))
	end
end

-- 공격 연출 (A가 B를 때리고 B는 데미지 입고 원위치로)
function local_class:attack_normal(char_1, char_2)

	local dir = (char_2.Position - char_1.Position).normalized

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(char_1, dir * 0.7, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local duration = 0.3

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.spine_pulse_color(char_2, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(char_2, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(char_2, dir * 0.5, 0.3, 0.2)

	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	duration = 0.2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'sword_idle'})

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	duration = 0.35

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'sword_idle'})
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'attack' })
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (서로 힘겨루기하며 밀고 당김)
function local_class:battle_template_power_struggle(char_1, char_2, vtr, direction)

	local cur_dist = 0.5
	local cur_duration = 2
	local cur_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(direction, true)

	if cur_dir == true then
		character_util.set_position(char_1, vtr + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.05))
		character_util.set_position(char_2, vtr + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(char_1, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(char_2, 'left')
	else
		character_util.set_position(char_2, vtr + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(char_1, vtr + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(char_2, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(char_1, 'left')
	end

	local dir_1 = (char_2.Position - char_1.Position).normalized
	local dir_2 = (char_1.Position - char_2.Position).normalized

	character_util.shake(char_1, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_1, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.shake(char_2, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.move_to_async(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist,
			0.1, nil, false, false)

	while true do
		character_util.move_to(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		character_util.move_to(char_2, char_2.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < cur_duration do

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.move_to(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_2 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		character_util.move_to(char_2, char_2.Position + dir_2 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < cur_duration do

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

return local_class

	character_util.set_position(self.favi, vector(-1.5, 0, 13))
	character_util.set_direction(self.favi, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(self.favi, { name = 'eat' })

	local renderers = self.waypoint.Transform:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	self.waypoint_renderer_start_color_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.color)

	for i = 0, renderers.Length - 1 do
		-- index 0, 4, 5번에만 color 프로퍼티가 있으므로 이렇게 처리하였음...안 좋은 코드 구조라 개선 필요
		if i == 0 or i == 4 or i == 5 then
			self.waypoint_renderer_start_color_list:Add(renderers[i].material.color)
			renderers[i].material.color = unity_color({ 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1 })
		else
			self.waypoint_renderer_start_color_list:Add(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.princess = nil

	self.little_princess = nil
	self.little_knight = nil

	self.favi = nil
	self.lana = nil

	self.trio_list = nil

	self.waypoint = nil
	self.waypoint_renderer_start_color_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.heroes_enter_event_zone_name and
			self.current_progress < self.progress_state.appear_princess then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.appear_princess

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.princess_guardian_event, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.waypoint_event_zone_name and
			self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.waypoint_event, self)
	end
end

			nil, 6, true, false, true)

	character_util.set_anim(self.little_knight, { name = 'dance' })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.move_to_async(self.little_knight, self.little_knight.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0),

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_holdup_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	end

	self.little_princess.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	command_util.execute_holdup(self.little_knight, self.little_princess, self.little_knight.Position, 0.12, false)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_anim(self.little_knight, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_to_async(self.little_knight, self.little_knight.Position + vector(1.8, 0, 0),
			nil, 6, true, false, true)

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
		self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

		return
	end

	for n = 1, 2 do
		character_util.set_direction(self.little_princess, 'down')

		character_util.move_to_async(self.little_knight, self.little_knight.Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5),
				nil, 6, true, false, true)

		if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
			self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

			return
		end

		character_util.set_direction(self.little_princess, 'left')

		character_util.move_to_async(self.little_knight, self.little_knight.Position + vector(-5, 0, 0),
				nil, 6, true, false, true)

		if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
			self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

			return
		end

		if n == 1 then
			if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.little_knight.Position, user_party.Leader.Position) then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_princess_laugh_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
			end

			character_util.set_emotion(self.little_princess, { name = 'smile' })
		end

		character_util.set_direction(self.little_princess, 'up')

		if n == 1 then
			character_util.move_to_async(self.little_knight, self.little_knight.Position + vector(0, 0, 5),
					nil, 6, true, false, true)

			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
				self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

				return
			end

			character_util.set_direction(self.little_princess, 'right')

			character_util.move_to_async(self.little_knight, self.little_knight.Position + vector(5, 0, 0),
					nil, 6, true, false, true)

			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
				self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

				return
			end

			character_util.set_direction(self.little_princess, 'down')

			character_util.move_to_async(self.little_knight, self.little_knight.Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5),
					nil, 6, true, false, true)

			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
				self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

				return
			end
		else
			character_util.move_to_async(self.little_knight, self.little_knight.Position + vector(0, 0, 2.5),
					nil, 6, true, false, true)

			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
				self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

				return
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
		self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

		return
	end

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.little_knight.Position, user_party.Leader.Position) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	end

	character_util.look_at(self.little_princess, user_party_leader)
	character_util.jump(self.little_princess, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.little_princess)

	character_util.look_at(self.little_knight, user_party_leader)
	character_util.jump(self.little_knight, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.little_knight, { name = 'scared' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
		self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

		return
	end

	character_util.shake(self.little_knight, 0.04, 9999)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
		self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

		return
	end

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.little_knight.Position, user_party.Leader.Position) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.little_princess, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.little_knight, 0, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event then
		self:interrupt_princess_guardian_event()

		return
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.little_knight, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.release_hold_object(self.little_knight, self.little_princess)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.little_princess.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	character_util.set_position(self.little_princess, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

-- 로레인 까딱거리는 연출
function local_class:lorain_head_shake(magnitude, duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gell_fall_down_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local start_angle = 0
	local end_angle = -magnitude / 2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration / 4 do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (duration / 4)
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_angle))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, end_angle))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	start_angle = -magnitude / 2
	end_angle = magnitude / 2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration / 2 do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (duration / 2)
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_angle))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, end_angle))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	start_angle = magnitude / 2
	end_angle = 0

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration / 4 do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (duration / 4)
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_angle))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, end_angle))
end

	self.get_dark_open_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_screen_darkness_curtain_dark_open') end

	self.current_event_step_state = self.event_step_state.step1

	self.enter_loop_zone = false

	self.sequence_func_table = { self.first_sequence, self.second_sequence, self.third_sequence }

	self.dark_closed_effect = nil

	self.blizzard_sfx = nil

	self.fire_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	local exit_fo = get_field_object(self.exit_fo_name)
	exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	exit_fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 3.25))

	self.get_dark_closed_effect()
	self.get_dark_open_effect()
	self.get_blink_effect()

	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
	music_player.StageIntroSfxHandleName = nil

		return

function local_class:exit()

		return

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	self:dispose_dark_closed()

	self:stop_sfx(self.blizzard_sfx, 0)
	self:stop_sfx(self.fire_sfx, 0)

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local exit_fo = get_field_object(self.exit_fo_name)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, exit_fo) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_exit, self))
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_event_step_state == self.event_step_state.step1 and e.Zone.Name == self.first_darkness_zone_name then
		self.current_event_step_state = self.event_step_state.step2
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blink_darkness_curtain, self))
		return true
	elseif self.current_event_step_state == self.event_step_state.step2 and e.Zone.Name == self.second_darkness_zone_name then

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.darkness_background, self))

-- 루프 이벤트 반복
function local_class:loop_event()
	local loop_end_marker_z = self.get_end_loop_marker().position.z
	local loop_start_marker_z = self.get_enter_loop_marker().position.z

	while self.enter_loop_zone do
		if user_party_leader.Position.z >= loop_end_marker_z then
			local diff_1 = user_party_leader.Position.z - loop_end_marker_z
			user_party_leader.Position = vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, user_party_leader.Position.y, loop_start_marker_z + diff_1)

			local diff_2 = self.get_princess().Position.z - loop_end_marker_z
			self.get_princess().Position = vector(self.get_princess().Position.x, self.get_princess().Position.y, loop_start_marker_z + diff_2)

			self.get_princess():OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		elseif user_party_leader.Position.z < loop_start_marker_z and self.current_event_step_state == self.event_step_state.step4 then

			local diff_1 = user_party_leader.Position.z - loop_start_marker_z
			user_party_leader.Position = vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, user_party_leader.Position.y, loop_end_marker_z + diff_1)

			local diff_2 = self.get_princess().Position.z - loop_start_marker_z
			self.get_princess().Position = vector(self.get_princess().Position.x, self.get_princess().Position.y, loop_end_marker_z + diff_2)

			self.get_princess():OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 걸은 거리 체크 하여 시퀀스 재생
function local_class:move_up_distance_check(target_distance)
	for cur_sequence_num = 1, #self.sequence_func_table do
		local routine_table = {}
		local leader_prev_z = user_party_leader.Position.z
		local total_moved_distance = 0

		while true do
			-- 전 프레임 기준 위로 이동한 거리
			local distance = user_party_leader.Position.z - leader_prev_z
			leader_prev_z = user_party_leader.Position.z

			-- 거리가 5이상(매 프레임 검사하고 move밖에 못하는 상황이라 1이상 넘어갈리가 없지만 여유롭게)일 경우 위치를 강제 이동시킨걸로 판단해서 체크하지 않는다.
			if distance < 5 then
				-- 전 프레임 위치 업데이트
				total_moved_distance = distance > 0 and total_moved_distance + distance or total_moved_distance

				if total_moved_distance >= target_distance then
					local routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sequence_func_table[cur_sequence_num], self))
					table.insert(routine_table, routine)
					break
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		coroutine_util.wait_coroutines(routine_table)
	end
end

-- 첫번째 시퀀스 연출
function local_class:first_sequence()
	local lorain_head = self.get_lorain_head()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	-- ...로레인.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'futurecastle_part2_s9_10', force_sfx = true })

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleMariaLisaSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_rock = function() return get_field_object('maria_lisa_rock') end
	self.get_mouse_bomb = function() return get_field_object('maria_lisa_mouse_bomb') end
	self.get_supplies = function(num) return get_field_object('maria_lisa_supplies_' .. num) end

	self.get_maria = function() return get_character('maria') end
	self.get_lisa = function() return get_character('lisa') end

	-- 4 ~ 21까지 사용
	self.get_refugee = function(num) return get_character('shelter_refugee_2_'.. num) end

	self.is_rock_blocking = false

	self.is_talk_run_once = false

	self.is_talk_running = false

	self.is_shelter_3_leaved = false

	self.star_piece_name = 'maria_lisa_star_piece'

	self.is_obj_following = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(151)
	if main_quest ~= nil and (main_quest.InnerProgress < 2 and not main_quest.IsComplete) then
		self.get_rock().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	else
		self.is_rock_blocking = true
		self.is_shelter_3_leaved = true
		self:after_earthquake()
	end
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.FullEnter then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'section_2_shelter_2' then
				if self.is_rock_blocking and not self.is_talk_run_once and not self.is_talk_running then
					self.is_talk_run_once = true
					self.is_talk_running = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_routine, self))
				end
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.FullLeave then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'section_2_shelter_3' then
				if not self.is_shelter_3_leaved then
					self.is_shelter_3_leaved = true
					self:after_earthquake()
				end
			end
		end

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_rock()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rock_destroyed, self))
		end

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if table_util.contain_value({
			self.get_lisa(),
			self.get_maria()
		}, e.Target) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_bros, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:after_earthquake()
	local maria = self.get_maria()
	local lisa = self.get_lisa()

	self.get_rock().ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	self.is_rock_blocking = true

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maria)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lisa)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(maria)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(lisa)

	character_util.set_direction(maria, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(lisa, 'right')

	character_util.set_anim(maria, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.set_emotion(maria, {name = 'tired'})

	character_util.set_emotion(lisa, {name = 'tired'})
end

function local_class:custom_hold_up(fo, target)

	character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = 'hold', loop = false, upper = true})

		target.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()

	local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(fo.Transform, '[GIMMICK]obstacle_ray')
	local renderer = mesh:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))

	local start_alpha = mesh_color.a
	local end_alpha = alpha

	local time_passed = 0


	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = (time_passed / duration)
		local color = mesh_color

		color.a = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, progress)
		material:SetColor("_TintColor", color)

		coroutine.yield()

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	-- obstacle door 이름
	self.obstacle_door_name = 'obstacle_'

	-- 감시 패턴 zone 이름
	self.pattern_zone_name = 'pattern_'

	-- 시작 zone 이름
	self.start_zone_name = 'cyborg_zone'

	-- 감시 패턴 끝나는 zone 이름
	self.pattern_end_zone_name = 'pattern_end'

	-- 진행도 처리
	self.event_progress = {
		start = 1,
		pattern_1 = 2,
		pattern_2 = 3,
		pattern_3 = 4,
		pattern_4 = 5,
		pattern_5 = 6,
		pattern_end = 7,
		lilith_talk = 8,
	}

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.start

	-- 감시를 피하고 있는 중인지
	self.pattern_playing = false

	-- 사이보그에게 걸려서 진행 불가능인지
	self.fail_playing = false

	-- 감시 거리
	self.sight_distance = 4

	-- 감시 각도
	self.sight_angle = 60

	-- 첫번째 연출을 봤는지
	self.saw_cyborg = false

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 순찰 사이보그 NPC 세팅
	local cyborg = get_character('crystal_cyborg')
	local start_pos = field:GetMarker('cyborg_start').position
	character_util.set_position(cyborg, start_pos)
	cyborg.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 전화 세팅

	local lilith = get_character('lilith')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(lilith, 0, 0)

	return true

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then
		return false
	end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.start_zone_name and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.start then
		if not self.saw_cyborg then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ready_cyborg, self)
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cyborg_pattern, self, 0))
		end
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.pattern_end_zone_name and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.pattern_end then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pattern_clear, self)
		return true
	else
		for i = 1, 5 do
			if zone_name == self.pattern_zone_name .. i and not self.pattern_playing and not self.fail_playing
					and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.start + i then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cyborg_pattern, self, i))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('crystal_cyborg')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			-- 전원이 다한 것 같다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_message_1', mintotalduration = 1.0 })
		end)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('phone')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lilith_talk, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then return false end

	local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name

	if self.pattern_playing then
		for i = 1, 5 do
			if grid_name == 'out_pattern_'..i and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.start + i then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset_cyborg, self, i))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

	if self.attack_range_renderer ~= nil then

-- 플레이어가 복도 이동시 로봇을 앞지르면 발동 되는 함수
function local_class:is_in_sight_corridor(fo, target)
	if direction_util.to_str(fo.Direction) == 'left' then
		if target.Position.x < fo.Position.x then return true else return false end
	elseif direction_util.to_str(fo.Direction) == 'right' then
		if target.Position.x > fo.Position.x then return true else return false end
	elseif direction_util.to_str(fo.Direction) == 'up' then
		if target.Position.z > fo.Position.z then return true else return false end
	elseif direction_util.to_str(fo.Direction) == 'down' then
		if target.Position.z < fo.Position.z then return true else return false end
	end
end

-- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크용 함수
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target)
	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	local full_diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center
	local diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > self.sight_distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > self.sight_angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	if field:IsAnythingBlocking(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(fo.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
			CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:pattern_end_if_player_already_in_room()
	if user_party.Leader.Position.z > (field:GetMarker('cyborg_pattern_end').position + 2.5 * unity_class.vector3.back).z then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pattern_clear, self)
	end
end

function local_class:open_pattern_doors(pattern_num)
	local tmp = {}
	local open_time = 0
	if pattern_num == 1 then
		tmp = { get_field_object('pattern_1_1'), get_field_object('pattern_1_2'), get_field_object('pattern_1_3'), get_field_object('pattern_1_4') }
	else
		tmp = { get_field_object('pattern_'..pattern_num..'_1'), get_field_object('pattern_'..pattern_num..'_2') }
	end
	if pattern_num == -1 then -- open all pattern doors instantly
		tmp = { get_field_object('pattern_1_1'), get_field_object('pattern_1_2'), get_field_object('pattern_1_3'), get_field_object('pattern_1_4') }
		for i=2,5 do
			table.insert(tmp, get_field_object('pattern_'..i..'_1'))
			table.insert(tmp, get_field_object('pattern_'..i..'_2'))
		end
		open_time = 0
	end
	for i=1, #tmp do
		local door = tmp[i]
		if pattern_num ~= -1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_interact_tower_02' })
		end
		--self:alpha_fade_3d_object(door, 0, open_time)
		local animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator:Play('on')
		wait_for_sec(0.8 * open_time)
		door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	for i=1, #tmp do

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_interact_tower_02' })

--[[ 3d 오브젝트 alpha fade
obstacle 기믹이 lab tileset 에 새로 on off 애니메이션 과 함께 추가 되면서 사용 하지 않게 됨
function local_class:alpha_fade_3d_object(fo, alpha, duration)
	local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(fo.Transform, '[gimmick]obstacle_ray_lab')
	local renderer = mesh:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))

	local material = renderer.material

	local mesh_color = material:GetColor("_TintColor")
	local start_alpha = mesh_color.a
	local end_alpha = alpha

	local time_passed = 0


	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = (time_passed / duration)
		local color = mesh_color

		color.a = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, progress)
		material:SetColor("_TintColor", color)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	mesh_color.a = end_alpha
	material:SetColor("_TintColor", mesh_color)
end
]]

--- OnInteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 거울 포탈 상호작용
	for mirror_index = 1, 2 do
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_mirror_portal(mirror_index)) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.move_mirror_portal, self, mirror_index)
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 테이블 상호작용
	for table_index = 1, 8 do
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_table(table_index)) then

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function(index)
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_turn_page_01')

				local start_index = self.item_data[index].narration_start_key_index
				local end_index = self.item_data[index].narration_end_key_index

				for key_index = start_index, end_index do
					if key_index == 25 or key_index == 26 or key_index == 30 then
						field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = game_string:Format(self.string_key .. key_index,
							user.Name), mintotalduration = 1 })
					else
						field_ui_util.show_narration_async(
							{ key = self.string_key .. key_index, mintotalduration = 1 })
					end
				end
			end, table_index)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- 거울 포탈 이동 연출
function local_class:move_mirror_portal(mirror_index)
	local in_mirror_index = mirror_index == 1 and 2 or 1

	party_util.align_to_target(self.get_mirror_portal(mirror_index), 'down', 1, 'linear')

	local in_waypoint = {
		self.get_mirror_start_pos(in_mirror_index) + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
		self.get_mirror_start_pos(in_mirror_index) + vector(0, 0, 1)
	}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		local cb = function(index)
			if index == 0 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_character_warp_01')
				self.get_reset_effect_pool():Instantiate(party_member.Position)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(party_member, 0, 0.2)
			end
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(party_member, in_waypoint, 4, false, nil, nil,
			nil, nil, nil, cb)
	end

	wait_for_sec(wp_util.get_duration(user_party[user_party.Count - 1].Position, in_waypoint, 4))

	-- 페이드 인 아웃 세팅
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	local out_start_pos = self.get_mirror_start_pos(mirror_index) + vector(0, 0, 1)

	local out_move_done = false

	-- 파티원들 세팅
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		local dist_party_member = CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers
		party_member.Position = out_start_pos + dist_party_member * i * vector(0, 0, 1)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(party_member, 1, 0)
		character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'disabled')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	local out_waypoint = {
		self.get_mirror_start_pos(mirror_index),
		self.get_mirror_end_pos(mirror_index)
	}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		local cb = function(index)
			if index == 0 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_character_warp_01')
				self.get_reset_effect_pool():Instantiate(party_member.Position - vector(0, 0, 0.5))
				character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'enabled')
			else
				out_move_done = true
			end
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(party_member, out_waypoint, 4, false, nil, nil,
			nil, nil, nil, cb)
	end

	while not out_move_done do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		character_util.stop(party_member)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
end

return local_class

		return true
	end

	-- 쥐 폭탄으로 들어왔을 때 비밀 방으로 이동
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_mouse_bomb(), self.change_secret_zone_name) then
		self.in_secret_map_mouse_bomb = true

		local dif = self.get_mouse_bomb().Position.z - self.get_change_origin_map_pos().z
		self.get_mouse_bomb().Position = self.get_change_secret_map_pos() + vector(0, 0, dif)
		stage_camera:ResetPositionWithOutGridMove()
		return true
	end

	-- 쥐 폭탄으로 들어왔을 때 원래 방으로 이동
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_mouse_bomb(), self.change_origin_zone_name) then
		local dif = self.get_mouse_bomb().Position.z - self.get_change_secret_map_pos().z
		self.get_mouse_bomb().Position = self.get_change_origin_map_pos() + vector(0, 0, dif)
		stage_camera:ResetPositionWithOutGridMove()
		return true
	end


	return false
end

--- ZoneLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and zone_name == self.event_zone_name then
		self.in_event_zone_leader = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- SwitchOnOffEvent
function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_mouse_bomb_switch()) and
		e.IsTurningOn and not self.is_appear_stair then

		self.is_appear_stair = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.appear_secret_stair, self))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_secret_stair()) then

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			quest_icon_util.remove(self.get_secret_stair())

			self.get_secret_stair().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_occult_library_34', mintotalduration = 1 })

			-- 오컬트 도서관 서브 스테이지 오픈
			stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
				substage_name = self.controller.unlock_stage_name
			})

			quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- DamageEvent
function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- 비밀 방에 있을 때만 쥐폭탄이 터지면 페이드 인아웃 처리
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, self.get_mouse_bomb()) and self.in_secret_map_mouse_bomb then

		self.in_secret_map_mouse_bomb = false

		self.stop_mouse_bomb = false

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

			wait_for_sec(1)

			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
			self.get_mouse_bomb().Position = self.mouse_bomb_pos

			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end)
	end

	return false
end

--- 리더가 이벤트 존 안에 있을 때
--- 존 안에서 7초 기다리면 이벤트 발생
function local_class:enter_event_zone_leader()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local wait_duration = 7
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < wait_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if not self.in_event_zone_leader then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.end_speech_event = false

	local speech_bubble_pos = self.get_event_speech_pos()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_die_ghost_01')
	-- 루시…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
		{ key = 'futurecastle_occult_library_1',
		  world_pos = speech_bubble_pos + vector(3, 0, 1) })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_die_ghost_01')
	-- 초코…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
		{ key = 'futurecastle_occult_library_2',
		  world_pos = speech_bubble_pos + vector(3, 0, -3) })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_die_ghost_01')
	-- 보고 싶어…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
		{ key = 'futurecastle_occult_library_3',
		  world_pos = speech_bubble_pos + vector(3, 0, -1) })

	self.end_speech_event = true
end

--- 쥐 폭탄으로 스위치를 눌러서 비밀 계단이 나오는 연출
function local_class:appear_secret_stair()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	self.stop_mouse_bomb = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		while self.stop_mouse_bomb do
			self.get_mouse_bomb().Position = self.get_mouse_bomb_switch().Position
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end))

	local secret_stair_pos = self.get_secret_map_stair_pos()
	if self.stop_mouse_bomb then
		camera_util.move(secret_stair_pos, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 폭발 이펙트 후 비밀 계단 생성
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_rock_break_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_gimmick_jingle_01')
	self.get_rock_destroy_effect_pool():Instantiate(secret_stair_pos)
	self.get_secret_stair().Position = secret_stair_pos
	wait_for_sec(2)

	if self.stop_mouse_bomb then
		camera_util.move(self.get_mouse_bomb().Position, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	self.get_secret_stair().Position = self.get_origin_map_stair_pos()

	quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(self.get_secret_stair())

	self.stop_mouse_bomb = false
end

return local_class

	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
