function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorClosedEvent), 'on_door_closed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	-- 초기 라나 세팅
	local start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.oni_girl_start_marker_name).position
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	oni_girl.Position = start_pos
	oni_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_immortal(oni_girl, true)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'up')

	-- 계단에 wall_invisible 배치하여 라나가 못 올라가도록 세팅
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local stair_blocking = get_field_object(self.stair_blocking_name .. i)
		local stair_blocking_pos = field:GetMarker(self.stair_blocking_marker_name .. i).position
		stair_blocking.Position = stair_blocking_pos
		stair_blocking.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	-- 라나가 폭탄을 들지 못하도록 세팅
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local oni_girl_bomb = get_field_object(self.oni_girl_bomb_name .. i)
		oni_girl_bomb.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	-- 라나가 미는 것을 못 하도록 세팅
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local oni_girl_pushable = get_field_object(self.oni_girl_pushable_name .. i)
		oni_girl_pushable.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	-- 경비병들 충돌 없도록
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local vending_machine_guard = get_character(self.vending_machine_guard_name .. i)
		vending_machine_guard.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.clear_door_name))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorClosedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.wheelchair_sfx ~= nil then
		self.wheelchair_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region Event

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return false
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)

	-- 라나가 자판기 앞 바위 충돌하는 이벤트 보는 존
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, self.oni_girl_crash_rock_zone_name) and
		self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.oni_girl_crash_rock_routine, self))
	end

	-- 가속타일 밟고 바위에 부딪혔을 때 이벤트
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, oni_girl, self.crashed_oni_girl_zone_name) and
		self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.hide_oni_girl then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress+ 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.crashed_oni_girl, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 감시자를 지나오고 다음 방으로 갈 때
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, oni_girl, self.pass_observer_zone_name) and
		self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.crashed_oni_girl then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		-- 경비병 세팅
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local vending_machine_guard_pos = field:GetMarker(self.vending_machine_guard_marker_name .. i).position
			local vending_machine_guard = get_character(self.vending_machine_guard_name .. i)
			vending_machine_guard.Position = vending_machine_guard_pos
			character_util.set_direction(vending_machine_guard, 'down')
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.guard_routine, self, vending_machine_guard, i))
		end

		return true
	end

	-- 퍼즐3 이벤트
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.pass_observer then
		for guard_index = 1, 2 do
			local vending_machine_guard = get_character(self.vending_machine_guard_name .. guard_index)
			for zone = 1, 2 do
				if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, vending_machine_guard, self.catch_guard_zone_name .. zone) then
					self.guard_in_catch_zone[guard_index][zone] = true
					return true
				end
			end
		end

		for zone = 1, 2 do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, oni_girl, self.catch_guard_zone_name .. zone) then
				self.leader_in_catch_zone[zone] = true
				return true
			end
		end

		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, oni_girl, self.end_puzzle_3_zone_name) then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

			for i = 1, 5 do
				local vending_machine_rock = get_field_object(self.vending_machine_rock_name .. i)
				vending_machine_rock.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				vending_machine_rock.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:Heal(10000, false)
			end

			local origin_leader_pos = field:GetMarker(self.vending_machine_origin_leader_marker_name).position
			user_party_leader.Position = origin_leader_pos
			character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')

			for i = 1, 2 do
				local vending_machine_guard = get_character(self.vending_machine_guard_name .. i)
				vending_machine_guard.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	-- 다시 자판기 앞으로 왔을 때
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, oni_girl, self.vending_machine_zone_name) and
		self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.pass_guard and not self.in_vending_machine_zone then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		self.in_vending_machine_zone = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			local duration = 3
			local time_passed = 0

			while time_passed < duration and self.in_vending_machine_zone do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if not self.in_vending_machine_zone then
				return
			end

			self.clear_vending_machine_puzzle = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.return_origin_leader, self))
		end))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)

	-- 퍼즐3 잡히는 존 체크
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.pass_observer then
		for guard_index = 1, 2 do
			local vending_machine_guard = get_character(self.vending_machine_guard_name .. guard_index)
			for zone = 1, 2 do
				if zone_name == self.catch_guard_zone_name .. zone and
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, vending_machine_guard) then

					self.guard_in_catch_zone[guard_index][zone] = false

					return true
				end
			end
		end

		for zone = 1, 2 do
			if zone_name == self.catch_guard_zone_name .. zone and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, oni_girl) then

				self.leader_in_catch_zone[zone] = false

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	-- 플레이어 라나로 자판기 존 안에 체크
	if zone_name == self.vending_machine_zone_name and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, oni_girl) and
		self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.return_leader and not self.clear_vending_machine_puzzle then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress - 1

		self.in_vending_machine_zone = false

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- FieldObjectDestroyedEvent
function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 라나가 충돌하고 있는 바위가 파괴됐을 때
	local vending_machine_rock = get_field_object(self.vending_machine_rock_name .. 1)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, vending_machine_rock) and
		self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.oni_girl_crash_rock then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		self.is_destroyed_puzzle_1_rock = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reminisce_oni_girl, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- CustomStageEvent
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- 지정한 존 밖으로 나가서 괴롭히는 npc 또는 경비병이 리셋될 때
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'return_to_base_pos' then
		-- 괴롭히는 npc
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.reminiscence_oni_girl then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hide_oni_girl, self)
			return true
		end

		-- 경비병
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.pass_observer then
			for i = 1, 2 do
				if self.is_chasing_guard[i] then
					self.is_chasing_guard[i] = false
					local vending_machine_guard = get_character(self.vending_machine_guard_name .. i)

					-- 현재 배틀 강제 종료
					stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

					character_util.convert_to_npc(vending_machine_guard)
					character_util.stop(vending_machine_guard)
				end
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 라나일 때 공격 키 눌렀을 때
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'start_oni_girl_aggro' then
		local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
		-- 라이트닝 카운터~!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(oni_girl, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_38', bubble_type = 'shout' })
		return true
	end

	-- 괴롭히는 npc 또는 경비병한테 잡혔을 때
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'caught_target' then
		-- 괴롭히는 npc
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.reminiscence_oni_girl and not self.is_playing_reset_bully then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.reset_run_away_bully, self)
			return true
		end

		-- 경비병
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.pass_observer and not self.is_playing_reset_puzzle_3 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.reset_puzzle_3, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- SwitchOnOffEvent
function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Stepper, oni_girl) or not e.IsTurningOn then return false end

	-- 퍼즐3에서 스위치 눌러서 문 열었을 때 플래그 변경
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.pass_observer then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local puzzle_3_switch = get_field_object(self.puzzle_3_switch_name .. i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, puzzle_3_switch) then
				for j = 1, 2 do
					self.is_door_closed[i][j] = false
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- DoorClosedEvent
function local_class:on_door_closed_event(e)
	-- 퍼즐3에서 문이 닫혔을 때
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.pass_observer then
		for zone = 1, 2 do
			for door_index = 1, 2 do
				if e.DoorHandleName == self.puzzle_3_door_name .. zone .. '_' .. door_index then
					self.is_door_closed[zone][door_index] = true

					self:check_puzzle_3_zone(zone)

					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	-- 라나가 계단 상호작용 했을 때
	if string.find(e.Target.Name, self.stair_blocking_name) then
		-- … 아무래도 계단은 좀 힘드네.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(oni_girl, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_39', skip = true })
		return true
	end

	-- 라나가 폭탄 상호작용 했을 때
	if string.find(e.Target.Name, self.oni_girl_bomb_name) or string.find(e.Target.Name, self.leader_throw_bomb_name) then
		-- … 아무래도 무거운 건 좀 힘드네.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(oni_girl,
			{ key = { 'futurecastle_oni_girl_57', user.Name }, skip = true })
		return true
	end

	-- 라나가 pushable 상호작용 했을 때
	if string.find(e.Target.Name, self.oni_girl_pushable_name) then
		-- … 아무래도 미는 건 좀 힘드네.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(oni_girl, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_58', skip = true })
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 라나가 바위에 계속 몸통박치기하는 루틴
function local_class:oni_girl_crash_rock_routine()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_japangi_01')

	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	local start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.oni_girl_start_marker_name).position
	local speed = 3
	local target = get_field_object(self.vending_machine_rock_name .. 1)
	local target_position = target.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5)

	camera_util.move_async(oni_girl.Position, 1)

	local is_show_event = false

	-- 부셔져! 부셔지란 말이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_1', skip = true })

	-- 자판기 앞 바위가 파괴됐는지
	self.is_destroyed_crashing_rock = false

	while not self.is_destroyed_puzzle_1_rock do
		if self.is_destroyed_crashing_rock then
			return
		end

		-- 라나 몸통박치기
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl,
			target_position, speed)

		if self.is_destroyed_crashing_rock then
			return
		end

		-- 라나 바위에 충돌 연출
		self:oni_girl_crash_routine(vector(0, 0, -1), vector(0, 1, -0.5))

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if self.is_destroyed_crashing_rock then
			return
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl,
			target_position, speed)

		if self.is_destroyed_crashing_rock then
			return
		end

		self:oni_girl_crash_routine(vector(0, 0, -1), vector(0, 1, -0.5))

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if self.is_destroyed_crashing_rock then
			return
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl, start_pos, speed)

		if self.is_destroyed_crashing_rock then
			return
		end

		character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'up')

		-- 라나가 바위에 충돌하는 이벤트를 처음 봤을 때만
		if not is_show_event then
			camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

			field_ui_manager:Show()
			party_util.reset_controllers()

			is_show_event = true
		end
	end
end

--- 배경 이동 루틴
function local_class:move_background_process()
	local obj_distance = vector(64, 0, 0)

	local background_instance_pos = field:GetMarker(self.background_instance_marker_name).position

	local current_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.background_loop_preset_name):Instantiate(background_instance_pos)

	local next_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.background_loop_preset_name):Instantiate(
		background_instance_pos + obj_distance)

	local time_passed = 0

	while true do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		current_obj.transform.position = current_obj.transform.position - dt * vector(self.loop_time_move_speed, 0, 0)
		next_obj.transform.position = current_obj.transform.position + obj_distance

		if self.end_move_background then
			current_obj:Dispose()
			next_obj:Dispose()
			break
		end

		if time_passed > (obj_distance.x / self.loop_time_move_speed) and not self.end_move_background then

			current_obj.transform.position = current_obj.transform.position + obj_distance

			local temp
			temp = current_obj
			current_obj = next_obj
			next_obj = temp

			time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 대사가 끝났을 때 루프 종료 후 연출

	-- 카메라가 점점 라나한테 가는 루틴
	self.is_rock_throw_real_position = true

	local oni_girl_bully_end_pos = field:GetMarker(self.oni_girl_bully_end_marker_name).position

	-- 괴롭히는 npc들 이동
	local oni_girl_bullies = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local oni_girl_bully = get_character(self.oni_girl_bully_name .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl_bully)
		oni_girl_bully.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
		character_util.set_active_shadow(oni_girl_bully, true)
		oni_girl_bully.Position = vector(oni_girl_bully_end_pos.x, 0, oni_girl_bully.Position.z)

--- 감시자 행동 루틴
function local_class:observe_routine(fo)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_near_observer, self))

	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)

	self.stop_observing = false

	while not self.stop_observing do
		local attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(fo, self.observer_sight_distance, self.observer_sight_angle)
		attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)
		attack_range_renderer:Update(fo)

		while true do
			-- 감시에 걸렸을 때
			if self:is_in_sight(fo, oni_girl, self.observer_sight_distance, self.observer_sight_angle) then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		attack_range_renderer:Dispose()

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_lana', state = 'event' })

		-- 거기 너 임마 빨간 거 멈춰!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', parent = fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_die_goblin_01', parent = fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fo, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_29', bubble_type = 'shout' })

		local save_leader_pos = oni_girl.Position

		-- 스위치 위치까지 이동 웨이포인트
		local observer_waypoints = {
			fo.Position,
			fo.Position + vector(0, 0, -3)
		}

		-- 돌아오는 이동 웨이프인트
		local observer_reverse_waypoints_1 = {}

		for _, v in pairs(observer_waypoints) do
			table.insert(observer_reverse_waypoints_1, 1, v)
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, observer_waypoints, 4)

		if self.stop_observing then
			return
		end

		-- npc가 스위치 밟음
		local puzzle_2_switch = get_field_object(self.puzzle_2_switch_name)
		message_system:SendSync(puzzle_2_switch, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(fo))

		observer_waypoints = {
			fo.Position,
			fo.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
			fo.Position + vector(-2, -1, -1.5),
			save_leader_pos
		}

		-- 돌아오는 이동 웨이프인트
		local observer_reverse_waypoints_2 = {}

		for _, v in pairs(observer_waypoints) do
			table.insert(observer_reverse_waypoints_2, 1, v)
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, observer_waypoints, 4)

		if self.stop_observing then
			return
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		if self.stop_observing then
			return
		end

		-- 돌아가는 감시자
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, observer_reverse_waypoints_2, 4)

		if self.stop_observing then
			return
		end

		-- npc가 스위치 밟음
		message_system:SendSync(puzzle_2_switch, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(fo))

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, observer_reverse_waypoints_1, 4)

		if self.stop_observing then
			return
		end

		character_util.set_direction(fo, 'left')
	end
end

--- 감시자 주변 플레이어 체크
function local_class:check_near_observer()
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	local observer = get_character(self.observer_name)

	self.stop_check_observer = false

	while not self.stop_check_observer do

		if (oni_girl.Position - observer.Position).sqrMagnitude < 0.5 then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	self.stop_observing = true
	character_util.stop(observer)
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'scared' })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 감시자 세팅
	local observer_start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.observer_start_marker_name).position
	observer.Position = observer_start_pos
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(observer)
	character_util.set_direction(observer, 'left')

	local observer_reset_pos = field:GetMarker(self.observer_reset_marker_name).position
	oni_girl.Position = observer_reset_pos
	character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.observe_routine, self, observer))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

--- 경비병들 감시 루틴
function local_class:guard_routine(fo, guard_index)
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)

	local guard_start_pos = fo.Position

	self.is_chasing_guard[guard_index] = false
	self.is_caught_guard[guard_index] = false

	while true do
		self.puzzle_3_reset = false

		local attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(fo, self.guard_sight_distance, self.guard_sight_angle)
		attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)

		while true do
			-- 라나가 어그로 상태일 때 감시에 걸렸을 때
			if self:is_in_sight(fo, oni_girl, self.guard_sight_distance, self.guard_sight_angle) then
				character_util.convert_to_monster(fo)
				command_util.execute_monster_notice(fo, oni_girl, 'battle')
				self.is_chasing_guard[guard_index] = true
				break
			end

			attack_range_renderer:Update(fo)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		attack_range_renderer:Dispose()

		while self.is_chasing_guard[guard_index] do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.is_caught_guard[guard_index] then
			return
		end

		if not self.puzzle_3_reset then
			self:path_finder(fo, guard_start_pos, 'down')
		else
			while self.is_playing_reset_puzzle_3 do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 퍼즐3 존 안에 체크
function local_class:check_puzzle_3_zone(zone_index)
	-- 하나라도 열려있으면 체크 종료
	for door_index = 1, 2 do
		if not self.is_door_closed[zone_index][door_index] then return end
	end

	-- 플레이어가 갇히면 리셋
	if self.leader_in_catch_zone[zone_index] and not self.is_playing_reset_puzzle_3 then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.reset_puzzle_3, self)
		return
	end

	local convert_to_npc_guards = {}
	local chasing_guards = {}

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local vending_machine_guard = get_character(self.vending_machine_guard_name .. i)

		-- 추격중인 경비병
		if self.is_chasing_guard[i] then
			table.insert(chasing_guards, vending_machine_guard)
		end

		-- 잡힌 경비병
		if self.guard_in_catch_zone[i][zone_index] then
			self.is_caught_guard[i] = true
			self.is_chasing_guard[i] = false
			table.insert(convert_to_npc_guards, vending_machine_guard)
		end
	end

	-- 추격중인 경비병이 있으면 배틀 강제 종료
	if #chasing_guards <= #convert_to_npc_guards then
		-- 현재 배틀 강제 종료
		stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()
	end

	for _, v in pairs(convert_to_npc_guards) do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(v)
		character_util.stop(v)
	end

	-- 스위치 변경
	if #convert_to_npc_guards > 0 then
		local puzzle_3_switch = get_field_object(self.puzzle_3_switch_name .. zone_index)
		local puzzle_3_clear_switch = get_field_object(self.puzzle_3_clear_switch_name .. zone_index)
		puzzle_3_clear_switch.Position = puzzle_3_switch.Position
		puzzle_3_switch.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end
end

--- 플레이어가 갇히거나 잡혔을 때 리셋
function local_class:reset_puzzle_3()
	self.is_playing_reset_puzzle_3 = true
	self.puzzle_3_reset = true

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'scared' })

	-- 현재 배틀 강제 종료
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	for i = 1, 2 do
		if not self.is_caught_guard[i] then

			local vending_machine_guard = get_character(self.vending_machine_guard_name .. i)

			self.is_chasing_guard[i] = false
			for zone = 1, 2 do
				self.guard_in_catch_zone[i][zone] = false
			end

			character_util.convert_to_npc(vending_machine_guard)
			character_util.stop(vending_machine_guard)
		end
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i = 1, 2 do
		if not self.is_caught_guard[i] then
			local vending_machine_guard = get_character(self.vending_machine_guard_name .. i)
			local vending_machine_guard_pos = field:GetMarker(self.vending_machine_guard_marker_name .. i).position

			vending_machine_guard.Position = vending_machine_guard_pos
			character_util.set_direction(vending_machine_guard, 'down')
		end

	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl)
	local oni_girl_reset_pos = field:GetMarker(self.puzzle_3_reset_marker_name).position
	oni_girl.Position = oni_girl_reset_pos
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'up')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.is_playing_reset_puzzle_3 = false
end

function local_class:return_origin_leader()
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	local cured_oni_girl = get_character(self.cured_oni_girl_name)

	local origin_leader_waypoints = {
		user_party_leader.Position + vector(4, 0, 0),
		user_party_leader.Position + vector(6, 1, 0),
		user_party_leader.Position + vector(9, 1, 0),
		user_party_leader.Position + vector(9, 1, -0.8)-- -1
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party_leader, origin_leader_waypoints, 4)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local leader_throw_bomb = get_field_object(self.leader_throw_bomb_name)
	command_util.execute_holdup(user_party_leader, leader_throw_bomb, user_party_leader.Position)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	command_util.execute_throw(user_party_leader, leader_throw_bomb,
		vector(1, 0, 0), user_party_leader.Position, 11, true)--22

	leader_throw_bomb.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	wait_for_sec(3)

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 페이드 인 아웃 세팅
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_shield_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	-- 라나가 폭탄을 들지 못하도록 세팅
	for i = 6, 7 do
		local oni_girl_bomb = get_field_object(self.oni_girl_bomb_name .. i)
		oni_girl_bomb.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	-- 자판기 주변 바위들 제거

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(oni_girl)
end

--- 경로 찾기
function local_class:path_finder(fo, pos, last_dir)
	local plan_path_done = false
	local plan_path

	field.PathFinder:FindNormalPath(fo, pos, 100, fo, 0, nil, function(path, req_key)
		if req_key == 0 then
			plan_path_done = true
			plan_path = path
		end
	end)

	while not plan_path_done do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 해당 지점으로 이동하는 경로
	local go_waypoints = {}

	for i = 0, plan_path.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(go_waypoints, plan_path[i])
	end

	-- 해당 위치로 이동
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, go_waypoints, 5,
		nil, nil, nil, last_dir)
end

--- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target, distance, angle)
	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	local full_diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center
	local diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	if field:IsAnythingBlockingWithoutBounds(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(fo.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
		CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 서비스센터에 전화
function local_class:call_service_center()
	local service_call = self.get_service_table()

	party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member(
			service_call.Position, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_broadcast_01')
	-- 만능약 고객 서비스 센터입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(service_call, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_pre_1', skip = true })

	-- 방문 목적이 어떻게 되십니까?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(service_call, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_pre_2', skip = true })

	local wait = true
	local pass = false
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	local lana_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(155)

	-- 라나 이벤트를 클리어하지 않은 경우 진행이 불가능하다.
	if lana_quest ~= nil and lana_quest.IsComplete then
		-- 불량품을 보고한다.
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('futurecastle_oni_girl_2_pre_3'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				pass = true
				wait = false
			end })
	end
	-- 그만둔다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('futurecastle_oni_girl_2_pre_4'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if pass ~= true then
		return
	end

	-- 교환 / 환불 코드를 입력해 주십시오.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(service_call, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_pre_5', skip = true })

	-- 비밀번호 입력
	local is_correct = true

	for i = 1, #self.password_table do
		local choose_result = nil
		if self.password_table[i] < 5 then
			choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
					{ { '0', 'normal' }, { '1', 'normal' }, { '2', 'normal' }, { '3', 'normal' },
					  { '4', 'normal' }, { '5', 'normal' } })

			if choose_result ~= self.password_table[i] + 1 then
				is_correct = false
				break
			end
		else
			choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
					{ { '4', 'normal' }, { '5', 'normal' }, { '6', 'normal' }, { '7', 'normal' },
					  { '8', 'normal' }, { '9', 'normal' } })

			if choose_result ~= self.password_table[i] - 3 then
				is_correct = false
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if is_correct == false then
		-- 잘못된 코드입니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(service_call, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_pre_6', skip = true })
		-- 확인 후 다시 입력해 주시기 바랍니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(service_call, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_pre_7', skip = true })
		return
	end

	-- 상품 불량 코드가 정상 접수되었습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(service_call, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_pre_8', skip = true })

	-- 고객 대응을 위해 공장 입장을 허용합니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(service_call, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_pre_9', skip = true })

	-- 포션 제조 공장에 대한 정보를 얻었다.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = self.controller.unlock_stage_name,
		substage_open_string_key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_pre_10'
	})

	-- 스테이지의 라나 비활성화
	local lana = get_character('lana')
	character_util.set_position(lana, vector(999, 0, 999))

	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region OnEvent

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return false
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'section1_entrance_1') and not self.entrance[1] then
		self.entrance[1] = true
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character('entrance_android_1'),
				{ key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_entrance_android_1_1' })

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'section1_entrance_2') and not self.entrance[2] then
		self.entrance[2] = true
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character('entrance_android_3'),
				{ key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_entrance_android_1_3' })

		return true

	-- 처음 입장시 안내 안드로이드와 대화
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'section1_meet_worker') and
		self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.meet_worker

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_android_worker, self)
		return true
	-- 포션 공장 견학
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'section1_excursion') and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.meet_worker then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.excursion

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.android_excursion, self)
		return true

	elseif (type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'section1_meet_worker_1') or
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'section2_meet_knight')) and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.guide_worker_1_end then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.guide_worker_2_start

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.android_guide_2, self))
		return true

	elseif (type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'section1_meet_worker_2') or
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'section2_meet_knight')) and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.guide_worker_2_end then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.guide_worker_3_start

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.android_guide_3, self))
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'section1_accident') and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.guide_worker_3_end then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.accident

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.invader_invade, self)
		return true

	end

	return false
end

--- BattleGroupEliminatedEvent
function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'section1_invader_battle' then
		--- disable control 상태 유지해야하기 때문에 play_normal_screenplay 를 사용하지 않는다.
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.got_accident, self))
		return true
	end
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local table = get_field_object('carry_table_' .. i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, table) then
			local carry = get_character('carry_android_' .. i)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(carry, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_carry_1_' .. i })
		end
	end

	return false
end


--endregion

-- 초기 세팅
function local_class:set_environment()
	-- 주인공 빼고 없애기
	while user_party.Count ~= 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[1], vector(99, 0, 99))
		character_util.convert_to_npc(user_party[1])
	end

	-- 길막는 안드로이드
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local rest = get_character('blocking_android_' .. i)
		character_util.set_with_marker(rest, field:GetMarker(rest.Name))
	end

	-- 쉬고있는 안드로이드
	local anim = {'seat', 'seat', 'seat'}
	local emo = {'tired', 'smile', 'doyagao'}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local rest = get_character('resting_android_' .. i)
		character_util.set_with_marker(rest, field:GetMarker('resting_android_1_' .. i))
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(rest, {name = anim[i]}, {name = emo[i]})
		rest.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_rest_1_' .. i
	end

	-- 입구 안드로이드
	local anim = {'cross_arm', 'cast', 'idle', 'cross_arm', 'idle', 'idle'}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local android = get_character('entrance_android_' .. i)
		character_util.set_anim(android, {name = anim[i]})
		android.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_entrance_android_1_' .. i
	end

	-- 안내원 안드로이드
	local worker = get_character('android_worker')
	worker.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_with_marker(worker, field:GetMarker(worker.Name))

	--- 포션 공장
	-- 일하는 안드로이드
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local android = get_character('working_android_' .. i)
		character_util.set_with_marker(android, field:GetMarker(android.Name))
	end

	for i = 1, 7 do
		self.controller:work_conveyor_belt('conveyor_belt_factory_' .. i, true)
	end

	self.controller.factory_on = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.factorio, self.controller))
	--- 포션 공장

	-- 집배원 안드로이드
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local carry = get_character('carry_android_' .. i)
		character_util.set_with_marker(carry, field:GetMarker(carry.Name))
		carry.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_carry_1_' .. i

		local table = get_field_object('carry_table_' .. i)
		table.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	-- 위에서 보는 라나
	local lana = get_character('onigirl')
	character_util.set_with_marker(lana, field:GetMarker('onigirl_up'))
	character_util.spine_rotate(lana, -30, 0)

	--미리 배틀게이트로 길 막아놓기
	for i = 1, 2 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('battle_gate_' .. i))
	end
end

function local_class:meet_android_worker()
	local worker = get_character('android_worker')
	party_util.align_to_target(worker.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), worker.Direction, 1, 'arc')

	character_util.play_speech_action(worker, {name = 'nod', scale = 0.5}, {name = 'sleep_deep'},
			{key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_1', skip = true})
	--부유성 포션 제조 공장에 오신 걸 환영합니다.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_2', skip = true})
	--방문 목적을 알려주시겠습니까?

	choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{{'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_3'}})
	--포션이 효과가 없었다.

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

	character_util.set_anim(worker, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4', skip = true})
	--그럴리 없습니다.
	character_util.remove_anim(worker)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_1', skip = true})
	--부유성의 포션은 엄격한 품질 관리를 통해 납품됩니다.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(worker, {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'mad'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_2', skip = true})
	--혹시 죽은 사람에게 사용한 것은 아니겠죠?

	choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{{'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_3'}})
	--자판기 포션의 유통기한이 지나있었다.

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(worker)

	character_util.normal_double_jump(user_party_leader, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_anim(worker, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_3_1', skip = true})
	--… 아직도 자판기가 남아있었다고요?

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(worker, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_4', skip = true})
	--일부러 자판기를 찾아내 클레임을 걸다니… 제가 가디언을 쉽게 봤군요.
	character_util.remove_anim(worker)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_4_1', skip = true})

	character_util.set_anim(worker, {name = 'question', loop = false})

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(worker, nil, 'silence')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_5', skip = true})
	--알겠습니다. 특별히 포션을 지급해드리죠.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	character_util.set_anim(worker, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_6', skip = true})
	--대신, 이번만입니다. 두 번은 없어요. 가장 진상인 가디언.
	character_util.remove_anim(worker)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2})

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(worker, worker.Position + vector(-10, 0, 0), 3, false)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_with_marker(worker, field:GetMarker('android_worker_2'))

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('lana_2', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, worker)
end

function local_class:android_excursion()
	local worker = get_character('android_worker')
	party_util.align_to_target(worker, worker.Direction, 1, 'arc')

	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 3), 1)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_7', skip = true})

	--한치의 오차도 없이 엄격한 공정을 준수하며 포션을 만들고 있습니다.

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_9', skip = true})
	--지난 500년간 단 한번도 불량품이 나온 적이 없었죠.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_10', skip = true})
	--당신처럼 일부러 인베이더 지역까지 가서 자판기를 찾고…

	character_util.set_anim(worker, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_11', skip = true})
	--유통 기한 지난 약을 찾아오지 않는 한 말이죠.
	character_util.remove_anim(worker)

	local ans = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{{'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_12', 'intellect'}, {'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_13', 'brutal'}})
	--그래서 포션은?
	--소비자 보호원에 신고하겠다.

	if ans == 1 then
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'doyagao'})

	else
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'mad'})
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_13_1', skip = true})
	--좀 더 인내심을 갖는 것이 좋겠습니다, 가디언.

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(worker, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.set_direction(worker, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_14', skip = true})
	--… 따라오시죠. 만능약 생산 라인은 이 앞입니다.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_4_15', skip = true})
	--이거면 당신 친구도 다리가 나을 수 있을 거예요.

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.guide_worker_1_start
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.android_guide_1, self))
end

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(worker, worker.Position + vector(-1, 1, 0), stair_speed, false)
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(worker, worker.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0), walk_speed, false)

function local_class:invader_invade()
	local worker = get_character('android_worker')
	local leader = user_party_leader

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_04')
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 2.5)

	camera_util.move(worker.Position, 1)

	party_util.align_to_target(worker, 'right', 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.stop(worker)
	character_util.set_direction(worker, 'right')

	for i = 1, 2 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
		local pos = field:GetMarker('s1_stone_' .. i).position + vector(-0.5, 0, -3)
		local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cp11_rock_landslide_purple'):Instantiate(pos)
		effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_7_0', skip = true})
	--… 오늘따라 유달리 흔들리는 군요.

	local ans = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{{'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_7_0_1', 'intellect'}, {'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s1_7_0_2', 'brutal'}})
	--여기 정말 괜찮은 거야?
	--공장이 무너지려고 하는데?

	if ans == 1 then
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	else
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleOniGirl2Section2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastleOniGirl @
		Comment = 포션을 찾기위해 공장에 입장한 기사 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.section_progress = {
		-- 초기값
		none = 0,
		-- 오프닝
		opening = 1,
		-- 기사를 지켜봄
		watching = 2,
		-- 기사를 만남 + 물약 안내 받음
		meet_knight = 3,
		-- 남은 재료로 물약공장 가동
		make_potion = 4,
		-- 물약이 하나 밖에 안남아서 기사 줌
		give_potion = 5
	}

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none

	self.get_lana = function()
		return get_character('onigirl')
	end

	self.get_first_switch = function()
		return get_field_object('belt_1_switch')
	end

	self.twinkle_effect = nil
	self.stone_twinkle_effect = nil
	self.desk_twinkle_effect = nil

	self.door_switch_1_on = false

	self.do_disaster = false
	self.do_falling_stone = true

	self.swipe_type = nil

	self.entrance = {false, false}
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return
	end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.opening, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	if self.stone_twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.stone_twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.stone_twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	if self.desk_twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.desk_twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.desk_twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	self.controller.do_siren = false

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region OnEvent

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return false
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'section1_entrance_1') and not self.entrance[1] then
		self.entrance[1] = true
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character('entrance_android_1'),
				{ key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_entrance_android_2_1' })

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'section1_entrance_2') and not self.entrance[2] then
		self.entrance[2] = true
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character('entrance_android_3'),
				{ key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_entrance_android_2_3' })

		return true
		-- 단차 위에서 기사를 바라봄
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'section2_lana') and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.opening then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.watching
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.saw_knight, self)

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'safe_zone') then
		self.do_falling_stone = false
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'safe_zone') then
		self.do_falling_stone = true
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local lana = self.get_lana()

	local book = get_field_object('access_record_book')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, book) then
		if self.desk_twinkle_effect ~= nil then
			self.desk_twinkle_effect:Dispose()
			self.desk_twinkle_effect = nil
		end

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function ()

			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_book'})
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(lana, nil, 'question')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lana, {key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_s2_0_5', skip = true})
			--포션 공장…?

		end)

		return true
	 --쓰러진 주인공 대화
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, user_party_leader) and
		self.current_progress == self.section_progress.watching then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.meet_knight
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.rescue_knight, self)

		return true

		-- 라나가 폭탄 상호작용
	elseif string.find(e.Target.Name, 'oni_girl_bomb_') then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(lana, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_bomb', skip = true })
		return true
	elseif string.find(e.Target.Name, 'stair_blocking_') then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(lana, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_stair', skip = true })
		return true
	elseif string.find(e.Target.Name, 'small_rock') then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(lana, { key = { 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_rock', user.Name }, skip = true })
		return true
	elseif string.find(e.Target.Name, 'push') then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(lana, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_push', skip = true })
		return true
	else
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local table = get_field_object('carry_table_' .. i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, table) then
				local carry = get_character('carry_android_' .. i)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(carry, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_carry_2_' .. i })
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- CustomStageEvent
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- 라나일 때 공격 키 눌렀을 때
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'start_oni_girl_aggro' then
		local lana = self.get_lana()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(lana, { key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_38', bubble_type = 'shout' })
		-- 라이트닝 카운터~!

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- SwitchOnOffEvent
function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local switch_name = e.SwitchObject.Name
	if switch_name == self.get_first_switch().Name then
		if e.IsTurningOn then
			if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
				self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
				self.twinkle_effect = nil
			end
		elseif not self.door_switch_1_on then
			self.twinkle_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle'):Instantiate(self.get_first_switch().Position)
		end
	elseif switch_name == 'door_switch_1' and e.IsTurningOn then
		self.door_switch_1_on = true
	elseif switch_name == 's2_potion_switch_1' and e.IsTurningOn and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.meet_knight then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.make_potion
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.make_potion_1, self)
	elseif switch_name == 's2_potion_switch_2' and e.IsTurningOn then
		if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.make_potion then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.give_potion
			self.do_disaster = false
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.make_potion_2, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function ()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_prepare_01')
				camera_util.shake(0.05, 2)
				wait_for_sec(3)
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_oni_girl_2_potion_narration_2'})
			end)
		end
	end
end

			self.stone_twinkle_effect:Dispose()
			self.stone_twinkle_effect = nil

function local_class:disaster()

	while self.do_disaster do
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)

		if rand % 4 == 0 then
			camera_util.shake(0.15, 1)
			wait_for_sec(1)
		elseif self.do_falling_stone then
			local rand_cnt = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
			for _ = 1, rand_cnt do
				local rand_x = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(-4, 4))
				local rand_z = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(-4, 4))
				local rand_scale = unity_class.random.Range(0.3, 1)
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_02', type_priority = 'Default', player_priority = 'default' })
				local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cp11_rock_landslide_purple')
												:Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z))
				effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * rand_scale
				wait_for_sec(0.4)
				camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.15)
			end
		end

		local rand_additional_time = unity_class.random.Range(0.3, 2)
		wait_for_sec(2 + rand_additional_time)
	end
end

function local_class:qte_swipe(type)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)

	self.swipe_type = ''
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	while self.swipe_type ~= type do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleOniGirl2Section3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastleOniGirl @
		Comment = 열쇠를 주는 라나
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_lana = function()
		return get_character('onigirl')
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.next_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.next_stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.next_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.subtitle = nil

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_lana(), self.controller)
end

--region OnEvent

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.next_stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_lana()) then
		-- 중간에 UI 켜지는것 방지하기 위해 이렇게 사용
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reunite_lana, self, false))
	end

	return false
end

--- CustomStageEvent
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == 'ready_for_race' then
		-- 중간에 UI 켜지는것 방지하기 위해 이렇게 사용
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reunite_lana, self, true))
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

	local lana = self.get_lana()

function local_class:check_race()
	local leader = user_party_leader
	local lana = self.get_lana()
	local start_pos = field:GetMarker('race_knight_start').position

	local speed_check_func = {
		function ()
			return (self.lana_speed_min + self.lana_speed_max) / 2 + (leader.Position.x - lana.Position.x) / 3
		end,
		function ()
			return (self.lana_speed_min + self.lana_speed_max) / 2 + (leader.Position.z - lana.Position.z) / 3
		end,
		function ()
			return (self.lana_speed_min + self.lana_speed_max) / 2 + (lana.Position.z - leader.Position.z) / 3
		end
	}

	while self.checking_race do
		-- (플레이어가 트랙 밖으로 이탈하려 했을 때, 거리가 너무 멀때) + 연출중이 아닐때
		local is_run_away = (user_party.Leader.Position.x < start_pos.x - 3 or -- ) and not self.acting --or
				math.sqrt(vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(user_party.Leader.Position, lana.Position)) > 8.5) and not self.acting

		self.lana_speed = speed_check_func[self.speed_check_index]()

		if is_run_away then
			self.lana_running = false
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lose_race, self)
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 라나 필살기 리프팅 턴
function local_class:lifting_turn(cur_dir, target_dir, first_move, second_move, is_scene)
	self.acting = true
	local dir = {'left', 'down', 'right', 'up'}

	local lana = self.get_lana()
	local total_time = 1.2
	local delay_time = 0.7
	local last_time = total_time - delay_time

	character_util.set_direction(lana, dir[cur_dir])
	character_util.set_emotion(lana, {name = 'attack'})

	character_util.spine_rotate(lana, 30, delay_time / 3)

	if is_scene then
		--time_util.mod('lana', 0.3)
		camera_util.move_async(lana.Position, 0.2, {end_target = lana})
	end

	character_util.move_to(lana, lana.Position + first_move, delay_time, nil, false)

	character_util.jump(lana, 3, total_time)

	wait_for_sec(delay_time / 3)
	character_util.spine_rotate(lana, -60, delay_time / 3 * 2)
	wait_for_sec(delay_time / 3 * 2)

	character_util.spine_rotate(lana, 0, 0.3)

	character_util.move_to(lana, lana.Position + second_move, last_time + 0.1, nil, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', play_pos = lana.Position})

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local max = target_dir < cur_dir and target_dir + 12 or target_dir + 8
		local wait_time = last_time / (max - cur_dir)
		for i = cur_dir, max do
			character_util.set_direction(lana, dir[i % 4 == 0 and 4 or i % 4])
			wait_for_sec(wait_time)
		end
	end))

	wait_for_sec(last_time / 3 * 2)

	if is_scene then
		--time_util.unmod('lana')
		camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, last_time / 3 + 0.1, {end_target = user_party_leader})
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_drift_01', play_pos = lana.Position})
	local skid = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_motor_tireskid_trail')
								  :Instantiate(lana.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, lana.Transform)

	wait_for_sec(last_time / 3)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.remove_emotion(lana)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		skid:Dispose()
	end))

	self.acting = false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == self.event_zone_name then
			self.is_zone = true
			if self.check_routine == nil then
				self.check_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.push_state_check_routine, self))
			end
			if self.progress == self.progress_enum.pre then
				self.progress = self.progress_enum.none
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.zone_enter_event, self))
			end
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.FullLeave and e.Zone.Name == self.event_zone_name
			and self.progress ~= self.progress_enum.qte then
			self.is_zone = false
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) and self.is_zone then

		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
			self.button_touch = true
			if self.progress == self.progress_enum.broken and self.push_routine == nil then
				self.progress = self.progress_enum.push
				--self.push_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_push_start, self))
				return true
			end
		end

		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and self.progress == self.progress_enum.qte then
			self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1
			return true
		end

		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown and self.progress == self.progress_enum.qte then
			self.tap_flag = true
			return true
		end

		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchUp then
			self.button_touch = false
			if self.progress >= self.progress_enum.broken and self.progress < self.progress_enum.qte then
				self.cancel_routine = true
				self:on_push_end()
			end
			return true
		end

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:knock_back_character(character, direction, force)
	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
			'physics', true, direction, force, 0.05,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(character, knock_back_info)
	character.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	character.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
	character.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
end

function local_class:push_state_check_routine()
	while self.is_zone do
		if self.cancel_routine and self.push_routine ~= nil then
			--CS.Debug.LogError('Routine Canceling Delayed')
		end
		if self:push_state_checker() then
			if self.button_touch then
				--CS.Debug.LogError('pushing while touch')
				if self.push_routine == nil and self.progress > self.progress_enum.none then
					self.push_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_push_start, self))
				end
			else
				--CS.Debug.LogError('pushing but not touch')
			end
		else
			self.cancel_routine = true
			if self.button_touch then
			--	CS.Debug.LogError('not_pushing but touch')
			--else
			--	CS.Debug.LogError('not_pushing while not touch')
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.check_routine = nil
end

function local_class:push_state_checker()
	local res = false
	if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterPushState) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState.PushTarget, self.push_wagon) then
			-- self.progress = self.progress_enum.push
			res = true
		end
	end
	return res
end

function local_class:wait_while_push(duration)
	local timer = 0
	while self.progress == self.progress_enum.push and timer < duration and not self.cancel_routine do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:wait_while_broken(duration)
	local timer = 0
	while self.progress == self.progress_enum.broken and timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:wagon_shake_routine()
	while self.push_count > -1 and not self.cancel_routine do
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_push_wagon_01', parent = self.wagon, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
		})
		self.wagon:Shake(0.03, 0.5)
		yield_return_func(self.wait_while_push, self, 0.5)
		if self.cancel_routine then break end
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Dash_Smoke'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5))
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Dash_Smoke'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(1, 0, -1),
				unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0,180,0), nil)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Dash_Smoke'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -2.5))
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Dash_Smoke'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -3),
				unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0,180,0), nil)
		self.wagon:CancelShake()
		yield_return_func(self.wait_while_push, self, 0.5)
		if self.cancel_routine then break end
	end
	self.wagon:CancelShake()
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.wagon_dad, {key = ''})
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.wagon_dad)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.wagon_kid, {key = ''})
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.wagon_kid)

	for _, v in ipairs(self.wagon_npcs) do
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(v, {key = ''})
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(v)
	end

	while not self.cancel_routine do
		if not self:push_state_checker() then break end

		-- 푸시 상호작용 유지 시간에 따른 효과
		if self.progress == self.progress_enum.qte then
			-- QTE 시작
			break

		elseif self.progress_flag and self.push_count == 1 then
			self.push_count = 2
			self.progress_flag = false

			yield_return_func(self.push_event_3, self)

		elseif self.progress_flag and self.push_count == 0 then
			self.push_count = 1
			self.progress_flag = false

			yield_return_func(self.push_event_2, self)
		elseif self.push_count == -1 then
			self.push_count = 0
			self.progress_flag = false

			yield_return_func(self.push_event_1, self)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.push_count = -1

	if self.progress == self.progress_enum.qte then
		self.tap_count = 0
		-- 플레이어가 수레를 밀고 있는 연출을 유지해야 한다.
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.final_event, self)
	end
	self.push_routine = nil
	self.cancel_routine = false
end

function local_class:npc_reset()
	--- 수레용 Pushable 제외
	self.push_wagon.Position = self.wagon.Position + vector(10.2, 0, 0)

	local princess = get_character('princess')
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	if user_party.Count < 2 then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(princess, user_party, true)
	end
	for i, npc in ipairs(self.wagon_npcs) do
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, {key = ''})
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
		if i ~= 5 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.npc_position_reset_routine, self, i, npc))
		else
			if npc.Position ~= self.npcs_initpos[i] then
				character_util.stop(npc)
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
				character_util.remove_anim(npc, true)
				character_util.move_waypoint(npc, {
					vector(self.npcs_initpos[1].x, 0, npc.Position.z),
					vector(self.npcs_initpos[1].x, 0, self.npcs_initpos[i].z), self.npcs_initpos[i]
				}, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
			end

		end

	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.wagon_mom, {
		self.wagon_dad.Position + vector(0, 0, 2.2)
	}, 7, false, 'stop', 'floor')
	--- 수레용 Pushable 배치
	self.push_wagon.Position = self.wagon.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.wagon_mom)
	character_util.set_direction(self.wagon_mom, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.wagon_mom, {name = 'release'}, {name = 'scared'})

	if self.push_count > 0 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.wagon_npcs[4], {key = self.talk_name .. 'reset_1'})
		yield_return_func(self.wait_while_broken, self, 2)
		if self.progress ~= self.progress_enum.broken then return end
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.wagon_npcs[2], {key = self.talk_name .. 'reset_2'})
	end
	self.cancel_routine = false
end

function local_class:npc_position_reset_routine(i, npc)

	character_util.set_emotion(npc, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.remove_anim(npc)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc, {

		self.npcs_initpos[i]
	}, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor')
	character_util.look_at(self.wagon)

function local_class:npc_reset_final()
	local offset = vector(0, 0, -8)
	local princess = get_character('princess')
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(princess, user_party, true)
	self.wagon_mom.Position = self.wagon_center + vector(1, 0, 1.5) + offset
	self.wagon_dad.Position = self.wagon_mom.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	self.wagon_kid.Position = self.wagon_mom.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	party_util.align_to_target(self.wagon_mom, 'left', 0, 'arc')

	for i, npc in ipairs(self.wagon_npcs) do
		character_util.stop(npc)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc, true)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})
		if i == 5 or i == 6 then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'smile'})
		end
		npc.Position = self.npcs_initpos[i] + offset
		if i == 8 then
			npc.Position = npc.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)
		end
		character_util.look_at(npc, user_party.Leader)
		npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.wagon_mom)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.wagon_mom, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.wagon_dad)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.wagon_dad, true)
	character_util.set_direction(self.wagon_mom, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.wagon_dad, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.wagon_kid, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.wagon_mom, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.wagon_dad, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.wagon_kid, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'smile'})

function local_class:final_event()
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'push', upper = true})

	local princess = get_character('princess')
	self.wagon_moves = {}
	-- 수레와 함께 이동할 필드오브젝트 및 NPC들의 테이블
	for i, npc in ipairs(self.wagon_npcs) do
		table.insert(self.wagon_moves, npc)
		character_util.set_emotion(npc, {name = 'attack'})
	end

	table.insert(self.wagon_moves, self.wagon_mom)
	table.insert(self.wagon_moves, self.wagon_dad)
	table.insert(self.wagon_moves, user_party.Leader)
	table.insert(self.wagon_moves, princess)

	for _, fo in ipairs(self.wagon_moves) do
		character_util.shake(fo, 0.02, 9999)
	end

	-- 1차 QTE 이벤트
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_shout_06')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.wagon_npcs[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 'push_1', bubble_type = 'shout'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self.tap_flag = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('down')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_tap_guide_01')

	while not self.tap_flag do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for _, fo in ipairs(self.wagon_moves) do
		character_util.move_to(fo, fo.Position + vector(0,0,-0.2), 0.5, nil)
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_push_rock_unit_02')
	character_util.move_to(self.wagon, self.wagon.Position + vector(0,0,-0.2), 0.5, nil)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.wagon_npcs[3])

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 2차 QTE 이벤트
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_shout_06')

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleSnowmanRescueSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.rock_broken = false
	self.lock = false

	self.star_piece_name = 'snowman_starpiece'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		return self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

-- 존 들어오면 고통 재생/단차위로 주인공이 다시 오면
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == 'snowman_rescue_zone' then
			if not self.lock and not self.rock_broken then
				self.lock = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pains, self))
				return true
			elseif self.rock_broken then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 쥐폭탄으로 바위 파괴시
function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local rock = self.controller:get_rock()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, rock) then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MouseBombResetEvent.Create(false))
		self.rock_broken = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_start, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleSquareSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastleRefugee @
		Comment = 미래 부유성 4스테이지 난민 스타피스 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.rat_skewer_item_id = 20208

	self.star_piece_name = 'square_star_piece'

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.item_spec_name = 'rat_skewer'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.jewel_event_zone_name = 'jewel_shop'

	self.water_event_zone_name = 'water_shop'
