	self.frog_event_zone_name = 'frog_shop'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_skewer_kid = function() return get_character('rat_skewer_customer_3') end
	self.get_skewer_mother = function() return get_character('rat_skewer_customer_4') end
	self.get_skewer_seller = function() return get_character('rat_skewer_seller') end
	self.get_jewel_seller = function() return get_character('jewel_seller') end
	self.get_jewel_customer = function(num) return get_character('jewel_customer_' .. num) end
	self.get_clothes_seller = function() return get_character('clothes_seller') end
	self.get_clothes_customer = function(num) return get_character('clothes_customer_' .. num) end
	self.get_water_seller = function() return get_character('water_seller') end
	self.get_water_customer = function(num) return get_character('water_customer_' .. num) end
	self.get_wood_seller = function() return get_character('wood_seller') end
	self.get_wood_customer = function(num) return get_character('wood_customer_' .. num) end
	self.get_frog_seller = function() return get_character('frog_seller') end
	self.get_frog_customer = function(num) return get_character('frog_customer_' .. num) end

	-- 스타피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = function(second)
		if second == 1 then
			return get_field_object(self.star_piece_name .. 2)
		else
			return get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
		end
	end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_kid_star_piece_marker = controller.get_kid_star_piece_marker
	self.get_jewel_seller_star_piece_marker = controller.get_jewel_seller_star_piece_marker

	-- item_get_async 에서 사용하는 아이템 id
	self.item_get_async_item_id = -1

	-- item_get_async 가 끝났는지
	self.is_item_get_async_end = true

	-- item_get_async 에서 사용하는 아이템을 습득하는 타겟
	self.item_get_async_target = nil

	-- 기타 상수
	self.resistance_watcher_num = 4
	self.square_npc_num = 9
	self.rat_skewer_item_id = 20208

	self.skewer_enum = {
		none = 0,
		kid = 2 ^ 0,
		jewery = 2 ^ 1,
		all = (2 ^ 2) - 1
	}

	-- 아이템 체크용 변수
	self.skewer_get = 1
	self.skewer_give = 0

	-- 아이템 체크용 함수
	self.is_kid_get = function() if self.skewer_give & self.skewer_enum.kid == self.skewer_enum.kid then return 1 else return 0 end end
	self.is_jewery_get = function() if self.skewer_give & self.skewer_enum.jewery == self.skewer_enum.jewery then return 1 else return 0 end end
	self.skewer_left = function() return self.skewer_get - self.is_kid_get() - self.is_jewery_get() end

	-- 캐릭터 이름
	self.square_npc_name = 'square_refugee_'
	self.square_kid_name = 'square_refugee_kid'

	self.kid_name = 'square_skewer_kid'
	self.jewery_name = 'jewel_seller'

	self.square_event_zone_name = 'section_6_square'
	self.kid_zone_name = 'hungry_refugees'
	self.jewery_zone_name = 'jewery_shop'

	self.branch_name = 'futurecastle_a_2_square_branch_'
	self.kid_talk_name = 'futurecastle_a_2_square_kid_'
	self.jewery_talk_name = 'futurecastle_a_2_square_jewery_'

	self.on_kid_routine = false
	self.on_jewery_routine = false
	self.on_clothes_routine = false
	self.on_water_routine = false
	self.on_wood_routine = false
	self.on_frog_routine = false

	self.on_square_event = false
	self.on_kid_event = false
	self.on_jewery_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')

	local skewer_kid = self.get_skewer_kid()
	character_util.add_listener(skewer_kid, self.controller)

	local jewel_seller = self.get_jewel_seller()
	character_util.add_listener(jewel_seller, self.controller)

	self.skewer_get = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'get')
	if self.skewer_get == -1 then
		self.skewer_get = 1
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'get', 1)
	end

	self.skewer_give = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'give')
	if self.skewer_give == -1 then
		self.skewer_give = 0
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'give', 0)
	end

	-- lua 에서는 0을 false라고 처리하지 않음. 0이나, 1이나 똑같이 값이 있기 때문에 true로 처리하는 것 같음.
	-- 따라서, 1인지 아닌지 비교해야 함.
	if self.is_kid_get() == 1 then
		local skewer_kid = self.get_skewer_kid()
		character_util.set_emotion(skewer_kid, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_relate_event(skewer_kid, self.controller)
		skewer_kid.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_square_kid_end'

		if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece('square_star_piece') then
			get_field_object(self.star_piece_name).FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false
		end
	end
	if self.is_jewery_get() == 1 then
		local jewel_seller = self.get_jewel_seller()
		character_util.set_emotion(jewel_seller, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_relate_event(jewel_seller, self.controller)
		jewel_seller.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_square_jewery_end'

		if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece('square_star_piece2') then
			get_field_object(self.star_piece_name .. 2).FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')

	local skewer_kid = self.get_skewer_kid()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(skewer_kid, self.controller)

	local jewel_seller = self.get_jewel_seller()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(jewel_seller, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		return self:on_item_get_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.jewel_event_zone_name and not self.on_jewery_routine then
				self.on_jewery_routine = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jewery_routine, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.rat_skewer_event_zone_name and not self.on_kid_routine then
				self.on_kid_routine = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.kid_routine, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.clothes_event_zone_name and not self.on_clothes_routine then
				self.on_clothes_routine = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clothes_routine, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.water_event_zone_name and not self.on_water_routine then
				self.on_water_routine = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.water_routine, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.wood_event_zone_name and not self.on_wood_routine then
				self.on_wood_routine = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.wood_routine, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.frog_event_zone_name and not self.on_frog_routine then
				self.on_frog_routine = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.frog_routine, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local skewer_kid = self.get_skewer_kid()
	local jewel_seller = self.get_jewel_seller()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, skewer_kid) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_kid, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, jewel_seller) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_jewery, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if not self.is_item_get_async_end then
		if self.item_get_async_target == nil or (self.item_get_async_target ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Getter, self.item_get_async_target)) then
			if e.Item.ItemId == self.item_get_async_item_id then
				self.is_item_get_async_end = true
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:kid_routine()

-- 아이템을 떨어트리고, 먹을 때 까지 기다린다.
function local_class:drop_item_and_get_async(from, to, item_name, scale)
	local pos = lua_helper.type_compare(from, unity_class.vector3) and from or from.Position
	local target = lua_helper.type_compare(to, unity_class.vector3) and to or to.Position

	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(item_name).Id
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = pos, target = target, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = scale, skip_text = true })

	if lua_helper.type_compare(to, CS.Oak.Character) then
		item.ConsumeTarget = to
	end

	self.item_get_async_item_id = item_id
	self.is_item_get_async_end = false
	self.item_get_async_target = to

	while not self.is_item_get_async_end do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end


return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleToyDeliverySection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_kid = function(num) return get_character('toy_kid_' .. num) end
	self.get_no_toy_kid = function() return get_character('toy_kid_5') end
	self.get_figure = function(num) return get_character('toy_figure_' .. num) end

	self.get_toy_shop = function() return get_field_object('toy_shop') end

	self.star_piece_name = 'toy_delivery_star_piece'

	self.no_toy_kid_origin_pos = nil

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadItemGetEvent()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	local anim_list = {
		'idle',
		'gauntlet_idle',
		'get',
		'bomb_idle',
	}

	local slot_list = {
		2, 1, 1, 2
	}

	local rotate_list = {
		0,
		-125,
		180,
		145
	}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local kid = self.get_kid(i)
		local figure = self.get_figure(i)

		character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = anim_list[i]})

		self.controller:set_figure(figure, i == 1 and 0.5 or 0.6)

		if i ~= 4 then
			self.controller:attach_figure_to_target(kid, figure, slot_list[i], rotate_list[i])
		else
			figure.Position = kid.Position + vector(-0.4, 0, 0)
			figure.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end
	end

	local no_toy_kid = self.get_no_toy_kid()

	self.no_toy_kid_origin_pos = no_toy_kid.Position
	no_toy_kid.Position = vector(3, 0, -72)
	no_toy_kid.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.set_anim(no_toy_kid, {name = 'seat'})
	character_util.set_emotion(no_toy_kid, {name = 'tired'})

	self.controller:set_kid_one_line('pre')

	local green_figure = self.get_figure(5)
	self.controller:set_figure(green_figure)
	character_util.spine_rotate(green_figure, -90, 0)
	green_figure.Position = self.get_toy_shop().Position + vector(0, 0.3, -0.3)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_toy_shop()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_toy, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_no_toy_kid()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_give_toy, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_with_toy()
	local green_figure = self.get_figure(5)

	--get item event
	--title: 티탄 레인저 피규어
	--subtitle: 최고의 스테디 셀러
	--description: 수익금의 1.3%는 티탄족 결식아동을 돕는데 사용된다고 적혀있다.

	local is_left = user_party.Leader.Position.x < green_figure.Position.x
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, is_left and 'right' or 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'eat'})

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	self.get_toy_shop().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	character_util.spine_rotate(green_figure, 0, 0)
	green_figure.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	character_util.add_listener(self.get_no_toy_kid(), self.controller)

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent,

			'futurecastle_toy_delivery_title',
			'futurecastle_toy_delivery_subtitle',
			'futurecastle_toy_delivery_desc'
	)
end

	character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = 'cast'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {key = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_6', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)

	--레인저 중 최강의 사나이!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {key = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_7', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)

	--정말 고마워요!
	character_util.set_emotion(kid, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {key = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_8', skip = true})

	character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = 'cast2'})

	--스타피스 던져준다, 퀘스트 클리어
	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(kid.Position))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.remove_anim(kid)

	--…덕분에 저도 제 몫을 할 수 있게 됐어요.
	character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = 'cast'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {key = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_9', skip = true})

	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'futurecastle_toy_delivery_branch_2_1', 'intellect'},
		{'futurecastle_toy_delivery_branch_2_2', 'brutal'},

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)

	character_util.set_emotion(kid, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {key = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_10', skip = true})

	--	요즘 어른들 표정이 많이 안좋아요…
	character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = 'cast'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {key = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_11', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(kid)

	--	공습, 물자… 어려운 소리는 잘 모르겠지만…

end

function local_class:start()

    self.quest_spec = nil

end

--region custom functions

function local_class:run_event_scene()
    local robot = self.get_new_robot()
    local boss = self.controller.get_boss()
    local panda = self.controller.get_panda()
    local denny = self.controller.get_denny()

    local aligned = nil

        camera_util.move_async(self.controller.event_camera_pos, 0.5)
        aligned = self.controller:trio_talk()
    end

    -- 신비한 배터리를 사용한다.

    local ans = choose_util.play_choose_event({
        {'future_castle_trio_4', 'mercy'},
        {'future_castle_trio_5', 'normal'}
    })

    if ans == 1 then
        local sfx_holder = nil
        if aligned == nil then
            camera_util.move_async(self.controller.event_camera_pos, 0.5)
            party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member(robot.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0), 'left', 1)
        end

        wait_for_sec(1)
        character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
        battery_item.ConsumeTarget = robot
        battery_item:ConsumeComplete()

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.loop_damaged_effect, self, robot))
        character_util.shake(robot, 0.04, 9999)

        wait_for_sec(0.5)
        local trios = {boss, denny, panda}

        self:move_around_routine()
        wait_for_sec(0.5)
        character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(panda, {name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01'}, {name = 'smile'})
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

        character_util.remove_anim(panda)

        -- 마크-13…!!

        character_util.move_waypoint_async(denny, vector(denny.Position.x + 1.25, 0, robot.Position.z - self.controller.robot_distance.z + 0.75),
                6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
        sfx_holder:FadeOut(0)

        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
        character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(denny, {name = 'push'}, {name = 'cry'})

        wait_for_sec(2.5)
        character_util.move_waypoint_async(boss, user_party_leader.Position + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
                2, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
        character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'smile'})
        -- 너 설마 우릴 위해서 일부러 배터리를..
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss, {key = 'future_castle_trio_11', skip = true})
        character_util.remove_emotion(panda)
        character_util.show_emoticon(panda, vector(1, 1, 1), 'silence')
        wait_for_sec(2)
        -- ...고맙다.
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(panda, {key = 'future_castle_trio_12', skip = true})

        character_util.move_waypoint_async(panda, user_party_leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0.5),
                2, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
        character_util.nod_twice(user_party_leader)

        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(panda, {key = 'future_castle_trio_13', skip = true})
        -- 우리한텐 여러 모로 소중한 녀석이라고.
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(panda, {key = 'future_castle_trio_14', skip = true})

            music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
            -- 하 이거 이 눈치없는 자식..
            speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(panda, {key = 'future_castle_trio_19', skip = true})

end

function local_class:loop_damaged_effect(fo)
    local sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_iron_teatan_head_turn_01', loop = true})
    local duration = 0.3
    while self.robot_fixed == false do
        character_util.spine_pulse_color(fo, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, duration)
        character_util.spine_damage_squish(fo, 1.05, 0.95, 1, duration)

        wait_for_sec(duration)
    end

    sfx_holder:FadeOut(0)
end

function local_class:move_around_routine()
    local panda = self.controller.get_panda()
    local robot = self.get_new_robot()
    local dis = self.controller.robot_distance
    local dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
    -- right mid나 left mid 에서 멈추면서 연출 3 번 반복
    local panda_waypoints = {
        -- left top
        robot.Position + vector(-dis.x,0, dis.z),
        -- right top
        robot.Position + vector(dis.x,0, dis.z),
        -- right mid
        robot.Position + vector(dis.x, 0, 0),
        -- right bot
        robot.Position + vector(dis.x, 0, -dis.z),
        -- left bot
        robot.Position + vector(-dis.x, 0, -dis.z),
        -- left mid
        robot.Position + vector(-dis.x, 0, 0)
    }

    character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(panda)
    -- 이, 이건….!
    -- 메인 회로가 살아있어…!
    -- 여기 회로 쇼트만 고치면…!
    local speech_list = {'future_castle_trio_6', 'future_castle_trio_7', nil, 'future_castle_trio_8'}
    local sfx_list = {nil, '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', nil, nil}
    local sfx_holder = nil
    local idx = 0
    for i = 1, 4 do
        panda.Direction = dir
        dir = direction_util.get_opposite(dir)
        character_util.set_anim(panda, {name = 'eat'})
        sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true})

        if sfx_list[i] ~= nil then
            music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = sfx_list[i], loop = false, delayed_time = 0.25})
        end
        if speech_list[i] ~= nil then
            speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(panda, {key = speech_list[i], skip = true})
        else
            wait_for_sec(1.5)
        end
        sfx_holder:FadeOut(0)
        character_util.remove_anim(panda)

        for j = 1, 3 do
            idx = idx + 1
            sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
            character_util.move_waypoint_async(panda, panda_waypoints[idx], 6, true)
            sfx_holder:FadeOut()
            idx = idx >= 6 and 0 or idx
        end
    end

    panda.Direction = dir

    sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true})
    character_util.set_anim(panda, {name = 'eat'})
    wait_for_sec(1)
    sfx_holder:FadeOut(0)
    character_util.remove_anim(panda)
    self.robot_fixed = true
    wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

--endregion

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleYuzePostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = FutureCastleYuzu @
		Comment = 퀘스트 완료 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.antidote_item_spec_name = 'healing_potion'

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.main_stage_name = 'futurecastle_1_2'
	self.sub_stage_name = 'substage_10_4'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.last_yuze_event_zone = 'last_yuze'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_yuze = controller.get_yuze

	self.is_saw_yuze_last = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.sub_stage_name then
		return true
	end
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'screen_tint_white', 'immediate'}))

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	if not self.controller.on_clear_yuze then
		local yuze = self.get_yuze()
		yuze.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		for i = 1, 2 do
			local resistance = get_character('resistance_' .. i)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(resistance)
			resistance.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		for i = 1, 18 do
			local patient = get_character('patient_' .. i)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(patient)
			patient.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		for i = 1, 6 do
			local sleep = get_character('sleep_patient_' .. i)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sleep)
			sleep.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		for i = 1, 15 do
			local guard = get_character('guard_' .. i)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)
			guard.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		for i = 1, 8 do
			local patrol = get_character('patrol_' .. i)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(patrol)
			patrol.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('last_room_door_1', true))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('last_room_door_2', true))
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.sub_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.sub_stage_name then
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local door1 = get_field_object('last_room_door_1')
		local door2 = get_field_object('last_room_door_2')
		local weapon = get_field_object('player_weapon_box')

		if e.Target.Name == 'green_storage' then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_green_box, self, e.Target.Position)
			return true
		elseif e.Target.Name == 'antidote_storage' then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_antidote_box, self, e.Target.Position)
			return true
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, weapon) or e.Target.Name == 'etc_weapon_box' then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_non_weapons, self)
			return true
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, door1) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, door2) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.last_door_interact, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:last_door_interact()
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'future_castle_yuze_106'})
end

-- 다른 유품상자에 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_non_weapons()
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'future_castle_yuze_weapon_non'})
end

-- 그린티켓 상자에 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_green_box(pos)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "SetNarration",
			game_string:GetString('future_castle_yuze_storage_drug'), 0, 0)

	local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({ {'future_castle_yuze_branch_yes', 'brutal'},
												   {'future_castle_yuze_branch_no', 'normal'} })

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "HideAnimation")

	if choose == 1 then
		local item_id = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName('drug_crystal').Id
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = pos, target = user_party.Leader.Position, itemid = item_id,
												  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })
		local sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		item:SetSortingLayer(true)

		if sprite ~= nil then
			sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 1 })
			sprite:Rebuild()
		end

		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01' })
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })

		local timer = 0
		while timer < 1 do
			item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - timer)
			item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - timer)
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0
		item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0

		item:ConsumeComplete()

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'dead', loop = false}, {name = 'confused'})
		wait_for_sec(2)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		character_util.shake_and_wakeup(user_party.Leader, 'right', 2, 'smile')

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'future_castle_yuze_after_drug'})
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 해독제 상자에 상호작용 했을 때

	local yuze = self.get_yuze()

	party_util.align_to_target(yuze, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 파트너, 오랜만이야!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_1', skip = true })

	-- 잘 지냈어?

	-- 잘 지냈어. / 힘든 시간이었다.

	if choose_result == 1 then

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_3_1', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(yuze)

		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_3_2', skip = true })
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_4', skip = true, scale = 1.5,

	succubus.Position = yuze.Position + vector(-11, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(succubus, yuze.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			7, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)


	-- 여기 들어오면…
	character_util.set_direction(succubus, 'down')
	character_util.normal_jump(succubus, true)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(succubus, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_5', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus)
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(yuze, nil, 'silence')

	-- 아, 아무 것도 아니에요!
	character_util.set_direction(succubus, 'right')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(succubus, succubus.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			0.5, nil, false, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(succubus, succubus.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			0.5, nil, false, true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_6', skip = true })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(succubus, yuze.Position + vector(-13, 0, 0),
			7, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus)
	character_util.set_active_state(succubus, 'disabled')


	-- 파트너, 이 주변에서 최근 실종자가 늘고 있어.
	character_util.remove_anim(yuze)
	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_7', skip = true })

	-- 실종 장소로 가면 뭔가 단서가 남아있을지도 몰라.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_8', skip = true })

	-- 파트너, 너도 도와 줄 거지?
	character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_9', skip = true })

	-- 서브 스테이지 오픈
	local sub_stage = self.get_substage().FieldObjectBehaviour
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({ substage_name = sub_stage.OpenStageName,
										substage_open_string_key = sub_stage.OpenMessage })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 준비가 되면 이쪽으로 와 줘.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_10', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)


	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:enter()

		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	-- 구역 배회하고 있는 몬스터들을 DontFight 세팅
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local patrol = self.get_patrol(i)
		patrol.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
	end

	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local default_start_marker = self.get_default_start_marker()

	yuze.Position = default_start_marker.position + vector(0, 0, -3)
	character_util.look_at(yuze, user_party_leader)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.green_fog_tint, self))

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_heal_a')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Screen_Blizzard_Cloud')

	for i = 3, 15 do
		local patient = get_character('patient_' .. i)
		character_util.add_listener(patient, self.controller)
	end


	self.get_patrol(6).OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.get_patrol(7).OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	self.preset = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Screen_Blizzard_Cloud')
	-- particle system 조정에 쓰일 gradient 생성
	-- stage 진행 중 생성할 경우 끊기는 현상이 발생해, 미리 생성
	self.fade.gradient = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(unity_class.color.black)

	self.weapon_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle'):Instantiate(
			get_field_object('player_weapon_box').Position + vector(0, 1, 0))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_start, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	self.is_tint = false

	self.weapon_effect = nil

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.main_module = nil
		self.fade.color = nil
		self.fade.obj:Dispose()
		self.fade.obj = nil
	end

	field:RemoveTint('green_fog1', 0)
	field:RemoveTint('green_fog2', 0)
	field:RemoveTint('illusion', 0)
	stage_camera.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.saved_party_leader = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
			self.get_yuze().Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		return self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'cross_road' then
				self.player_in_battle_zone = 'cross_road'
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'antidote_battle_zone' then
				self.player_in_battle_zone = 'antidote_battle_zone'
				if not self.on_bgm_play then
					self.on_bgm_play = true
					music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 0})
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'patrol_zone' then
				self.player_in_battle_zone = 'patrol_zone'
			end

			if e.Zone.Name == self.yuze_talk_event_zone_name and not self.is_smoke then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.yuze_following_talk, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.dream_therapy_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.in_to_the_dream_therapy, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'marvin_zone' and self.talk_level < 1 then
				self.talk_level = 1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.marvin_talk, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'shapira_zone' and self.talk_level < 2 then
				self.talk_level = 2
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shapira_talk, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'talon_zone' and self.talk_level < 3 then
				self.talk_level = 3
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talon_talk, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'china_zone' and self.talk_level < 4 then
				self.talk_level = 4
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.china_talk, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.queen_event_zone_name and self.talk_level < 5 then
				self.talk_level = 5
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.princess_talk_alone, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.patient_room_event_zone_name and not self.is_saw_patient_room then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.entry_patient_room, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'antidote_room' and not self.on_talk_1 and not self.on_battle_1 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_talk_1, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'cross_road' and not self.on_talk_2 and not self.on_battle_2 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_talk_2, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'patrol_zone' then
				-- 해당 구역에 들어왔을 때 DontFight false
				for i = 1, 4 do
					local patrol = self.get_patrol(i)
					if not patrol.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
						patrol.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
					end
				end

				if self.last_patient_routine == nil then
					self.last_patient_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
							self.patient_snoring, self))
				end

				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.meet_yuze_event_zone_name .. 1 and not self.on_battle_yuze_room_1 then
				--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_yuze_1, self)
				-- 보초들 배틀 전환
				self:guard_battle_state()
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.meet_yuze_event_zone_name .. 2 and not self.on_yuze_battle then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.entry_yuze_room, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.last_yuze_event_zone and not self.is_saw_yuze_last then
				self.is_saw_yuze_last = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.yuze_last, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'cross_road' or e.Zone.Name == 'antidote_battle_zone' then
				self.player_in_battle_zone = 'none'
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'patrol_zone' then
				-- 해당 전투 구역 나갔을 때 DontFight true
				for i = 1, 4 do
					local patrol = self.get_patrol(i)
					if not patrol.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
						patrol.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
					end
				end

				self.player_in_battle_zone = 'none'
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local door1 = get_field_object('last_room_door_1')
	local door2 = get_field_object('last_room_door_2')
	local weapon = get_field_object('player_weapon_box')
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, weapon) then
		if not self.is_armed then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_weapons, self)
			return true
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_non_weapons, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif e.Target.Name == 'etc_weapon_box' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_non_weapons, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, princess) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_queen, self)
		return true
	elseif e.Target.Name == 'green_storage' then
		if stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty() == nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_green_box, self, e.Target.Position))
		end
		return true
	elseif e.Target.Name == 'antidote_storage' then
		if stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty() == nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_antidote_box, self, e.Target.Position))
		end
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, door1) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, door2) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.last_door_interact, self)
		return true
	else
		for i = 3, 15 do
			local patient = get_character('patient_' .. i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, patient) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_patients, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not self.is_armed then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party_leader)
			and lua_helper.type_compare(e.Info.target.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
		local notice_link = e.Info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName

		if notice_link == self.guard_battle_group_name .. 1 and
				not self.is_eliminated_0 and self.player_in_battle_zone == 'antidote_battle_zone' then
			return self:notice_guards_1(e, e.Info.target)
		elseif notice_link == self.guard_battle_group_name .. 2 and
				not self.is_eliminated_1 and  self.player_in_battle_zone == 'cross_road' then
			return self:notice_guards_2(e, e.Info.target)
		elseif notice_link == self.detect_event_name .. 3 and
				not self.is_eliminated_3 and  self.player_in_battle_zone == 'patrol_zone' then
			return self:notice_guards_3(e, e.Info.target)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == self.detect_event_name .. 3 and not self.on_detected then
		return self:notice_guards_3(e)
	elseif e.Params[0] == self.detect_event_name .. 1 and not self.on_detected then
		return self:notice_guards_1(e)
	end
	if e.Params[0] == self.guard_battle_group_name .. 2 or e.Params[0] == self.detect_event_name .. 2 then
		if not self.on_detected then
			return self:notice_guards_2(e)
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:wait_while_tint(duration)
	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration and self.is_tint do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 화면 전체에 옅은 녹색 틴트가 일렁거림.
function local_class:green_fog_tint()
	local color_list = { unity_color({ 0.5, 0.8509803921568627, 0.5, 1 }),
						 unity_color({ 0.5, 0.6529411764705882, 0.5, 1 })}
	local duration = 1

	field:Tint('green_fog', color_list[2], 1)
	yield_return_func(self.wait_while_tint, self, duration + 0.1)

	while self.is_tint do
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local color = color_list[i]

			field:Tint('green_fog' .. i, color, duration)
			yield_return_func(self.wait_while_tint, self, duration + 0.1)
		end
	end

	field:RemoveTint('green_fog1', 0.25)
	field:RemoveTint('green_fog2', 0.25)
end

	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'sleep'})
	character_util.set_anim(queen, {name = 'seat'})
	eva.Position = eva.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
	queen.Position = dream_forest_marker.position + vector(0.7, 0, 0)
	self.is_tint = false

	wait_for_sec(1)

	field:Tint('black_screen', unity_class.color.black, 0)
	queen.SpineController:AddColor('black_out', unity_color{ 0, 0, 0, 1 }, 1, 0)
	eva.SpineController:AddColor('black_out', unity_color{ 0, 0, 0, 1 }, 1, 0)
	user_party_leader.SpineController:AddColor('black_out', unity_color{ 0, 0, 0, 1 }, 1, 0)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 어나…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(queen, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_17_1', skip = true})

	-- 빨리…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(queen, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_17_2', skip = true})

	-- 일어나!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(queen, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_17_3', skip = true,
															bubble_type = 'shout'})

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	field:RemoveTint('black_screen', 0)
	queen.SpineController:RemoveColor('black_out', 0)
	eva.SpineController:RemoveColor('black_out', 0)
	user_party_leader.SpineController:RemoveColor('black_out', 0)
	self.is_tint = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.green_fog_tint, self))
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	self.stage_bgm = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_hallucination_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2})
	local sleep_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_sleep_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 0})

	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(true)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	for i = 1, 2 do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.02, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
	sleep_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party_leader, 'left')

	-- 신참! 여왕님이 계시는데 감히 코를 골다니…
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(eva, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(eva, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_17', skip = true })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 괜찮아요, 에바 단장. 많이 피곤했나 보군요, 가디언이여.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(queen)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(queen, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_18', skip = true })

	-- 하지만 당신을 애타게 기다리고 있는 귀염둥이가 있으니…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(queen, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_19', skip = true })

	-- 이제 그만 깨어나서 가야 할 시간이랍니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(queen, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_20', skip = true })

	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(eva)
	character_util.remove_anim(queen)
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(queen, user_party, true)
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(eva, user_party, false)
end

-- 공주 가까이 다가갔을 때
function local_class:meet_queen()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local eva = self.get_eva()
	local queen = self.get_queen()
	local resistance_1 = self.get_resistance(1)
	local resistance_2 = self.get_resistance(2)

	self.talk_level = 6

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(princess, {key = ''})
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(princess)

	--party_util.align_to_target(queen, 'left', 1, 'arc')
	party_util.align_party(princess.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'arc')

	-- 언니, 에바!
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_22', skip = true })

	-- {0}! 보고 싶었어!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = { 'future_castle_yuze_23', user.Name }, skip = true })

	-- 공주, 기사를 향해 달려간다.
	-- 화면 shake + 검은색으로 깜빡인다.
	self.stage_bgm:FadeOut(2)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_evolve_result_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.25, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.25, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_evolve_result_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.25, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.25, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 공주가 기사에게 도착하기 직전, 화면 전환 검은화면
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	character_util.move_waypoint(princess, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			1, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.shake(0.7, 0.3)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.stage_bgm = nil
	-- 플레이어 무기 장착 해제
	--self:load_switch_leader()
	--party_util.switch_leader(self.get_walk4legs_holder())
	--user_party_leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nil)
	--user_party_leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nil)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(queen)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(eva)

	local wake_up_marker = self.get_wake_up_marker()
	resistance_1.Position  = wake_up_marker.position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	resistance_2.Position  = wake_up_marker.position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	--party_util.position_party(wake_up_marker.position + vector(0, 1, 0), 'down', 'arc')
	user_party_leader.Position = wake_up_marker.position + vector(0, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'sleep' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'prostrate' })

	character_util.look_at(resistance_1, user_party_leader)
	character_util.look_at(resistance_2, user_party_leader)
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_1, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_2, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_sleep_01')
	resistance_1:HideWeapon(true)
	resistance_2:HideWeapon(true)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 남자 둘이 주인공을 옮기다가 떨어트린다.
	character_util.shake(resistance_1, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.shake(resistance_2, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(resistance_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(resistance_2, 'left')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, 'right')
	character_util.move_waypoint(resistance_1, resistance_1.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	character_util.move_waypoint(resistance_2, resistance_2.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.stop_shake(resistance_1)
	character_util.stop_shake(resistance_2)
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_1, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_2, true)
	character_util.move_to(resistance_1, resistance_1.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 0), 0.2, nil, false, true)
	character_util.move_to(resistance_2, resistance_2.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 0), 0.2, nil, false, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, vector_util.get_x0z(user_party_leader.Position), 0.2, nil, false, false)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(user_party_leader)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(user_party_leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(resistance_1, 'none')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(resistance_2, 'none')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, 'none')

	-- 야! 조심하라 했잖아!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_1, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_24', skip = true })

	-- 거, 되게 뭐라 그러네.
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_2, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_25', skip = true })

	-- 어차피 안깬다고.
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_2, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_2, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_26', skip = true })

	-- 주인공이 부들거리다가 일어난다.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.02, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.02, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'confused' })
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party_leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'confused' })

	-- 내가 조심하라고 했지?!
	character_util.set_emotion(resistance_1, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(resistance_2, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_1, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_1, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_26_1', skip = true })

	-- 아…  망할.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_1)
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_2, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_27', skip = true })

	-- 공주는? / 여왕님은…?
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'future_castle_yuze_27_1', 'normal' }, { 'future_castle_yuze_27_2', 'normal' } })

	character_util.remove_emotion(resistance_1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(resistance_2)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 공주님을 여기서 왜 찾아?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_2, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_28', skip = true })
	else
		-- 뭔 꿈을 꾸고 있던 거야?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_2, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_29', skip = true })
	end

	-- 아, 어떻게든 재우면 되는거잖아.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_2, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_29_1', skip = true })

	-- 레지스탕스2가 주인공을 발로 찬다.
	-- 주인공 쓰러진다.
	local on_first = true
	local sfx_func1 = function()
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
		self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(user_party_leader)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(user_party_leader)
		if on_first then
			on_first = false
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
		end
	end
	local sfx_func2 = function()
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
		self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(user_party_leader)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(user_party_leader)
		if on_first then
			on_first = false
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
		end
	end

	-- 플레이어를 마구 구타함
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(resistance_2, vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.2)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(resistance_2, {name = 'gauntlet_kick2', count = 1, sfx = sfx_func2})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(resistance_1, vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.2)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(resistance_1, {name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx = sfx_func1})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(resistance_2, vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.2)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(resistance_2, {name = 'gauntlet_kick2', count = 1, sfx = sfx_func2})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(resistance_1, vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.2)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(resistance_1, {name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx = sfx_func1})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(resistance_2, vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.2)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(resistance_2, {name = 'gauntlet_kick2', count = 1, sfx = sfx_func2})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(resistance_1, vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.2)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(resistance_1, {name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx = sfx_func1})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 플레이어를 다시 들어서 침낭으로 옮김
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_1, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_2, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	character_util.move_to(resistance_1, resistance_1.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 0), 0.2, nil, false, true)
	character_util.move_to(resistance_2, resistance_2.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 0), 0.2, nil, false, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0),
			0.5, nil, false, false)

	character_util.shake(resistance_1, 0.03, 9999)
	character_util.shake(resistance_2, 0.03, 9999)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(resistance_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(resistance_2, 'left')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, 'right')
	character_util.move_waypoint(resistance_1, resistance_1.Position + vector(1.8, 0, 0),
			3, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	character_util.move_waypoint(resistance_2, resistance_2.Position + vector(1.8, 0, 0),
			3, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(1.8, 0, 0),
			3, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_to(resistance_1, resistance_1.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 0), 0.2, nil, false, true)
	character_util.move_to(resistance_2, resistance_2.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 0), 0.2, nil, false, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, vector_util.get_x0z(user_party_leader.Position), 0.2, nil, false, false)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(user_party_leader)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(user_party_leader)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.stop_shake(resistance_1)
	character_util.stop_shake(resistance_2)
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_1, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_2, true)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(resistance_1, 'none')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(resistance_2, 'none')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, 'none')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 뭐가 됐던, 눈 감고 누워있으면 보일 거야.
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_2)
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_1, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_30', skip = true })

	-- 얌전히 누워 있으라고.
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_2, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_31', skip = true })

	local walk4legs_holder = self:get_walk4legs_holder()
	walk4legs_holder.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	character_util.set_direction(walk4legs_holder, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(walk4legs_holder, {name = 'prostrate'})

	-- 레지스탕스 1&2 퇴장한다.
	character_util.move_waypoint(resistance_2, resistance_2.Position + vector(10, 0, 0), 4, false)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(resistance_1, resistance_1.Position + vector(10, 0, 0), 4, false)
	character_util.set_active_state(resistance_1, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(resistance_2, 'disabled')

	-- TODO: 컨트롤 돌아온다.
	--주인공 혼자 남은 상태
	--4leg 상태로 이동
	--달리기 불가(걷기 속도로 이동)


	self:load_switch_leader()

function local_class:player_prostrate_routine()

	character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.03, 0.3)
	self:get_walk4legs_holder().SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	party_util.remove_animation()
end

-- 그린티켓 상자에 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_green_box(pos)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "SetNarration",
			game_string:GetString('future_castle_yuze_storage_drug'), 0, 0)

	local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({ {'future_castle_yuze_branch_yes', 'brutal'},
												   {'future_castle_yuze_branch_no', 'normal'} })

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "HideAnimation")

	if choose == 1 then
		local item_id = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName('drug_crystal').Id
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = pos, target = user_party.Leader.Position, itemid = item_id,
												  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })
		local sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		item:SetSortingLayer(true)

		if sprite ~= nil then
			sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 1 })
			sprite:Rebuild()
		end

		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01' })
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })

		local timer = 0
		while timer < 1 do
			item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - timer)
			item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - timer)
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0
		item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0

		item:ConsumeComplete()

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'dead', loop = false}, {name = 'confused'})
		wait_for_sec(2)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		if not self.is_blink then
			character_util.shake_and_wakeup(user_party.Leader, 'right', 2, 'smile')
		end

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'future_castle_yuze_after_drug'})
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	if self.is_blink then
		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
		manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack |
				CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Assassination)

		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'blush'})
	elseif not self.is_armed then
		-- 공격, 스킬 막아놓음
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		user_party_leader:HideWeapon(true)
		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
		manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Assassination)

		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)
	end


	if not self.is_armed then
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.MythSkillButton)
	else
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

end

		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })

		-- TODO: 회복 이펙트 + 버프 이펙트
		-- 이동 속도 및 화면 깜빡이는 효과 사라진다.
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = user_party.Leader
		heal_info.target = user_party.Leader
		heal_info.heal = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_heal_a'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)

		wait_for_sec(0.8)

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		if self.is_blink then
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'future_castle_yuze_antidote' })
			local is_changed = false
			local event_listener = {}

			event_listener.on_battle_action_changed = function(_, e)
				is_changed = true
				return true
			end

			message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionsChangedEvent), 'on_battle_action_changed')

			if not self.is_armed then
				self.saved_party_leader:HideWeapon(true)
			end

			self.is_blink = false
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.saved_party_leader)
			character_util.set_direction(self.saved_party_leader, user_party.Leader.Direction)

			party_util.switch_leader(self.saved_party_leader)

			while is_changed == false do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionsChangedEvent))
		else
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'future_castle_yuze_after_antidote' })
		end
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()


	if self.is_blink then
		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
		manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack |

		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'blush'})
	elseif not self.is_armed then
		-- 공격, 스킬 막아놓음
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
		manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Assassination)

		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)
	end


	if not self.is_armed then
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.MythSkillButton)
	else
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:interact_weapons()

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'eat' })

	local ui_dict = field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar, false)
	local timer_bar = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
	local duration = 2

	local is_timer_full = false
	local parent = timer_bar.transform.parents

	timer_bar.transform.parent = user_party.Leader.Transform
	timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	timer_bar:Init(user_party.Leader)
	timer_bar:SetPosition(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 1.2, 0))
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, duration)
	is_timer_full = false
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0)
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(duration, duration)

	wait_for_sec(2)
	timer_bar.transform.parent = parent
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_get_drop_item_01')

	self.weapon_effect:Dispose()

	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(false)

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'future_castle_yuze_weapon'})
	self:get_player_weapons()

	self.is_armed = true

	self:set_guards_enemy()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:set_guards_enemy()
	for i = 5, 8 do
		local patrol = self.get_patrol(i)
		local waypoints = patrol.FieldObjectController.WaypointList
		local range = patrol.FieldObjectController.SightDistance
		local angle = patrol.FieldObjectController.SightAngle
		local eventName = patrol.FieldObjectController.EventName
		character_util.convert_to_monster(patrol)
		character_util.set_death_type(patrol, 'airspin')
		patrol.FieldObjectController
		= CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(patrol, waypoints, eventName, range, angle)
	end

	for i = 1, 15 do
		local guard = self.get_guard(i)
		if lua_helper.type_compare(guard.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController) then
			local directions = guard.FieldObjectController.DirectionList
			local delay = guard.FieldObjectController.DirectionDelay
			local range = guard.FieldObjectController.SightDistance
			local angle = guard.FieldObjectController.SightAngle
			local eventName = guard.FieldObjectController.EventName
			character_util.convert_to_monster(guard)
			character_util.set_death_type(guard, 'airspin')
			guard.FieldObjectController
			= CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(guard, directions, delay, eventName, range, angle)
		end
	end
end
