-- 마지막 유즈 방 입장 했을 때
function local_class:entry_yuze_room()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name .. 'yuze', true))
	camera_util.move(yuze.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 1)
	party_util.align_party(yuze.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'arc')

	-- 파트너! 여기까지 오다니, 대단하네!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(yuze, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_53', skip = true })

	-- 그래도 날 도와 행복을 나눠주는 사람들인데… 좀 살살하지 그랬어?
	character_util.remove_anim(yuze)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_54', skip = true })

	-- 여긴 대체…?
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'future_castle_yuze_54_1', 'brutal' }})
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 걱정 마, 파트너.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_55', skip = true })

		-- 드림 테라피로 모두가 죽을 때까지 행복한 꿈을 꾸게 만들었을 뿐이야.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_56', skip = true })

		-- 상처 없이 재우려고 약물의 도움을 약간 받았지만, 고통은 없었을 거야.
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(yuze, {name = 'nod', loop = false}, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_57', skip = true })
	end

	-- 대체 왜 이러는 거야?
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({{ 'future_castle_yuze_54_2', 'brutal' } })
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 공주님이 분전해주고 있지만… 우린 이미 패배했어.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_58', skip = true })

		-- 부유성에 비축해둔 식량도, 약품도 바닥을 보이고 있고,
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_59', skip = true })

		-- 점점 더 인구는 감소하고 있어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_60', skip = true })

		-- 인베이더들이 포위만 하고 있더라도, 우린 스스로 자멸할 거야.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_61', skip = true })

		-- 예정된 운명을 바꿀 수 없다면…
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'up')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_62', skip = true })

		-- 적어도 모두가 행복하게 마지막을 맞이하게 해주는 것.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_63', skip = true })

		-- 그게 내게 남은 의무가 아닐까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_64', skip = true })

		-- 뒤 돌아있던 유즈, 플레이어를 바라본다.
		--speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_65', skip = true })
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 그런의미에서… 파트너?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_66', skip = true })

		-- 너도 더이상 고통받지 않고, 행복하게 해줄게.
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_count_final_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
		camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.3)
		camera_util.move_async(yuze.Position, 0.3)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_67', skip = true })

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
		camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 0.5, {end_target = user_party_leader})

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})
		screen_util.show_boss_title('future_castle_yuze_boss_title',
				'future_castle_yuze_boss_subtitle', 2, false)
		wait_for_sec(2)

		-- 유즈와 전투 시작
		character_util.convert_to_monster(yuze, self.yuze_battle_group_name, self.meet_yuze_event_zone_name .. 2)
		character_util.set_death_type(yuze, 'prostrate')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(yuze, user_party_leader, 'battle')
	end

	self.on_yuze_battle = true
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'combat', mix = 0})
end

-- 유즈와의 전투에서 승리 했을 때
function local_class:win_to_yuze()
	self.is_yuze_defeat = true
	self.controller.on_clear_yuze = true

	local yuze = self.get_yuze()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2})

	party_util.position_party(vector(103, 0, -59), 'left', 'arc')
	yuze.Position = vector(101, 0, -59)
	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)
	character_util.set_anim(yuze, {name = 'seat'})
	character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'tired' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 네가 이겼어, 파트너.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_68', skip = true })

	-- 드림 테라피를 멈추길 바라는 거야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_69', skip = true })

	local choose_result = 0

	while true do

		-- 말해두는데, 나도 이제 한계야.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_70', skip = true })

		-- 한 번 멈추면 다시 걸 수 없어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_71', skip = true })

		-- 드림 테라피를 멈춰줘. / 이대로 떠난다.
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'future_castle_yuze_71_1', 'mercy' }, { 'future_castle_yuze_71_2', 'brutal' } })

		if choose_result == 2 then break end

		-- 정말?
		character_util.normal_jump(yuze, true)
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, {name = 'idle'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_72', skip = true })

		-- 넌 이 현실이 더 낫다고 생각하는 거야?
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_73', skip = true })
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, {name = 'idle'})

		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'future_castle_yuze_73_1', 'mercy' }, { 'future_castle_yuze_73_2', 'brutal' } })

		if choose_result == 1 then break end

	end

	if choose_result == 1 then

		-- 그래… 이 현실과 마주하는 것이 그들이 바라던 것인지 볼까?
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_74', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'staff_cast', loop = false })
		camera_util.resize_to(2, 1)
		camera_util.move(yuze.Position, 1)

		--- 화면 전환
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		for i = 6, 8 do
			local patrol = self.get_patrol(i)
			character_util.convert_to_monster(patrol)
		end
		camera_util.move_async(vector(52, 0, -105.5), 0)
		local patients = {}
		for i = 1, 6 do
			table.insert(patients, get_character('patient_' .. i))
			if i ~= 2 then
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(patients[i], {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'sleep'})
			end
		end

		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		self.is_tint = false
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'screen_tint_white', 'linear'}))

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shake_and_wakeup, self,
				patients[3], 'right', 1, 'scared'))
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shake_and_wakeup, self,
				patients[4], 'right', 1, 'scared', '01_player_popup_01'))
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shake_and_wakeup, self,
				patients[1], 'right', 1, 'scared', '01_player_popup_01'))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shake_and_wakeup, self,
				patients[6], 'right', 1, 'scared', '01_player_popup_01'))
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shake_and_wakeup, self,
				patients[5], 'right', 1, 'scared', '01_player_popup_01'))
		wait_for_sec(1.2)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(patients[1], {name = 'idle'})
		character_util.shake(patients[1], 0.03, 2)
		for i = 3, 6 do
			character_util.set_emotion(patients[i], {name = 'idle'})
			character_util.shake(patients[i], 0.03, 2)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.8)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(patients[3], { key = 'future_castle_yuze_75_1', skip = true })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(patients[4], { key = 'future_castle_yuze_75_2', skip = true })

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(patients[1], {name = 'scared'})
		character_util.shake(patients[1], 0.03, 2)
		for i = 3, 6 do
			character_util.set_emotion(patients[i], {name = 'scared'})
			character_util.shake(patients[i], 0.03, 2)
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 여, 여보? 딸? 다들 어디갔어!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(patients[3], {name = 'cry'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(patients[3], { key = 'future_castle_yuze_75', skip = true })

		self.run_wall_routine = true
		-- 어서 깨어나! 깨어나라고!
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function ()
			while self.run_wall_routine do
				character_util.move_waypoint_async(patients[4], vector(57.5, 0, -104), 6, true)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
				self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(patients[4].Position + vector(0.3, 0.5, 0))
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(patients[4])
				character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(patients[4])
				local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, vector(-1, 0, 0),
						15000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
				local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(patients[4], knockback_info)
				patients[4].FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
				wait_for_sec(1)
			end
		end))
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(patients[4], {name = 'scared'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(patients[4], { key = 'future_castle_yuze_76', skip = true })

		-- 빙글빙글 도는 환자
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function ()
			local marker = field:GetMarker('guard_reset')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(patients[6], {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'cry'})
			while self.run_wall_routine do
				character_util.move_waypoint_async(patients[6], {
					patients[6].Position,
					vector(marker.position.x, 0, patients[6].Position.z),
					marker.position,
					vector(patients[6].Position.x, 0, marker.position.z),
					patients[6].Position}, 6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'none', true)
			end
		end))

		-- 아니지…? 이게… 현실인 거야?
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_emotion(patients[1], {name = 'scared'})
		character_util.set_anim(patients[1], {name = 'frustration', loop = false})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(patients[1], { key = 'future_castle_yuze_77', skip = true })

		-- 으아아아아아아아!
		-- 물건을 던지는 여자
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_linda_scream_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(patients[5], {name = 'attack'}, {name = 'cry'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(patients[5], { key = 'future_castle_yuze_78', skip = true })

		--- 화면 전환
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'remove_tint_white', 'immediate'}))
		camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})
		self.run_wall_routine = false
		--character_util.remove_anim(yuze)
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 하하…
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, {name = 'idle'})
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_79', skip = true })

		-- 하하하하…!
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'idle' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_80', skip = true })

		-- 하하하하하하하하하하하!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.5)
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_81', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

		-- 어때, 마음에 들어?
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(yuze)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_82', skip = true })

		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_82_0', skip = true })

		-- 내가 모두를 구하겠어. / …….
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'future_castle_yuze_82_1', 'mercy' }, { 'future_castle_yuze_82_2', 'brutal' } })
		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- …….
			character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'tired' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_83', skip = true })

			-- 그래, 넌 그런 사람이었지…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_84', skip = true })

			-- 가봐, 남은 사람들은 내가 어떻게든 챙겨볼게.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_85', skip = true })
		else
			-- …….
			character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'tired' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_86', skip = true })

			-- 가봐, 남은 사람들은 내가 어떻게든 챙겨볼게.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_87', skip = true })

			-- 넌 너의 일을 해.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_88', skip = true })
		end
	else
		self.abandon_yuze = true

		-- 그냥… 간다고?
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_89', skip = true })

		-- 이 상황을 보고?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_90', skip = true })

		-- 하, 하하…!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_91', skip = true })

		-- 그래 너도… 결국 이 사람들에게는 현실보다는 환상이 더 행복하다고 생각하는구나.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_92', skip = true })

		-- 결국… 네가 와도 변하는 건 없는 거였어.
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_93', skip = true })
	end
	self.controller.on_clear_yuze = true

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('last_room_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('last_room_door_2', false))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name .. 'yuze', false))
end

-- 보상방으로 향하는 도어를 지나가면 나오는 이벤트
function local_class:yuze_last()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'muted', mix = 2})
	-- 열려 있던 도어가 닫힌다.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('last_room_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('last_room_door_2', false))

	-- 유즈 포트레이트 달린 상태로 이야기.
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(yuze, 0, 1)

	-- 있잖아, 파트너.
	character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_94', skip = true,
														portraitname = 'succubus', screen_pos = vector(-300, 200) })

	-- 나도 드림 테라피를 받은 적이 있어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_95', skip = true,
														portraitname = 'succubus', screen_pos = vector(-300, 200) })

	-- 꿈 속에서 오늘처럼 네가 부유성에 돌아왔어.
	character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_96', skip = true,
														portraitname = 'succubus', screen_pos = vector(-300, 200) })

	-- 그리고 네가 정말 모든 문제를 해결해주는 거야.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'future_castle_yuze_97', skip = true,

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.75, fade_color, 'linear')

end

function local_class:illusion_tint_process()
	local tint_name = 'illusion'
	local transition_time = 2
	local colors = {
		unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.7 }),
		unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 0.7 }),
		unity_color({ 0, 0, 1, 0.7 }),
	}

	local rotate_speed = 0.1

	local current_color_idx = 1
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_color = unity_class.color.white
	local end_color = colors[current_color_idx]
	while self.is_illusion do

		self.screen_effect_level = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((user_party_leader.Position.z + 20) / -20)
		self.rotate_angle = self.screen_effect_level * 5
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local sin_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(2 * unity_class.mathf.PI * unity_class.time.time * rotate_speed)
		stage_camera.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(self.rotate_angle * sin_val, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / transition_time)
		local current_color = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_color, end_color, progress)
		if time_passed >= transition_time then
			time_passed = 0
			start_color = end_color
			current_color_idx = current_color_idx == #colors and 1 or current_color_idx + 1
			end_color = colors[current_color_idx]
		else
			field:Tint(tint_name, current_color, 0, 0.75)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	stage_camera.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
	field:RemoveTint(tint_name)
end


--- 페이드 이펙트 셋업
function local_class:screen_smoke_start(alpha)
	if self.is_smoke then return end
	self.is_smoke = true

	local custom_alpha = false

	if not float_util.almost_close_to(alpha, -1) then
		custom_alpha = true
	end

	local camera = stage_camera

	self.fade.obj = self.preset:Instantiate(
			camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
	self.fade.main_module = self.fade.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
	self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

	target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.fade.color.a * 0.2

	self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
			{ 0.2, 0.6, 0.3, target_alpha })

	self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
	self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

	local smoke_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_gas_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2})

	while self.is_smoke do
		self:screen_smoke_update(0.1 + self.screen_effect_level * 0.3)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	smoke_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.main_module = nil
		self.fade.color = nil
		self.fade.obj:Dispose()
		self.fade.obj = nil
	end
end

function local_class:screen_smoke_update(fade_alpha)
	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, fade_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
	end
end

function local_class:screen_smoke_color_refresh()
	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

function local_class:shake_and_wakeup(fo, dir, num, emotion_name, jump_sfx)
	local shake_num = lua_helper.get_or_default(num, 2)

	for i = 1, shake_num do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')

function local_class:on_event(e)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		return self:on_item_get_event(e)
	end

	return false

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local trainer = self.get_trainer()
	local boss = self.get_boss()
	local panda = self.get_panda()
	local man = self.get_man()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, trainer) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_trainer, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, boss) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, panda) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, man) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_trio, self)
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local box = self.get_box(i)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, box) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_trio, self)

	return false

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if not self.is_saw_mad_panda_boss_shout and not self.is_interact_mad_panda and e.Zone.Name == self.event_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mad_panda_boss_shout, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if not self.is_item_get_async_end then
		if self.item_get_async_target == nil or (self.item_get_async_target ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Getter, self.item_get_async_target)) then
			if e.Item.ItemId == self.item_get_async_item_id then
				self.is_item_get_async_end = true
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_trio()
	local boss = self.get_boss()
	local panda = self.get_panda()
	local man = self.get_man()
	local box = self.get_box(2)

	self.is_interact_mad_panda = true

	local trio_list = {
		boss,
		panda,
		man
	}

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trio_non_fight', state = 'event' })

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(boss)

	camera_util.move(box.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 1)
	party_util.align_party(box, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	boss:HideWeapon(true)
	panda:HideWeapon(true)
	man:HideWeapon(true)

	-- 상자에서 천천히 고개를 내밈.
	for i = 1, #trio_list do
		local trio = trio_list[i]

		trio.Position = vector(89 + i, -0.8, -38.5)
		character_util.move_to(trio, vector_util.get_x0z(trio.Position, 0.2), 1.4)
	end
	wait_for_sec(1.4)

	-- 다 내밀고 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 상자 뒤쪽으로 뛰어 나옴
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	for i = 1, #trio_list do
		local trio = trio_list[i]

		character_util.mario_jump_new(trio, 'left', 0.5, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to(trio, vector_util.get_x0z(trio.Position) + vector(0, 0, 0.75), 0.5, nil, false, false)

	self.is_item_get_async_end = false

		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 스타피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_boss = function() return get_character('trio_boss') end
	self.get_panda = function() return get_character('trio_panda') end
	self.get_man = function() return get_character('trio_man') end
	self.get_trainer = function() return get_character('trainer') end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_training_dummy = function(num) return get_field_object('trio_training_dummy_' .. num) end
	self.get_box = function(num) return get_field_object('trio_hide_box_' .. num) end

	-- 이펙트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_hit_effect = controller.get_hit_effect
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local box = self.get_box(i)
		box.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	local trainer = self.get_trainer()
	character_util.add_listener(trainer, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local box = self.get_box(i)
		box.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	local trainer = self.get_trainer()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(trainer, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local trainer = self.get_trainer()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, trainer) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_trainer, self)
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local box = self.get_box(i)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, box) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_box, self, i))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('FutureRachelsSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureRachels @
		Comment = 미래 부유성 레이첼 스타피스 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 아이템 이름
	self.rum_item_spec_name = 'pirate_rum'
	self.blue_rose_item_spec_name = 'rachel_blue_rose'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_pirate = function(num) return get_character('pirate_' .. num) end
	self.get_rachels = function() return get_character('rachels') end
	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end

	-- 스타피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_rum_barrel = function() return get_field_object('rum_barrel') end
	self.get_gravestone = controller.get_gravestone
	self.get_twinkle_object = function() return get_field_object('twinkle_blue_rose') end

	-- 이펙트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_twinkle_effect = controller.get_twinkle_effect
	self.get_water_splash_effect = controller.get_water_splash_effect

	-- item_get_async 에서 사용하는 아이템 id
	self.item_get_async_item_id = -1

	-- item_get_async 가 끝났는지
	self.is_item_get_async_end = true

	-- item_get_async 에서 사용하는 아이템을 습득하는 타겟
	self.item_get_async_target = nil

	-- 럼주를 얻었는가
	self.is_get_rum = false

	-- 해적의 수
	self.pirate_num = 3

	-- 이펙트
	self.twinkle_effect = nil

	-- 퀘스트 내부 프로그레스
	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		saw_pirate = 1,
		saw_rachels = 2,
		get_blue_rose = 3,
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')

	local pirate_position_list = {
		vector(47, 0, 47),
		vector(46, 0, 47),
		vector(48, 0, 47)
	}
	for i = 1, self.pirate_num do
		local pirate = self.get_pirate(i)

		pirate.Position = pirate_position_list[i]
		character_util.add_listener(pirate, self.controller)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')

	for i = 1, self.pirate_num do
		local pirate = self.get_pirate(i)

		character_util.remove_relate_event(pirate, self.controller)
	end

	if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		return self:on_item_get_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		return self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local twinkle_object = self.get_twinkle_object()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, twinkle_object) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_twinkle, self))
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, self.pirate_num do
		local pirate = self.get_pirate(i)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, pirate) then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_pirate, self)
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.get_blue_rose then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_pirate_2, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if not self.is_item_get_async_end then
		if self.item_get_async_target == nil or (self.item_get_async_target ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Getter, self.item_get_async_target)) then
			if e.Item.ItemId == self.item_get_async_item_id then
				self.is_item_get_async_end = true
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local rum_barrel = self.get_rum_barrel()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, rum_barrel) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.broken_rum_barrel, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

		local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo(nil, 0.05, duration, false)

			local diminish_factor = shake_info.diminishScale > 0 and unity_class.mathf(1 - (shake_info.timePassed / shake_info.duration) * shake_info.diminishScale) or 1
			local mag = shake_info.magnitude * diminish_factor
			local angle = unity_class.random.value * unity_class.mathf.PI * 2
			local shake_offset = vector(unity_class.mathf.Cos(angle) * 0.5 * mag, 0, unity_class.mathf.Sin(angle) * 0.5 * mag)

			shake_info.timePassed = shake_info.timePassed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			fo.Position = position + shake_offset

			coroutine.yield()

-- 아이템을 떨어트리고, 먹을 때 까지 기다린다.
function local_class:drop_item_and_get_async(from, to, item_name, scale)
	local pos = lua_helper.type_compare(from, unity_class.vector3) and from or from.Position
	local target = lua_helper.type_compare(to, unity_class.vector3) and to or to.Position

	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(item_name).Id
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = pos, target = target, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = scale, skip_text = true })

	if lua_helper.type_compare(to, CS.Oak.Character) then
		item.ConsumeTarget = to
	end

	self.item_get_async_item_id = item_id
	self.is_item_get_async_end = false
	self.item_get_async_target = to

	while not self.is_item_get_async_end do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('GaramAndMirrorWitchSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = GaramAndMirrorWitch @
		Comment = 거울 마녀와 첫 만남 - 대화 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress = {
		none = 1,
		look_blocked_door = 2,
		appear_witch = 3
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'witch_appear') and self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.look_blocked_door
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'witch_appear')  then
		local try_get_out = user_party.Leader.Position.z < e.Zone.Bounds.center.z

		if try_get_out and self.current_progress == self.progress.look_blocked_door then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.appear_witch

	return false

local local_class = newclass('GaramAndMirrorWitchSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute

		Comment = 거울 마녀와의 전투 - 엔딩 @
		Index = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress = {
		none = 1,
		battle_to_witch = 2,
		ending = 3
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_fo_destroyed_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local fake_witch = get_character('mirror_witch_fake')
	fake_witch.Position = vector(108.5, 0, 129.5)
	fake_witch.Direction = character_util.get_direction('up')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.progress = nil
	self.get_battle_witch = nil
	self.get_witch = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'battle_to_witch') and self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.battle_to_witch
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.battle_to_witch, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_character('mirror_witch_battle')) and self.current_progress == self.progress.battle_to_witch then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.ending

	end

	return false
end

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.twinkle_effect = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	-- 3스테이지를 클리어하고 재입장한 상태라면
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.controller.main_quest_id)
	if main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.InnerProgress >= 12 then
		local crystal = get_field_object('gas_room_crystal')
		crystal.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		local effect_offset = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
		self.twinkle_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle'):Instantiate(crystal.Position + effect_offset)
		self.twinkle_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

		quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(crystal)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.twinkle_effect = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local crystal = get_field_object('gas_room_crystal')
	if crystal ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, crystal) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.open_stage_event, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:open_stage_event()
	local crystal = get_field_object('gas_room_crystal')

	quest_icon_util.remove(crystal)
	party_util.align_party(crystal.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5, 'down')

	-- 크리스탈에서 페니의 기운이 느껴진다.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = self.controller.stage_name,
		substage_open_string_key = 'girl_in_red_pre_1'
	})

	self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
	local crystal = get_field_object('gas_room_crystal')
	crystal.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

	quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'scene_3' and not self.scene_3_zone_entered then
			self.scene_3_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_chaos, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_4' and not self.scene_4_zone_entered then
			self.scene_4_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_4_deadend, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_5' and not self.scene_5_zone_entered then
			self.scene_5_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_5_white_rat, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_6_start' and not self.scene_6_start_zone_entered then
			self.scene_6_start_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_6_intro, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_6_chase' and not self.scene_6_chase_zone_entered then
			self.scene_6_chase_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_6_chase, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_6_gateway' and not self.scene_6_has_passed_gateway then
			self.scene_6_has_passed_gateway = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_6_escape, self)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_8' and not self.scene_8_zone_entered then
			self.scene_8_zone_entered = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_8_penny_house, self)
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) and e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.discovered_event_name and not self.is_discovered then
			self.is_discovered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.discovered_by_soldier, self, e.Sender))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		-- 쓰레기통에 숨은 아이 npc와 대화
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.refugee_girl) and self.scene_3_talked_to_refugee_girl == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_talk_to_refugee_girl, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.scene_4_hole) and not self.scene_4_fell_into_hole then
			self.scene_4_fell_into_hole = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_4_fall, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.scene_4_hole) and self.scene_4_fell_into_hole then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_4_fall_recurring, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.invader_crystal) and self.scene_7_picked_up_crystal == false then
			self.scene_7_picked_up_crystal = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_7_pick_up_crystal, self))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then return false end

		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'grid_cave' then
			self:cave_setting()
			return true
		elseif e.CameraGrid.name == 'grid_steampunk' then
			self:steampunk_setting()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'scene_3' and not self.scene_3_zone_entered then
			self.scene_3_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_chaos, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_4' and not self.scene_4_zone_entered then
			self.scene_4_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_4_deadend, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_5' and not self.scene_5_zone_entered then
			self.scene_5_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_5_white_rat, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_5_exit' and not self.scene_5_exit_zone_entered then
			self.scene_5_exit_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_5_end, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) and e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.discovered_event_name and not self.is_discovered then
			self.is_discovered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.discovered_by_soldier, self, e.Sender))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.soldiers[1]) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.soldiers[3]) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.soldiers[4]) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.soldier_boy) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_talk_to_soldier, self, e.Target))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.refugees[2]) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_talk_to_refugee_2, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.refugee_girl) and self.scene_3_talked_to_refugee_girl == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_talk_to_refugee_girl, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.scene_4_hole) and not self.scene_4_fell_into_hole then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_4_fall, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.scene_4_hole) and self.scene_4_fell_into_hole then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_4_fall_recurring, self))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then return false end

		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'grid_cave' then
			self:cave_setting()
			return true
		elseif e.CameraGrid.name == 'grid_steampunk' then
			self:steampunk_setting()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:scene_3_talk_to_refugee_girl()
	-- UI를 숨긴다.
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤을 빼앗는다.
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 플레이어는 어디에서 말을 걸든 쓰레기통의 상단으로 이동한다.
	if user_party.Leader.Position.z < -31 then
		character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position +
			unity_class.vector3.forward * (-31 - user_party.Leader.Position.z), nil, 2, true, true)
	end

	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, self.refugee_girl.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward, nil, 2, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')

	-- (스위치 ON의 경우) 쓰레기통 #2: “미안한데 다른 데로 가주겠니?”
	if self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed == true then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_17', skip = true})

		-- UI를 표시한다.
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		-- 플레이어가 컨트롤을 되찾는다.
		user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- (스위치 OFF의 경우) 쓰레기통 #2: “미안… 여긴 내줄 수 없어. 대신 내가 문을 잡아줄게.”
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_16', skip = true})

		-- 소녀가 쓰레기통을 뒤집어 쓴 채로 스위치를 향해 걷는다.
		self.scene_3_fix_trash_can_position_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.fix_trash_can_position, self))

		character_util.show_emoticon(user_party.Leader, nil, 'happy')

		local pos_list_refugee_girl = {
			vector(1, 0, -31)
		}

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_grass_slide_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', duration = 1.125, fade_out_time = 2})

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.refugee_girl, pos_list_refugee_girl, 2, false, 'stop', 'floor', CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		-- 소녀가 스위치로 점프한다.
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')

		character_util.jump(self.refugee_girl, 0.05, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(self.refugee_girl, vector(1, 0, -32), 0.3, nil, true, true)

		-- 문이 열린다.
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.scene_3_door_bottom_left_name, false))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.scene_3_door_bottom_right_name, false))

		self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed = true
		self.scene_3_talked_to_refugee_girl = true

		get_character('refugee_girl').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

		stop_coroutine(self.scene_3_fix_trash_can_position_routine)

		-- UI를 표시한다.
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		-- 플레이어가 컨트롤을 되찾는다.
		user_party:ResetControllers()

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

		-- “어서!”
		character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_girl, 'left')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_18', skip = true})
		self.refugee_girl.Interactable.Talk = 'girl_in_red_s2_18'
	end
end

-- 쓰레기통 위치를 쓰레기통 소녀와 같도록 고정
function local_class:fix_trash_can_position()
	while true do
		self.trash_can.Position = self.refugee_girl.Position

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	}

	self.patrols[1].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

function local_class:scene_4_fall()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이동
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'girl_in_red_2', self.scene_5_stairs)

	-- 페니, 구멍으로 떨어진다.
	yield_return(self, 'fall_into_hole_routine', self.scene_4_hole.Position)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

    screen_util.fade_out_circular(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	-- 쥐들이 플레이어를 지켜보다가 놀라 도망간다.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))

		character_util.move_to_async(self.rats[3], self.rats[3].Position + unity_class.vector3.forward, 0.4, nil, true, true)
		character_util.move_to_async(self.rats[2], self.rats[2].Position + 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.right, 0.6, nil, true, true)

		-- 쥐들이 깜짝 놀라며 플레이어를 쳐다본다.
		for i = 1, 3 do
			character_util.remove_anim(self.rats[i])
			character_util.normal_jump(self.rats[i])
			character_util.look_at(self.rats[i], user_party.Leader)
			character_util.show_emoticon(self.rats[i], nil, 'notice')
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 쥐들이 머뭇거리다가 한마리가 용기를 내 페니의 생사를 확인한다.
		character_util.move_to_async(self.rats[1], self.rats[1].Position + 0.25 * unity_class.vector3.left, nil, 1, true, true)
		character_util.move_to_async(self.rats[3], self.rats[3].Position + 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.back, nil, 2, true, true)
		character_util.move_to_async(self.rats[2], self.rats[2].Position + 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.left, nil, 1.3, true, true)

		character_util.move_to_async(self.rats[1], vector(-8, 0, -101), nil, 2, true, true)
		character_util.set_anim(self.rats[1], {name = 'eat', loop = true})

		wait_for_sec(1.2)

		-- 쥐들이 부리나케 도망치기 시작한다.
		for i = 1, 3 do
			character_util.set_anim(self.rats[i], {name = 'embarrassed', loop = true})
			character_util.normal_jump(self.rats[i])
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_mouse_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

		character_util.move_to(self.rats[1], vector(35, 0, -101), nil, 9, true, true)
		character_util.move_to(self.rats[2], vector(35, 0, -102), nil, 9, true, true)
		character_util.move_to_async(self.rats[3], vector(-8, 0, -95), nil, 9, true, true)

		self.rats[3].Position = vector(-10, 0, -76)
		character_util.set_direction(self.rats[3], 'down')
	end))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 제국병 제거
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.patrols[3])
	character_util.stop(self.patrols[3])
	self.patrols[3].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- 페니, 폐광 바닥으로 추락
    local marker = stage.Field:GetMarker(self.cave_floor_marker_name)
    yield_return(self, 'land_on_routine', marker.position, marker.direction)
end

function local_class:scene_4_fall_recurring()

	-- 페니, 폐광 바닥으로 추락
    local marker = stage.Field:GetMarker(self.cave_floor_marker_name)

-- 구멍에 Interact해서 특정 위치로 떨어지는 이벤트
function local_class:fall_into_hole_routine(pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        user_party[i].SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.zero, 1)
        user_party[i].SpineController:Jump(2, 1)

-- 구멍에 Interact해서 특정 위치와 방향으로 착지하는 이벤트
function local_class:land_on_routine(pos, dir)
	-- 동굴 스팀펑크보다 더 어둡게
	field:Tint('girl_in_red', unity_color({0.25, 0.15, 0, 0.1}), 0)

	camera_util.move_async(pos, 0.1)

    screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

    local fall_time = 1
    local bounce_time = 0.5

    local fall_party_delay = fall_time / user_party.Count
    local bounce_party_delay = bounce_time / user_party.Count

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        user_party[i].SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

        character_util.set_position(user_party[i], pos + vector(0, 15, 0))
        character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], dir)
        character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'embarrassed'})
        character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'damaged'})

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(self.freefall_character, self, user_party[i], fall_time))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(fall_party_delay))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

	if not self.scene_4_fell_into_hole then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_die_mouse_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
	end

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        user_party[i].SpineController:Jump(1, bounce_time)

        character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'prostrate'})

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(user_party[i],
                        pos + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(dir) * CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * i,
                        bounce_time, nil, true))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(bounce_party_delay))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

		if not self.scene_4_fell_into_hole then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_mouse_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'confused'})

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2))

		-- 플레이어 일어남
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(user_party[i], 0.05, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'get'})
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.normal_jump_async(user_party[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
    end

    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(bounce_time - bounce_party_delay))

	-- 한 번이라도 구멍으로 떨어졌다는 걸 체크
	self.scene_4_fell_into_hole = true

	-- 카메라 다시 플레이어에게로
	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- UI를 표시한다.
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 플레이어가 컨트롤을 되찾는다.
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 일정 시간 동안 자유낙하하는 캐릭터 연출
function local_class:freefall_character(character, fall_time)
    local curtime = unity_class.time.time
    local falltime = fall_time
    local curpos = character.Position
    local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(falltime, curpos.y, 0);

    while unity_class.time.time - curtime < falltime do
        freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
        local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

        character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, curpos.y + dist_y, curpos.z), true)
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, 0, curpos.z))
end

-- 흰 쥐가 동굴 비밀 통로를 알려준다.
function local_class:scene_5_white_rat()

	character_util.move_to(self.rats[3], vector(-34, 0, -76), 0.3, nil, true, false)

	character_util.set_active_state(self.rats[3], 'disabled')
end

function local_class:scene_3_talk_to_soldier(detector)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 제국병 1, 3, 4, 소년단원이 플레이어를 쳐다본다.
	for i = 1, 4 do
		if i ~= 2 then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.soldiers[i])
			character_util.look_at(self.soldiers[i], user_party.Leader)
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.soldier_boy)
	character_util.look_at(self.soldier_boy, user_party.Leader)

	-- 제국병 1의 경우 플레이어를 쳐다보기만 하고 (자동 검거), 나머지는 쳐다본 후 검거 이벤트를 실행한다.
	if detector ~= self.soldiers[1] then
		yield_return(self, 'discovered_by_soldier', detector)
	end
end

function local_class:discovered_by_soldier(detector)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 발견자 소리지름
	character_util.normal_jump(detector)
	character_util.set_anim(detector, {name = 'release'})
	character_util.set_emotion(detector, {name = 'mad'})

	if detector == self.patrols[4] or detector == self.patrols[5] or detector == self.patrols[6] then
		for i = 4, 6 do
			character_util.stop(self.patrols[i])
			character_util.look_at(self.patrols[i], user_party.Leader)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_runaway_01'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01'})
	party_util.set_anim({name = 'embarrassed', loop = true})
	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'surprise'})

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i])
	end

	if detector == self.soldier_boy then
		-- 여기 캔터베리인이 있어요!!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(detector, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_5_alt', skip = true})
	else
		-- 거기 누구냐!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(detector, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_19', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true})
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if detector == self.patrols[4] or detector == self.patrols[5] or detector == self.patrols[6] then
		yield_return(self, 'stop_scene_6_chase_continued_coroutine')
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(detector, { 'reset', self.discovered_event_name }))

	local reset_pos_1 = vector(-4.5, 0, -20)
	local reset_pos_2 = vector(-4.5, 0, -47)
	local reset_pos_3 = vector(25.5, 0, -49)

	-- 다시 씬 시작 지점으로 돌아감
	if detector == self.patrols[3] then
		party_util.position_party(reset_pos_2, 'down', 'linear')
	elseif detector == self.patrols[4] or detector == self.patrols[5] or detector == self.patrols[6] then
		party_util.position_party(reset_pos_3, 'up', 'linear')
	else
		party_util.position_party(reset_pos_1, 'down', 'linear')
	end

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(detector)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(detector)

	self.is_discovered = false

	-- 다시 원상태로 복귀
	if detector == self.soldiers[1] or detector == self.soldiers[3] or detector == self.soldiers[4] or detector == self.soldier_boy then
		character_util.set_direction(self.soldiers[1], 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldiers[1], {name = 'release', loop = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.soldiers[1], {name = 'attack', loop = true})

		character_util.set_direction(self.soldiers[3], 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldiers[3], {name = 'cross_arm', loop = true})

		character_util.set_direction(self.soldiers[4], 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(self.soldiers[4], {name = 'doyagao', loop = true})

		character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_boy, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_boy, {name = 'release', loop = true, scale = 0.5})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.soldier_boy, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
	end

	if detector == self.patrols[4] or detector == self.patrols[5] or detector == self.patrols[6] then
		screen_util.fade_in(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		self.scene_6_chase_continued_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.scene_6_chase_continued, self))
	elseif detector == self.patrols[3] then
		screen_util.fade_in(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		character_util.set_direction(self.patrols[3], 'down')

		user_party:ResetControllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		self.patrols[3].Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		-- Waypoint 상태 초기화
		message_system:SendSync(self.patrols[3].FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	else
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		user_party:ResetControllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:soldier_hit_refugee()
	while true do
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.soldiers[2], vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)

		character_util.set_anim(self.soldiers[2], { name = 'attack', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = self.refugees[1], type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', max_distance = 6 })

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.refugees[1].Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(
				self.refugees[1], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 0.3, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(
				self.refugees[1], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

		character_util.remove_anim(self.soldiers[2])

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		-- 블록이 스위치를 누르고 있는지 체크
		local block = get_field_object('scene_3_pushable_block')

		-- 쓰레기통 소녀의 진로를 방해하는 범위에 있으면 스위치를 눌렀다고 판단
		if block.Position.z < -30 and block.Position.x > 0 and block.Position.x < 3 then
			if block.Position.x > 1.5 and block.Position.z < -31.5 then
				self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed = false
			else
				self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed = true
			end
		elseif block.Position == vector(1, 0, -32) then
			self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed = true
		else
			self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed = false
		end
	end
end

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'scene_5' and not self.scene_5_zone_entered then
			self.scene_5_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_5_white_rat, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_6_start' and not self.scene_6_start_zone_entered then
			self.scene_6_start_zone_entered = true
			self.scene_6_snore_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_6_snore, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_6_gateway' and not self.scene_6_has_passed_gateway then
			self.scene_6_has_passed_gateway = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_6_escape, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_8' and not self.scene_8_zone_entered then
			self.scene_8_zone_entered = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_8_penny_house, self)
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) and e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.discovered_event_name and not self.is_discovered then
			self.is_discovered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.discovered_by_soldier, self, e.Sender))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.soldiers[1]) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.soldiers[3]) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.soldiers[4]) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.soldier_boy) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_talk_to_soldier, self, e.Target))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.refugees[2]) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_talk_to_refugee_2, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.refugee_girl) and self.scene_3_talked_to_refugee_girl == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_talk_to_refugee_girl, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.scene_4_hole) and self.scene_4_fell_into_hole then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_4_fall_recurring, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.soldiers[6]) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_6_chase, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.invader_crystal) and self.scene_7_picked_up_crystal == false then
			self.scene_7_picked_up_crystal = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_7_pick_up_crystal, self))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then return false end

		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'grid_cave' then
			self:cave_setting()
			return true
		elseif e.CameraGrid.name == 'grid_steampunk' then
			self:steampunk_setting()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:scene_3_talk_to_refugee_girl()
	-- UI를 숨긴다.
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤을 빼앗는다.
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 플레이어는 어디에서 말을 걸든 쓰레기통의 상단으로 이동한다.
	if user_party.Leader.Position.z < -31 then
		character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position +
			unity_class.vector3.forward * (-31 - user_party.Leader.Position.z), nil, 2, true, true)
	end

	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, self.refugee_girl.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward, nil, 2, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')

	-- (스위치 ON의 경우) 쓰레기통 #2: “미안한데 다른 데로 가주겠니?”
	if self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed == true then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_17', skip = true})

		-- UI를 표시한다.
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		-- 플레이어가 컨트롤을 되찾는다.
		user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- (스위치 OFF의 경우) 쓰레기통 #2: “미안… 여긴 내줄 수 없어. 대신 내가 문을 잡아줄게.”
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_16', skip = true})

		-- 소녀가 쓰레기통을 뒤집어 쓴 채로 스위치를 향해 걷는다.
		self.scene_3_fix_trash_can_position_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.fix_trash_can_position, self))

		character_util.show_emoticon(user_party.Leader, nil, 'happy')

		local pos_list_refugee_girl = {
			vector(1, 0, -31)
		}

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_grass_slide_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', duration = 1.125, fade_out_time = 2})

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.refugee_girl, pos_list_refugee_girl, 2, false, 'stop', 'floor', CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		-- 소녀가 스위치로 점프한다.
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')

		character_util.jump(self.refugee_girl, 0.05, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(self.refugee_girl, vector(1, 0, -32), 0.3, nil, true, true)

		-- 문이 열린다.
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.scene_3_door_bottom_left_name, false))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.scene_3_door_bottom_right_name, false))

		self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed = true
		self.scene_3_talked_to_refugee_girl = true

		get_character('refugee_girl').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

		stop_coroutine(self.scene_3_fix_trash_can_position_routine)

		-- UI를 표시한다.
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		-- 플레이어가 컨트롤을 되찾는다.
		user_party:ResetControllers()

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

		-- “어서!”
		character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_girl, 'left')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_18', skip = true})
		self.refugee_girl.Interactable.Talk = 'girl_in_red_s2_18'
	end
end

-- 구멍에 Interact해서 특정 위치로 떨어지는 이벤트
function local_class:fall_into_hole_routine(pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        user_party[i].SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.zero, 1)
        user_party[i].SpineController:Jump(2, 1)

        character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'get'})

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(user_party[i], pos + vector(0, -1, 0), 0.5, nil, true))
    end

end

-- 구멍에 Interact해서 특정 위치와 방향으로 착지하는 이벤트
function local_class:land_on_routine(pos, dir)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 동굴 스팀펑크보다 더 어둡게
	field:Tint('girl_in_red', unity_color({0.25, 0.15, 0, 0.1}), 0)

	camera_util.move(pos, 0.1)

    screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

    local fall_time = 1
    local bounce_time = 0.5

    local fall_party_delay = fall_time / user_party.Count
    local bounce_party_delay = bounce_time / user_party.Count

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        user_party[i].SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

        character_util.set_position(user_party[i], pos + vector(0, 15, 0))
        character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], dir)
        character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'embarrassed'})
        character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'damaged'})

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(self.freefall_character, self, user_party[i], fall_time))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(fall_party_delay))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        user_party[i].SpineController:Jump(1, bounce_time)

        character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'prostrate'})

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(user_party[i],
                        pos + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(dir) * CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * i,
                        bounce_time, nil, true))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(bounce_party_delay))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'confused'})

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2))

		-- 플레이어 일어남
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(user_party[i], 0.05, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'get'})
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.normal_jump_async(user_party[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
    end

    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(bounce_time - bounce_party_delay))

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
	end

	-- 카메라 다시 플레이어에게로
	camera_util.move(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	-- UI를 표시한다.
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 플레이어가 컨트롤을 되찾는다.
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 일정 시간 동안 자유낙하하는 캐릭터 연출
function local_class:freefall_character(character, fall_time)
    local curtime = unity_class.time.time
    local falltime = fall_time
    local curpos = character.Position
    local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(falltime, curpos.y, 0);

    while unity_class.time.time - curtime < falltime do
        freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
        local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

        character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, curpos.y + dist_y, curpos.z), true)
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, 0, curpos.z))
end

function local_class:discovered_by_soldier(detector)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 발견자 소리지름
	character_util.normal_jump(detector)
	character_util.set_anim(detector, {name = 'release'})
	character_util.set_emotion(detector, {name = 'mad'})

	if detector == self.patrols[4] or detector == self.patrols[5] or detector == self.patrols[6] then
		for i = 4, 6 do
			if self.patrols[i] ~= detector then
				character_util.stop(self.patrols[i])
				character_util.look_at(self.patrols[i], user_party.Leader)
			end
		end
		yield_return(self, 'stop_scene_6_chase_continued_coroutine')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_runaway_01'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01'})
	party_util.set_anim({name = 'embarrassed', loop = true})
	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'surprise'})

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i])
	end

	if detector == self.soldier_boy then
		-- 여기 캔터베리인이 있어요!!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(detector, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_5', skip = true})
	elseif detector == self.patrols[4] then
		-- Sight 범위가 넓어 대사가 보이지 않을 가능성이 크기 때문에 아무 말도 하지 않는다.
	else
		-- 거기 누구냐!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(detector, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_19', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true})
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(detector, { 'reset', self.discovered_event_name }))

	local reset_pos_1 = vector(-4.5, 0, -20)
	--local reset_pos_2 = vector(-4.5, 0, -49)
	local reset_pos_3 = vector(25.5, 0, -49)

	-- 다시 씬 시작 지점으로 돌아감
	if detector == self.patrols[4] or detector == self.patrols[5] or detector == self.patrols[6] then
		party_util.position_party(reset_pos_3, 'up', 'linear')
	else
		party_util.position_party(reset_pos_1, 'down', 'linear')
	end

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(detector)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(detector)

	self.is_discovered = false

	-- 다시 원상태로 복귀
	if detector == self.soldiers[1] or detector == self.soldiers[3] or detector == self.soldiers[4] or detector == self.soldier_boy then
		character_util.set_direction(self.soldiers[1], 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldiers[1], {name = 'release', loop = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.soldiers[1], {name = 'attack', loop = true})

		character_util.set_direction(self.soldiers[3], 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldiers[3], {name = 'cross_arm', loop = true})

		character_util.set_direction(self.soldiers[4], 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(self.soldiers[4], {name = 'doyagao', loop = true})

		character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_boy, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_boy, {name = 'release', loop = true, scale = 0.5})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.soldier_boy, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
	end

	if detector == self.patrols[4] or detector == self.patrols[5] or detector == self.patrols[6] then
		screen_util.fade_in(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		self.scene_6_chase_continued_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.scene_6_chase_continued, self))
	else
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		user_party:ResetControllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:soldier_hit_refugee()
	while true do
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.soldiers[2], vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)

		character_util.set_anim(self.soldiers[2], { name = 'attack', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = self.refugees[1], type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', max_distance = 6 })

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.refugees[1].Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(
				self.refugees[1], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 0.3, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(
				self.refugees[1], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

		character_util.remove_anim(self.soldiers[2])

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		-- 블록이 스위치를 누르고 있는지 체크
		local block = get_field_object('scene_3_pushable_block')

		-- 쓰레기통 소녀의 진로를 방해하는 범위에 있으면 스위치를 눌렀다고 판단
		if block.Position.z < -30 and block.Position.x > 0 and block.Position.x < 3 then
			if block.Position.x > 1.5 and block.Position.z < -31.5 then
				self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed = false
			else
				self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed = true
			end
		elseif block.Position == vector(1, 0, -32) then
			self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed = true
		else
			self.scene_3_door_switch_bottom_pressed = false
		end
	end
end
