local local_class = newclass('GnomePilotSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_pilot = function() return get_character('gnome_pilot') end
	self.get_requester = function() return get_character('pilot_requester_female') end
	self.get_babo =  function() return get_character('babo_gnome') end
	self.get_ddong = function(num) return get_character('ddong_' .. num) end
	self.get_doctor = function() return get_character('infinite_doctor') end
	self.get_assist = function() return get_character('infinite_assist') end
	self.get_fat_gnome = function() return get_character('fat_gnome') end

	self.get_invader_soldier = function(num) return get_character('invader_soldier_' .. num) end
	self.get_second_invader = function(num) return get_character('second_invader_' .. num) end

	self.get_hold_object = function(num) return get_field_object('pilot_hold_object_' .. num) end
	self.get_hold_invisible = function() return get_field_object('pilot_hold_object') end
	self.get_bomb = function(num) return get_field_object('pilot_bomb_grass_' .. num) end
	self.get_hold_bomb = function() return get_field_object('pilot_hold_bomb') end

	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_fx_lasthit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit') end

	self.is_object_following = false

	self.is_looking_around = false
	self.look_around_coroutine = nil

	self.progress = {
		pre = 0,	-- 아직 이벤트 발동 안됨
		doing = 1,	-- 이벤트 진행 중. Stop되지 않음
		post = 2,	-- 이벤트 끝남(혹은 강제로 멈춤)
	}

	self.first_scene_progress = self.progress.pre
	self.second_scene_progress = self.progress.pre

	-- 씬 시작 시 True로, stop_request가 들어오면 특정 구간이 끝날 때 까지 기다렸다가 False로 바뀜
	self.is_scene_playing = false

	self.is_request_stop = false

	self.berry_id = 20131
	self.berry_item = nil

	--region 씬 3
	self.is_scene_started = false

	self.resholder = nil
	self.invader_body_spine = nil

	self.hide_offset = -16
	self.show_offset = 0

	self.battle_zone_name = 'pilot_help_3'
	self.wave_1_name = 'pilot_battle_1'
	self.wave_2_name = 'pilot_battle_2'

	self.qte_count = 0

	self.qte_success = false

	self.is_bomb_following = false

	self.is_during_battle = false
	--endregion
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()

	self:set_first_scene()
	self:set_second_scene()
	self:set_third_scene()

	self:start_looking_around(vector(15, 1, 1))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if self.berry_item ~= nil then
		self.berry_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.berry_item = nil
	end

	self.look_around_coroutine = nil

	self.progress = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.resholder) then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
		self.resholder = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.invader_body_spine) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.invader_body_spine.gameObject)
		self.invader_body_spine = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		self:on_item_get_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.FullEnter then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'pilot_help_1' and self.first_scene_progress == self.progress.pre then
			self.first_scene_progress = self.progress.doing
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_first_scene, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'pilot_help_2' and self.second_scene_progress == self.progress.pre then
			self.second_scene_progress = self.progress.doing
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_second_scene, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.battle_zone_name and not self.is_scene_started then
			self.is_scene_started = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.before_battle, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.FullLeave then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'pilot_cave_grid' and self.second_scene_progress == self.progress.doing then
			self.second_scene_progress = self.progress.post
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stop_second_scene, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)
			or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'table_1' and self.first_scene_progress == self.progress.doing then
			self.first_scene_progress = self.progress.post
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stop_first_scene, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if e.Item.ItemId == self.berry_id
			and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Getter, self.get_babo()) and self.berry_item ~= nil then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))
		self.berry_item = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.wave_1_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.active_wave_2, self))

	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.wave_2_name then
		self.is_during_battle = false
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.after_battle, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.is_during_battle then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action2TouchDown then
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_fat_gnome())
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_fat_gnome(),
					{ key = 'nightmare_titantavern_1_during_battle', offset = vector(2.5, 3, 0) } )
			return true
		end
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp and self.qte_count == 1 then
		self.qte_success = true
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown and self.qte_count == 0 then
		self.qte_success = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 에이든 두리번거리는 루틴 시작
function local_class:start_looking_around(pos)
	self.get_pilot().Position = pos
	self.get_pilot().Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.look_around_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.look_around_routine, self))
end

function local_class:stop_looking_around()
	self.is_looking_around = false
end

function local_class:look_around_routine()
	self.is_looking_around = true

	local pilot = self.get_pilot()

	while self.is_looking_around do
		pilot.Direction = direction_util.get_opposite(pilot.Direction)
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	self.look_around_coroutine = nil
end

function local_class:set_first_scene()
	local center_pos = vector(24, 0, 0)

	--self.get_hold_invisible().Position = center_pos
	self.get_hold_object(2).Position = center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	self.get_hold_object(3).Position = center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	self.get_hold_object(1).Position = center_pos + vector(0, 0.7, 0)

	self.get_requester().Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

function local_class:start_first_scene()
	self.is_scene_playing = true
	self:first_scene()
	self.is_scene_playing = false
end

function local_class:stop_first_scene()
	local pilot = self.get_pilot()
	local female = self.get_requester()

	self.is_request_stop = true
	self:stop_looking_around()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pilot)
	character_util.stop(pilot)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(pilot)
	character_util.spine_rotate(pilot, 0, 0)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(female)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(female)

	while self.is_scene_playing do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.is_object_following = false

	for i = 1, 3 do
		self.get_hold_object(i).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

		message_system:SendSync(self.get_hold_invisible(), CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		self.get_hold_invisible().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(female, 'disabled')
	pilot.Position = vector(6, 0, -83.5)

	--character_util.set_active_state(pilot, 'disabled')
	while self.look_around_coroutine ~= nil do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

function local_class:object_follow_target(fo, target)
	local dif = fo.Position - target.Position

	while self.is_object_following do
		fo.Position = target.Position + dif
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:set_second_scene()
	self.get_babo().SpineController:Scale(0.5 * unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	self.get_babo().Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	for i = 1, 4 do
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.get_ddong(i), CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		self.get_ddong(i).CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end
end

function local_class:start_second_scene()
	self.is_request_stop = false
	self.is_scene_playing = true
	self:second_scene()
	self.is_scene_playing = false
end

function local_class:stop_second_scene()
	local pilot = self.get_pilot()
	local babo = self.get_babo()

	self.is_request_stop = true
	self:stop_looking_around()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pilot)
	character_util.stop(pilot)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(pilot)
	character_util.spine_rotate(pilot, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(pilot, 'disabled')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(babo)
	character_util.stop(babo)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(babo)
	character_util.set_active_state(babo, 'disabled')

	if self.berry_item ~= nil then
		self.berry_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.berry_item = nil
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local ddong = self.get_ddong(i)
		character_util.stop(ddong)
		character_util.set_active_state(ddong, 'disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:load_big_invader_routine()
	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'characters/big_invader_fat', 'big_invader_fat', function(prefab)
				if not is_unity_null(prefab) then
					local body_obj = CS.UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(prefab)
					body_obj.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)

					self.invader_body_spine = body_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
					self.invader_body_spine.IsShadowActive = false
					self.invader_body_spine:UseBend(false)
					self.invader_body_spine:SetSortingLayer('Under Effects', -999)
					self.invader_body_spine.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2.0
				end
			end)
end

function local_class:active_wave_2()
	local monster_count = 6
	local wait_list = {}
	local pos_list = {
		vector(81, 0, -7),
		vector(81, 0, -11),
		vector(83, 0, -8),
		vector(83, 0, -10),
		vector(84, 0, -6),
		vector(84, 0, -12),
	}

	for i = 1, monster_count do
		local invader = self.get_second_invader(i)

		table.insert(wait_list,
				util.cs_generator(screen_util.invader_transfer_async, pos_list[i], CS.Oak.Direction.Left, invader))
	end

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({
		name = 'bgm_inn', state = 'field'
	})
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true

	wait_all(wait_list)

	for i = 1, monster_count do
		local invader = self.get_second_invader(i)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(invader, self.wave_2_name, self.battle_zone_name)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(invader, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	end
end

function local_class:big_invader_appear(pos, dur)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, self.hide_offset)

	self.invader_body_spine:SetAnimation(0, 'idle', true)
	self.invader_body_spine.Transform.localPosition = start_pos

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < dur do
		local normalized = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((unity_class.time.time - start_time) / dur)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.hide_offset, self.show_offset, normalized)

		self.invader_body_spine.Transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, cur_y)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.invader_body_spine.Transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, self.show_offset)
end

function local_class:play_qte(dir)
	self.qte_success = false
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(dir)

	while not self.qte_success do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)
end

--endregion

function local_class:falling_vishuvac()
	local vishuvac = get_character('vishuvac')
	local duration = 0.25
	local time_passed = 0
	local target_pos = get_character('teatan_ranger_red').Position
	local start_y = 15

	vishuvac.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * start_y
	coroutine.yield()

	vishuvac.Position = target_pos
	vishuvac.SpineController.ShadowScale = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		vishuvac.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_y, 0, progress)
		vishuvac.SpineController.ShadowScale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 3, progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	vishuvac.Position = target_pos
	vishuvac.SpineController.ShadowScale = 1
	vishuvac.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_volcano_explosion'):Instantiate(target_pos)

function local_class:give_starpiece()
	local red = get_character('teatan_ranger_red')

	quest_icon_util.remove(red)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(red, self.controller)

	-- 메인 퀘스트 프로그레스를 검사하여 에일리를 정렬할지 판단

	character_util.look_at(red, user_party.Leader)
	red:RemoveEmotion()
	red:RemoveAnimation()

	-- 아까는 도와주셔서 감사합니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red, { key = 'greens_identity_35', skip = true })

	-- 이건 오늘 우연히 얻은 물건인데, 조금이라도 보답이 되었으면 합니다.

	local star_piece = get_field_object('teatan_ranger_starpiece')

	red:SetAnimation('release', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red, { key = 'greens_identity_37', skip = true })
	red:RemoveAnimation()

	local green = get_character('teatan_ranger_green')
	local sfx_cb = function(_, _)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(green.Position)

		green:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.05)

	character_util.look_at(red, green)
	red:SetEmotion('mad', true)
	character_util.set_anim(red, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = true, sfx_name = sfx_cb })

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	if align_ailie then

		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(ailie, user_party, 0, 0, true,
				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
		ailie:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	end
end

end

function local_class:eva_appear()
	local door = get_field_object('house_1_in')
	local eva = get_character('eva')
	local princess = user_party[1]

	party_util.align_to_target(door.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5, 'down')

	-- 노크 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_doorknock_01'})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dualgun_attack_right' })
	wait_for_sec(0.67)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	local princess_point = door.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2 + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5
	local leader_point = door.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2 + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_way_points_async, user_party.Leader, { waypoints = leader_point, speed = 2, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_way_points_async, princess, { waypoints = princess_point, speed = 2, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up })
	})

	-- 지옥의 공연을 방해하는 자…  누구인가?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_1', skip = true,
													   world_pos = door.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5 })

	-- 트릭 오어 트릿! / 돌아간다.
	local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'halloween_door_choose_1', 'mercy' }, { 'halloween_door_choose_2', 'brutal' } })
	if choose == 2 then return end

	-- 트릭 오어 트리이잇!
	character_util.normal_double_jump(princess, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bell_02', type_priority = 'event' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'halloween_princess_trick_or_treat', skip = true })

	-- 고, 공주님?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01' })
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_2', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true,
													   world_pos = door.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5 })

	-- 에바를 완전히 투명하게 만들어줌.
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(eva, 0, 0)
	eva.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
	coroutine.yield()

	eva.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	eva.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
	eva.Position = door.Position + unity_class.vector3.back
	eva:RemoveEmotion()
	eva:RemoveAnimation()

	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, eva)
	character_util.look_at(princess, eva)

	-- 에바 등장 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_door_push_01' })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(eva, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 공주님! 안으로 들어오시죠!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' })
	eva:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	eva:SetAnimation('hold_loop', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_4', skip = true})

	user_party.Leader:RemoveAnimation()
	princess:RemoveAnimation()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_stage_in_teleport_01' })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	eva.Position = field:GetMarker('eva_reset').position
	eva.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	eva:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	eva:RemoveAnimation()

	party_util.position_party(eva.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 자, 공주님! 여기 사탕입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' })
	eva:SetAnimation('hold_loop', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_5', skip = true})

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})

	eva:SetAnimation('eat', true)

	-- 에바가 사탕을 겁나 뿌려줌
	self.stop_give = false
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eva_give_many_candies, self))

	local wait_get_item = true
	local get_item_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Getter, princess) then
				wait_get_item = false
			end
		end
	}
	message_system:Subscribe(get_item_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'callback')

	-- 공주가 아이템을 먹을떄까지 대기
	while wait_get_item do coroutine.yield() end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(get_item_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))

	-- 와아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01' })
	princess:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	princess:SetAnimation('success', true)
	character_util.add_animation_sfx(princess, '01_small_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_6', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 이… 이제 충분해!
	princess:SetEmotion('tired', true)
	princess:RemoveAnimation()
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_7', skip = true})

	-- 사탕을 그만주게함.
	self.stop_give = true
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	self.throw_sfx:Stop()

	-- 그, 그렇습니까?
	eva:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
	eva:RemoveAnimation()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' })
	character_util.normal_jump(eva)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_8', skip = true})

	princess:RemoveEmotion()
	eva:SetEmotion('tired', true)

	-- 나는? / 너무 과했어.
	local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'halloween_basket_catch_new_9', 'mercy' }, { 'halloween_basket_catch_new_10', 'brutal' } })

	if choose == 1 then
		-- 흠… 여기있다.
		eva:RemoveEmotion()
		eva:SetAnimation('cross_arm', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_11', skip = true})

		-- TODO: 유틸로 만들어도 될듯
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })
		drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = eva.Position, target = user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, itemid = 20086,
									 lootstate = 'FixLooter', skip_text = true})
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		-- 과도한 당분은 몸을 둔하게 한다.
		eva:SetEmotion('attack', true)
		eva:SetAnimation('release', true)
		character_util.add_animation_sfx(eva, '01_swing_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_12', skip = true})

		-- 유념하도록.
		eva:RemoveAnimation()
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_13', skip = true})
		eva:RemoveEmotion()
	else
		-- 네가 신경쓸 것 없다, 신참.
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01'})
		eva:SetEmotion('attack', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_14', skip = true})
	end

	-- 그보다 신참, 지금 콘서트 뒷풀이로 조그만 놀이를 하고 있다.
	eva:SetAnimation('cross_arm', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_15', skip = true})

	-- 실수 없이 성공하는 사람에게 상품을 주고 있지.
	eva:SetAnimation('release', true)
	character_util.add_animation_sfx(eva, '01_swing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_16', skip = true})

	-- 관심있으면 참가해 보도록.
	eva:RemoveAnimation()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_17', skip = true})

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'get_candy', 'basket_catch_game' }))

	-- 도어 상호작용체를 원래대로 되돌려줌
	door.Interactable = self.cached_door_interactable

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:eva_give_many_candies()
	local eva = get_character('eva')
	local princess = user_party[1]
	local cycle = 0.5
	local throwed = false

	local time_passed = 0
	while not self.stop_give do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= cycle then
			time_passed = 0
			for _ = 1, 4 do
				local point = vector_util.get_random_point_in_circle(eva.Position, 1)
				local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = eva.Position, target = point, itemid = 20086,
														  lootstate = 'FixLooter', skip_text = true})
				item.ConsumeTarget = princess
			end

			-- 사탕을 처음 던져주는 거라면 소리 재생
			if not throwed then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_snowball_hit_01'})

				self.throw_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_throw_01', loop = true})
			end

			throwed = true
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

end

function local_class:set_vignette_radius(target_scale, duration)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_rad = stage.FieldUIVignette.Radius

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - start_time) / duration
		stage.FieldUIVignette.Radius = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_rad, target_scale, progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('HalloweenLoopSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = HalloweenLoop @
		Comment = 할로윈 1~5회차 루프 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'halloween_loop'
	self.quest_marker_door_name = 'halloween_loop_door'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.event_zone_name = controller.event_zone_name
	self.exit_event_zone_name = 'halloween_loop_2'

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.item_spec_name = 'candy'

	-- Custom State key
	self.custom_state_is_loop = controller.custom_state_is_loop
	self.custom_state_loop_count = controller.custom_state_loop_count

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end
	self.get_pumpkin_kid = function() return get_character('pumpkin_kid') end
	self.get_miya = function() return get_character('miya') end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_house_door = function(num) return get_field_object('house_' .. num .. '_in') end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_start_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('default_start') end

	-- 이펙트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_hit_effect = controller.get_hit_effect

	-- 호박머리 꼬마가 넘어지는 이벤트를 보았는가
	self.is_saw_falldown_event = false

	-- 호박머리 꼬마를 붙잡아 줬는가
	self.is_catch_pumpkin_kid = false

	-- 미야가 찾아왔는가
	self.is_miya_come = false

	-- 미야와의 이야기를 끝냈는가
	self.is_talk_miya = false

	-- 요괴에 대한 이야기를 들었는가
	self.is_heard_monster = false

	-- 집에 들어가서 미니게임을 끝냈는가
	self.is_get_candy = false

	self.mini_game_exit_door_list = {
		shell_game = vector(8.5, 1.5, 19),
		basket_catch_game = vector(95.5, 1.5, 18),
		red_green = vector(51.5, 1.5, 23),
	}

	-- 루프 횟수
	self.loop_count = 0

	-- 마지막 루프 횟수
	self.last_loop_count = 3

	-- waiting 함수 request id
	self.waiting_req_id = 0

	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_subscribe_touch_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.loop_count = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_loop_count)
	if self.loop_count == -1 then
		self.loop_count = 0
	end

	local pumpkin_kid = self.get_pumpkin_kid()

	if self.loop_count ~= self.last_loop_count then
		pumpkin_kid.Position = vector(12, 0, 2)

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local house_door = self.get_house_door(i)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_door_name .. i, house_door)
		end
	else
		local miya = self.get_miya()

		-- 분명 이 주변 어디에 있는 게 느껴지는데...
		miya.Interactable.Talk = 'halloween_loop_33'
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 현재 진행중인 루프에서 첫 진입일 때만, 스테이지 시작 연출을 보여줌.
	-- 이외에, 마지막 루프인 경우에는, 첫 진입이더라도 보여주지 않음.
	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_is_loop) <= 0 then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_princess, self)
	end

	if self.loop_count == self.last_loop_count then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.waiting, self))
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(quest_util.set_custom_state, self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_is_loop, 1))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	if self.is_subscribe_touch_event then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
	end

	local miya = self.get_miya()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(miya, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if not self.is_saw_falldown_event and self.loop_count ~= self.last_loop_count and e.Zone.Name == self.event_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pumpkin_kid_fall_down, self))
				return true
			elseif self.is_talk_miya and e.Zone.Name == self.exit_event_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.see_all_events, self)
				return true
			end

			if self.is_get_candy then
				if e.Zone.Name == 'shell_game' or e.Zone.Name == 'basket_catch_game' or e.Zone.Name == 'red_green' or e.Zone.Name == 'ghost_story' then
					local game_name = e.Zone.Name
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_door_name, self.mini_game_exit_door_list[game_name])
					return true
				elseif e.Zone.Name == 'street' then
					if not self.is_talk_miya then
						local miya = self.get_miya()
						quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, miya)
						return true
					else
						quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, vector(37.5, 1.5, 0))
						return true
					end
				end
			else
				if e.Zone.Name == 'street' and self.loop_count ~= self.last_loop_count then
					for i = 1, 3 do
						local house_door = self.get_house_door(i)
						quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_door_name .. i, house_door)
					end
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'street' then
				self.waiting_req_id = self.waiting_req_id + 1

				if not self.is_get_candy then
					for i = 1, 4 do
						quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_door_name .. i)
					end
					return true
				else
					quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
					return true
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'shell_game' or e.Zone.Name == 'basket_catch_game' or e.Zone.Name == 'red_green' or e.Zone.Name == 'ghost_story' then
				if self.is_get_candy then
					quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_door_name)

					if not self.is_miya_come then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.miya_come_to_house, self))
					end
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local miya = self.get_miya()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, miya) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_miya, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'get_candy' then
		if not self.is_get_candy then
			self:get_candy()
		end

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_door_name, self.mini_game_exit_door_list[e:GetParamAt(1)])

		return true
	end

	local mini_game_list = {
		'shell_game',
		'basket_catch_game',
		'red_green',
	}

	for i = 1, #mini_game_list do
		local game_name = mini_game_list[i]

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == game_name then
			if e:GetParamAt(1) == 'start' then
				if self.is_get_candy then
					quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_door_name)
				end
			elseif e:GetParamAt(1) == 'end' then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_door_name, self.mini_game_exit_door_list[game_name])
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 호박을 뒤집어 쓴 꼬맹이가 넘어지는 이벤트
function local_class:pumpkin_kid_fall_down()
	local pumpkin_kid = self.get_pumpkin_kid()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	self.is_saw_falldown_event = true

	pumpkin_kid.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(pumpkin_kid, pumpkin_kid.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0), 3, true, nil, nil, nil, true)

	if self.loop_count == 0 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = pumpkin_kid, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_comic_01', parent = pumpkin_kid, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	end
	character_util.set_anim(pumpkin_kid, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	pumpkin_kid.Position = pumpkin_kid.Position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(pumpkin_kid, 30, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	if self.loop_count > 0 then
		local is_close = false
		local duration = 1
		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < duration do
			local distance = (user_party.Leader.Position - pumpkin_kid.Position).magnitude

			if distance <= 1.25 then
				is_close = true
				break
			end

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if is_close then
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			if self.loop_count == 1 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_tap_guide_01')
			end
			yield_return_func(self.qte_swipe, self, 'right')
			if self.loop_count == 1 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_qte_complete_01')
			end

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, pumpkin_kid.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 4, false, nil, nil, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'push' })
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_small_01')
			character_util.set_anim(pumpkin_kid, { name = 'idle', mix_duration = 1 })
			character_util.spine_rotate(pumpkin_kid, 0, 1)
			character_util.move_to(pumpkin_kid, pumpkin_kid.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
			character_util.remove_anim(pumpkin_kid)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			if self.loop_count == 1 then
				-- 2회차 루프때의 펌킨 키드 반응
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
				character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
				character_util.set_anim(pumpkin_kid, { name = 'victory_extra' })
				wait_for_sec(0.633 * 4)
			elseif self.loop_count == 2 then
				-- 3회차 루프때의 펌킨 키드 반응
				wait_all({
					util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, user_party.Leader, pumpkin_kid.Position + vector(-1.25, 0, 0), 4, false, nil, nil, 'right'),
					util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, princess, pumpkin_kid.Position + vector(-1.25, 0, -0.5), 4, false, nil, nil, 'right')
				})
				wait_for_sec(1)

				-- …
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pumpkin_kid, { key = 'halloween_loop_13', skip = true })

				character_util.move_waypoint_async(pumpkin_kid, { pumpkin_kid.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), princess.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0) }, 7, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)

				local attack_callback = function()
					local direction = vector(-1, 0, 0)
					local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, direction, 10000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

					wait_for_sec(0.2)
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_small_01')

					self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(princess.Position + vector(0.2, 0.3, 0))
					command_util.publish_knock_back(princess.Owner, princess, knockback_info, nil)

					character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
					character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'damaged' })
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(princess)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(princess)

					character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
				end
				character_util.set_anim(pumpkin_kid, { name = 'attack' })
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(attack_callback))
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
			end

			character_util.remove_anim(pumpkin_kid)
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(pumpkin_kid, pumpkin_kid.Position + vector(12, 0, 0), 7, true, nil, nil, nil, true)
			character_util.set_active_state(pumpkin_kid, 'disabled')

			if self.loop_count == 2 then
				-- 3회차 루프때의 펌킨 비드 반응 이후의 연출
				character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position:Get0Yz(princess.Position.x), 7, true, nil, nil, 'down', true)

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
				character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'cry' })
				character_util.shake(princess, 0.02, 2)
				wait_for_sec(1)

				character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'push' })
				wait_for_sec(1)

				character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
				character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'idle', mix_duration = 0 })
				character_util.normal_jump_async(princess, true)
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				-- 고마워…
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
				character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'halloween_loop_14', skip = true })

				-- 갑자기 얻어맞아서 놀랐지만…
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'halloween_loop_15', skip = true })

				-- 네가 곁에 있어주니까 괜찮아!
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
				character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'halloween_loop_16', skip = true })

				-- 자, 어서 캔디를 받으러 가자!
				character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'halloween_loop_17', skip = true })

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
			end

			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()

			self.is_catch_pumpkin_kid = true

			return
		end
	else
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_trip_01', parent = pumpkin_kid, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim(pumpkin_kid, { name = 'falldown', loop = false })
	character_util.spine_rotate(pumpkin_kid, 0, 0)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(pumpkin_kid, 0.02, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01', parent = fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pumpkin_kid)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(pumpkin_kid, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(pumpkin_kid, vector(40, 0, 2), 7, true, nil, nil, nil, true)
	character_util.set_active_state(pumpkin_kid, 'disabled')
end

-- 미니 게임을 클리어 했을 때, 미야에게 대화할 수 있게 세팅
function local_class:get_candy()
	self.is_get_candy = true

	local miya = self.get_miya()
	character_util.add_listener(miya, self.controller)
end

-- 미야가 집 문앞에 와서 플레이어게 말을 걸게 세팅함
function local_class:miya_come_to_house()
	local miya = self.get_miya()

	miya.Position = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(miya)
	character_util.set_direction(miya, 'up')

	while lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	yield_return_func(self.talk_miya, self)

	self.is_miya_come = true

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 미야가 주인공에게 사탕 좀 빌려달라 하는 이벤트
function local_class:talk_miya()
	local miya = self.get_miya()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	party_util.align_to_target(miya, 'up', 1, 'arc')

	-- 안녕하세요.
	character_util.look_at(miya, user_party.Leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_2', skip = true })

	-- 여기 꼬맹이들이랑 내기 카드 게임을 했는데
	character_util.set_direction(miya, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_3', skip = true })

	-- 져서 사탕을 전부 잃어버렸어요.
	character_util.look_at(miya, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(miya, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_4', skip = true })

	-- 혹시 사탕 좀 빌려주시겠어요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_5', skip = true })

	-- 빌려 준다. / 빌려 주지 않는다. / 할로윈의 요괴에 대해 가르쳐줘.
	local choose_list = {
		{ 'halloween_loop_5_1', 'mercy' },
		{ 'halloween_loop_5_2', 'brutal' },
		{ 'halloween_loop_5_3', 'intellect' }
	}

	-- 4회차 루프 이전까진, 3번째 선택지를 안보이게 한다.
	if self.loop_count < 2 or not self.is_catch_pumpkin_kid then
		table.remove(choose_list, 3)
	end

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_list)
	if choose_result == 1 then
		yield_return_func(self.drop_candy, self, user_party.Leader, miya)

		-- 어머나, 감사합니다.
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(miya, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_anim(miya)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_6', skip = true })

		-- 이번엔 꼭 이겨서, 반드시 갚아드릴게요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_7', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(miya)

		if self.is_catch_pumpkin_kid then
			-- 3회차 루프때의 미야 반응
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(miya, miya.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), 7, true, nil, nil, nil, true)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.look_at(miya, user_party.Leader)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(miya, miya.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 7, true, nil, nil, nil, true)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			-- 그러고 보니…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_10', skip = true })

			-- 아까 꼬마를 잡아주실 때, 마치 알고 있었던 것 같아요.
			character_util.set_anim(miya, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_11', skip = true })

			-- 요괴한테 홀리기라도 한 것 아니에요?
			character_util.set_emotion(miya, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_anim(miya, { name = 'question', loop = false })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_12', skip = true })
		end
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		character_util.set_direction(miya, 'up')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(miya)
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, miya)

		return
	else
		-- 할로윈의 요괴요?
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(miya)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_18', skip = true })

		-- 영원히 할로윈을 즐기고 싶은 요괴가 있어요.
		character_util.set_anim(miya, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_19', skip = true })

		-- 그 요괴가 사람을 홀리는 일이 간혹 있는데…
		character_util.remove_anim(miya)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_20', skip = true })

		-- 물리치는 방법은, 그 요괴가 할로윈을 즐기지 못하게 하는 것 뿐이에요.
		character_util.set_anim(miya, { name = 'cast' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_21', skip = true })

		-- 도움이 되셨나요?
		character_util.set_anim(miya, { name = 'cast2' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_22', skip = true })

		-- 뭐, 그건 어찌 됐든
		character_util.remove_anim(miya)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_22_1', skip = true })

		-- 어서 사탕이나 빌려주세요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_22_2', skip = true })

		-- 빌려 준다.
		choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'halloween_loop_5_1', 'mercy' } })

		yield_return_func(self.drop_candy, self, user_party.Leader, miya)

		-- 어머나, 감사합니다.
		character_util.set_emotion(miya, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_anim(miya)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_6', skip = true })

		-- 이번엔 꼭 이겨서, 반드시 갚아드릴게요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(miya, { key = 'halloween_loop_7', skip = true })

		self.is_heard_monster = true
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(miya)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(miya, { vector_util.get_xy0(miya.Position, 2), vector(20, 0, 2) }, 7, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
	character_util.set_anim(miya, { name = 'seat' })
	character_util.set_emotion(miya, { name = 'doyagao' })

	-- 꼬맹이 자식! 나한테 사탕 잃고 울지나 말라고!
	miya.Interactable.Talk = 'halloween_loop_7_1'

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, vector(37.5, 1.5, 0))
	character_util.remove_relate_event(miya, self.controller)
	self.is_talk_miya = true
end

-- 캔디를 타겟에서 던져주는 연출
function local_class:drop_candy(from, to)
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.item_spec_name).Id
	local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = from.Position, target = to.Position, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })
	drop_item.ConsumeTarget = to

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
	character_util.set_anim(from, { name = 'throw', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(from)
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

-- 모든 이벤트를 다 봤을 때의 연출
function local_class:see_all_events()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	-- 오늘도 정말 즐거웠어.
	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, princess)
	character_util.look_at(princess, user_party.Leader)

-- 아무것도 안하고 기다리는지 체크
function local_class:waiting()
	self.waiting_req_id = self.waiting_req_id + 1

	local req_id = self.waiting_req_id
	local is_equal_req_id = function()
		return req_id == self.waiting_req_id
	end
	local waiting_for_interact = function()
		while lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
	local waiting_for_sec = function(duration)
		local time_passed = 0

		while is_equal_req_id() and time_passed < duration do
			waiting_for_interact()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 6 do
		if not is_equal_req_id() then
			break
		end

		waiting_for_sec(5)

		if not is_equal_req_id() then
			break
		end

		yield_return_func(self.princess_wait, self, i)
	end

	waiting_for_interact()

	if not is_equal_req_id() then
		return
	end

	yield_return_func(self.princess_wait_final, self)
end

function local_class:princess_change_loop()

	local duration = 0.5
	local duration_sub = 0.05
	local duration_min = 0.1

	local character_list = {
		'princess',
		'eva',
		'shell_gambler',
		'red_green_tagger',
		'shell_girgas',
		'ghost_story_coco',
		'ghost_story_bianca',
		'red_green_tagger',
		'ghost_story_arabelle',
		'red_green_mover_1',
	}

	character_util.set_active_state(princess, 'disabled')

	while true do
		for i = 1, #character_list do
			local character = get_character(character_list[i])

			character.Position = princess.Position
			character.Direction = princess.Direction
			character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'empty' })
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'taunt', loop = false })
			character_util.set_active_state(character, 'enabled')

			wait_for_sec(duration)
			character_util.set_active_state(character, 'disabled')

			if duration > duration_min then
				duration = duration - duration_sub
			end
		end
	end
end

-- QTE 함수
function local_class:qte_swipe(type)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)

	self.swipe_type = ''
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
	self.is_subscribe_touch_event = true

	while self.swipe_type ~= type do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.is_subscribe_touch_event = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

-- 화면을 흔들면서 왜곡시키는 연출
function local_class:illusion_tint_process()
	local rotate_angle = 5
	local rotate_speed = 2
	local time_passed = 0

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local sin_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(2 * unity_class.mathf.PI * time_passed * rotate_speed)
		stage_camera.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rotate_angle * sin_val, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	stage_camera.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
	field:RemoveTint(tint_name)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('HalloweenShellGameSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_knight = function()
		if not is_unity_null(CS.Oak.User.Me:GetCharacter(2, true)) then
			return get_character('knight_male')
		else
			return get_character('knight_female')
		end
	end
	self.get_princess = function() return user_party[1] end
	self.get_vishuvac = function() return get_character('shell_gambler') end
	self.get_girgas = function() return get_character('shell_girgas') end

	self.star_piece_name = 'shell_game_star_piece'

	self.get_door = function() return get_field_object('house_2_in') end

	self.is_played_once = false

	self.door_exit_interactable = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	character_util.add_listener(self.get_vishuvac(), self.controller)
	self.door_exit_interactable = self.get_door().Interactable
	self.get_door().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_vishuvac(), self.controller)

	self.door_exit_interactable = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_vishuvac()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_gambler, self))
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_door()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_knock, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'shell_game' and e.Params[1] == 'end' then
			if e.Params[2] == 'win' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_game, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Params[2] == 'lose' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_game, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

	end

	self.scene = nil

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local happy_snowman = get_character(self.happy_snowman_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, happy_snowman) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_open, self))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:quest_open()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local happy_snowman = get_character(self.happy_snowman_name)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(happy_snowman)

	character_util.align_party(happy_snowman, "down")

	local is_accepted = false
	local wait = true

	if not self.skip_request then
		yield_return_func(self.scene.request, self.scene)
		self.skip_request = true
	end

	CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.ProcessQuestRequest(nil, self.quest_spec.QuestId, function(accepted_in)
		is_accepted = accepted_in
		wait = false
	end)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if is_accepted then
		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)

		screen_util.quest_accept_event()

		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

		yield_return_func(self.scene.accept, self.scene)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		screen_util.quest_decline_Event()

		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

		yield_return_func(self.scene.decline, self.scene)

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(happy_snowman)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:drop_hat()
	local happy_snowman = get_character(self.happy_snowman_name)

	character_util.set_anim(happy_snowman, {name = "idle_hat", loop = true})

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = "01_player_popup_01"})

	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData("ItemData")

	drop_item_util.create_item({pos = happy_snowman.Position, target = user_party_leader.Position,
								itemid = item_data:GetSpec("snowman_hat").Id, notforinven = true})
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = HauntedHouse @
		Comment = 켄터베리 여성을 유령의 저택까지 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_female = controller.get_female

	self.event_zone_name = 'haunted_house_area'
	self.house_inside_zone_name = 'haunted_house_inside'
	self.to_house_route_outside_zone_name = 'haunted_house_route_outside'

	self.is_saw_here = false
	self.is_saw_house_inside = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 스테이지에 재 진입한 경우, 켄터베리 여성은 원래 위치로 돌아가 있음.
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 0 then
		self.controller:female_reset()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	local female = self.get_female()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(female.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		female.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
			if not self.is_saw_here and e.Zone.Name == self.event_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.abandoned_mansion, self))
				return true
			elseif not self.is_saw_house_inside and e.Zone.Name == self.house_inside_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.entry_abandoned_mansion, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.to_house_route_outside_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.female_return_to_start_position, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local female = self.get_female()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, female) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.interact_female, self.controller)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 시작 지점과 저택 사이의 경로에서 벗어나면 알파 페이드 아웃되서 사라지고, 다시 원래 위치로 돌아감. (다시 말 걸면 똑같이 진행 가능)
function local_class:female_return_to_start_position()
	local female = self.get_female()

	character_util.stop(female)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(female, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	female.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.controller:female_reset()

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(female, 1, 0)
end

-- 낡은 저택에 다다랐을 때
function local_class:abandoned_mansion()
	local female = self.get_female()

	self.is_saw_here = true

	-- 여자, left, tired, idle, “여기예요… 저희 집…”
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female, { key = 'haunted_house_5' })
end

-- 낡은 저택 안에 들어왔을 때
function local_class:entry_abandoned_mansion()
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	self.cookie_girl = get_character('cookie_girl')
	self.cookie_boyfriend = get_character('cookie_boyfriend')
	self.jealous_student = get_character('jealous_student')

	-- 소심한 고블린 학생 이벤트 관련 npc
	self.timid_goblin = get_character('timid_goblin')
	self.beautiful_ogre = get_character('beautiful_ogre')
	self.beautiful_ogre_friend = get_character('beautiful_ogre_friend')

	-- 소심한 싸움꾼 학생 이벤트 관련 npc
	self.timid_fighter = get_character('timid_fighter')
	self.weak_student = get_character('weak_student')
	self.bully_student_1 = get_character('bully_student_1')
	self.bully_student_2 = get_character('bully_student_2')

	self.cookie_item_id = 20086

	-- 퀘스트 진행 상태 변수
	self.is_talked_cookie_girl = false
	self.is_bullied = false
	self.is_ogre_talk_see = false

	CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.Preload()
	self.hit_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_name)

	self.cookie_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.timid_fighter.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.weak_student.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.weak_student.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.weak_student.Interactable.Talk = 'highschool_1_1_weak_student_before'

	self.timid_goblin.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.timid_goblin.Interactable.Talk = 'highschool_1_1_timid_goblin_1'

	self.timid_goblin:SetAnimation(self.timid_goblin,
		CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('seat', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))
	self.timid_goblin:SetEmotion(self.timid_goblin,
		CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('tired', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))

	self.timid_goblin.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.timid_goblin.Interactable.Talk = 'highschool_1_1_timid_goblin_1'
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.cookie_girl = nil
	self.cookie_boyfriend = nil
	self.jealous_student = nil

	self.timid_goblin = nil
	self.beautiful_ogre = nil
	self.beautiful_ogre_friend = nil

	self.timid_fighter = nil
	self.weak_student = nil
	self.bully_student_1 = nil
	self.bully_student_2 = nil

	self.hit_effect_pool = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	-- 쿠키 여학생에게 말걸었을시 이벤트 시작
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.cookie_girl) then
			self.talk_cookie_couple_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.talk_cookie_couple, self))

			-- 대화 도중에는 시선이 분산되지 않도록 쿠키걸 밑쪽 괴롭힘 잠시 중지
			stop_coroutine(self.start_bully_coroutine)

			character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_1)
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_1)

			character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_2)
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_2)

			self.bully_student_1.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0);
			self.bully_student_2.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0);

			self.is_bullied = false

			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.timid_fighter) then
			-- 린치당하고 있으며 아직 쿠키가 없을때 말을 건 경우 따로 Talk대사를 띄운다.
			if self.is_bullied and not self.is_talked_cookie_girl then
				CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.Talk(self.timid_fighter, 'highschool_1_1_fighter_student_before',
					false, nil, nil, false)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals
	(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if not e.FullEnter then
			return false
		end

		-- 교실에 들어왔을시 덩치 학생 근처 린치 시작
		if e.Zone.Name == 'bully_zone' and not self.is_bullied then
			self.start_bully_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.start_bully, self))
			return true
		end

		-- 오우거 여학생과 친구의 대사 반복
		if e.Zone.Name == 'ogre_talk_zone' then
			if not self.is_ogre_talk_see then
				self.is_ogre_talk_see = true
				self.talk_ogre_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.talk_ogre, self))
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 교실 밖으로 나가면 덩치 학생 근처 린치 종료
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals
	(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if not e.FullLeave then
			return false
		end

		if e.Zone.Name == 'bully_zone_exit' and self.is_bullied then
			stop_coroutine(self.start_bully_coroutine)

			character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_1)
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_1)

			character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_2)
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_2)

			self.bully_student_1.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0);
			self.bully_student_2.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0);

			self.is_bullied = false
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('HighSchoolHonestCookieSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.hit_effect_name = 'FX_hit'
	self.hit_power_effect_name = "FX_hit_power"

	self.hit_effect_pool = nil
	self.hit_power_effect_pool = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	self.cookie_girl = get_character('cookie_girl')
	self.cookie_boyfriend = get_character('cookie_boyfriend')
	self.jealous_student = get_character('jealous_student')

	-- 소심한 고블린 학생 이벤트 관련 npc
	self.timid_goblin = get_character('timid_goblin')
	self.beautiful_ogre = get_character('beautiful_ogre')
	self.beautiful_ogre_friend = get_character('beautiful_ogre_friend')

	-- 소심한 싸움꾼 학생 이벤트 관련 npc
	self.timid_fighter = get_character('timid_fighter')
	self.weak_student = get_character('weak_student')
	self.bully_student_1 = get_character('bully_student_1')
	self.bully_student_2 = get_character('bully_student_2')

	self.emoticonPool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('emoticon');

	CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.Preload()
	self.hit_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_name)
	self.hit_power_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_power_effect_name)

	self.cookie_item_id = 20086

	-- 퀘스트 진행 상태 변수 (추후 사용 방식 변경)
	self.is_cookie_give_goblin = false
	self.is_cookie_give_fighter = false
	self.is_bullied = false
	self.is_cookie_zone_enter = false
	self.is_cookie_end = false
	self.is_ogre_talk_see = false

	self.timid_goblin.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.timid_fighter.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.cookie_girl = nil
	self.cookie_boyfriend = nil
	self.jealous_student = nil

	self.timid_goblin = nil
	self.beautiful_ogre = nil
	self.beautiful_ogre_friend = nil

	self.timid_fighter = nil
	self.weak_student = nil
	self.bully_student_1 = nil
	self.bully_student_2 = nil

	self.emoticonPool = nil

	self.hit_effect_pool = nil
	self.hit_power_effect_pool = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals
	(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if not e.FullEnter then
			return false
		end

		-- 교실에 들어왔을시 덩치 학생 근처 린치 시작
		if e.Zone.Name == 'bully_zone' and not self.is_cookie_give_fighter and not self.is_bullied then
			self.start_bully_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.start_bully, self))
			return true
		end

		-- 오우거 여학생과 친구의 대사 반복
		if e.Zone.Name == 'ogre_talk_zone' then
			if not self.is_ogre_talk_see then
				self.is_ogre_talk_see = true
				self.talk_ogre_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.talk_ogre, self))
			end
			return true
		end

		if e.Zone.Name == 'end_cookie_check_2' or e.Zone.Name == 'end_cookie_check_1' then
			if self.is_cookie_give_fighter and self.is_cookie_give_goblin and not self.is_cookie_zone_enter then
				self.is_cookie_zone_enter = true
				self:setting_end_cookie()
				self.end_cookie_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.setting_end_cookie_talk, self))
			end
			return true
		end

		if e.Zone.Name == 'end_cookie_end' then
			if self.is_cookie_give_fighter and self.is_cookie_give_goblin and not self.is_cookie_end then
				self.is_cookie_end = true
				self.end_cookie_coroutine_2 = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.end_cookie_talk, self))
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 교실 밖으로 나가면 덩치 학생 근처 린치 종료
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals
	(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if not e.FullLeave then
			return false
		end

		if e.Zone.Name == 'bully_zone_exit' and not self.is_cookie_give_fighter and self.is_bullied then
			stop_coroutine(self.start_bully_coroutine)

			character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_1)
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_1)

			character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_2)
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_2)

			self.bully_student_1.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0);
			self.bully_student_2.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0);

			self.is_bullied = false
			return true
		end
	end
	--

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.timid_goblin)
			and not self.is_cookie_give_goblin then
			self.talk_cookie_goblin_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.give_cookie_timid_goblin, self))
			return true

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.timid_fighter) then
			if self.is_bullied and not self.is_cookie_give_fighter then
				self.talk_cookie_fighter_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.give_cookie_timid_fighter, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:setting_end_cookie()
	-- 기존 쿠키관련 npc들 중 다시 사용하지 않는 학생들을 맵 밖으로 이동.
	character_util.remove_anim(self.weak_student)

	move_duration = move_info:GetDuration(self.cookie_girl.Position)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(move_duration))

	self.cookie_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 이벤트 끝난 후 반복 대사 설정

	self.timid_fighter.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.timid_goblin.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()

	self.cookie_girl.Interactable.Talk = 'highschool_1_1_cookie_end_5'

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 쿠키이벤트 덩치 근처 린치 연출
function local_class:start_bully()
	self.is_bullied = true

	character_util.set_anim(self.weak_student, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.weak_student, { name = 'tired' })

	-- 때리는 동안 괴롭히는 학생 레이어가 묻히지 않게 일시적으로 바꿔준다. (코루틴 종료될때 원래대로 돌려 놓는다.)
	self.bully_student_1.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 2);
	self.bully_student_2.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 2);

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2.0))

	while true do
		-- 첫번째 괴롭히는 학생 1타 공격 연출 시작
		character_util.set_anim(self.bully_student_1, { name = 'gauntlet_handskill2', loop = false})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.bully_student_1, { name = 'doyagao' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.bully_student_1,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_bully_student_1_1', skip = false})

		-- 주먹이 닿을때 까지 대기
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.4))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', play_pos = self.weak_student.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0)
		})

		self.hit_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.weak_student.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0))
		self.weak_student.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(-0.2, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.2)
		self.weak_student.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

		stage_camera:Shake(0.008, 0.333)

		-- 애니메이션 모션이 끝날때 까지 대기
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.333))

		character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_1)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_1)

		-- 다음 학생 때리기 전까지 대기
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2.5))

		-- 말풍선 제거
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.bully_student_1)

		-- 두번째 괴롭히는 학생 3타 공격 연출 시작
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.bully_student_2,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_bully_student_2_1', skip = false})

		character_util.set_anim(self.bully_student_2, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack2', loop = false})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.bully_student_2, { name = 'doyagao' })

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.15))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', play_pos = self.weak_student.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0)
		})

		self.hit_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.weak_student.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0))
		self.weak_student.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(0.05, 0, 0), 0.15, 0.15)
		self.weak_student.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		stage_camera:Shake(0.005, 0.417)

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.15))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', play_pos = self.weak_student.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0)
		})

		self.hit_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.weak_student.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0))
		self.weak_student.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(0.05, 0, 0), 0.15, 0.15)
		self.weak_student.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.15))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', play_pos = self.weak_student.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0)
		})

		self.hit_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.weak_student.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0))
		self.weak_student.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(0.05, 0, 0), 0.15, 0.15)
		self.weak_student.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.117))

		character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_2)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_2)

		-- 다음 학생 때리기 전까지 대기
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2.5))

		-- 말풍선 제거
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.bully_student_2)
	end
end

-- 소심한 덩치 학생에게 쿠키를 주는 이벤트 연출
function local_class:give_cookie_timid_fighter()
	-- 괴롭힘 중지
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	coroutine.yield(align_party(self.timid_fighter, CS.Oak.Direction.Up, 1.0, CS.Oak.Party.AlignType.Arc))

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.timid_fighter,
		{key = 'highschool_1_1_fighter_student_before', skip = true})

	self.timid_fighter.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.timid_fighter,
		{key = 'highschool_1_1_fighter_student_0', skip = true})

	local wait = true

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('highschool_1_1_cookie_branch_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			self.is_cookie_give_fighter = true
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('highschool_1_1_cookie_branch_2'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end
	})

	local acs = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	acs.Talker = user_party_leader
	acs.Branchs = branches
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, acs)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_cookie_give_fighter then
		CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:Return(self.bully_student_1.transform)
		CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:Return(self.bully_student_2.transform)

		stop_coroutine(self.start_bully_coroutine)

		character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_1)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_1)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_2)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_2)

		self.bully_student_1.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0);
		self.bully_student_2.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0);
		self.is_bullied = false

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "throw", loop = false})
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = "doyagao"})

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')

		local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.2),
		target = self.timid_fighter.Position + vector(0.25, 0, -0.15),
		itemid = self.cookie_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true})

		drop_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1) * 0.5
		drop_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1) * 0.5

		-- DropItem 의 SortingLayer를 캐릭터 보다 위에 나오도록
		drop_item:SetSortingLayer(true)

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.65))

		self.timid_fighter.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		user_party_leader:RemoveAnimation(user_party_leader)

		character_util.remove_anim(self.timid_fighter)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.timid_fighter,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_fighter_student_1', skip = true})

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.timid_fighter,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_fighter_student_2', skip = true})

		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true
		})

		character_util.set_anim(self.timid_fighter, { name = 'eat' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.timid_fighter, { name = 'smile' })

		user_party_leader:RemoveEmotion(user_party_leader)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.timid_fighter,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_fighter_student_3', skip = true})

		-- 먹는시간 조금 더 대기
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.6))

		drop_item.ConsumeTarget = self.timid_fighter
		drop_item:Fly()

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.6))

		eat_sfx:FadeOut(0.2)

		character_util.remove_anim(self.timid_fighter)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.timid_fighter)

		character_util.set_emotion(self.timid_fighter, { name = 'damaged' })

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.timid_fighter,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_fighter_student_4', skip = true})

		self.timid_fighter.SpineController:Shake(0.04, 2)
		self.timid_fighter.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		self.timid_fighter.SpineController:PulseColor(CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 0.3, 2);
		self.timid_fighter.SpineController:DamageSquish(1.3, 0.7, 1, 2);

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.timid_fighter)

		character_util.set_anim(self.timid_fighter, { name = 'question' , loop = false})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.timid_fighter, { name = 'doyagao' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.timid_fighter,
			{key = "highschool_1_1_fighter_student_5", skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.timid_fighter)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.timid_fighter,
			{key = "highschool_1_1_fighter_student_6", skip = true})

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.timid_fighter)

		character_util.set_emotion(self.timid_fighter, { name = 'eyelight' })

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fade_out_03')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.timid_fighter,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_fighter_student_7', skip = true})

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.timid_fighter)

		self.timid_fighter.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		character_util.set_anim(self.timid_fighter, { name = 'release' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.timid_fighter, { name = 'mad' })

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')

		-- 덩치 학생이 괴롭히던 학생들을 도발한다.
		camera_util.shake(0.25, 0.5)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.timid_fighter,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_fighter_student_8', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

		character_util.set_direction(self.bully_student_1, CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
		character_util.jump(self.bully_student_1, 1, 0.5)

		character_util.set_direction(self.bully_student_2, CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
		character_util.jump(self.bully_student_2, 1, 0.5)

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.0))

		CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(self.bully_student_2, move_info)

		character_util.set_emotion(self.bully_student_1, { name = 'doyagao' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.bully_student_1,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_bully_student_1_2', skip = true})

		character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_1)

		character_util.set_anim(self.bully_student_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.bully_student_2, { name = 'mad' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.bully_student_2,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_bully_student_2_2', skip = true})

		character_util.remove_anim(self.bully_student_2)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_2)

		self.hit_power_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.bully_student_1.Position)

		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(self.bully_student_1, knockback_info);

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.bully_student_1)

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

		Text = game_string:GetString('highschool_1_1_cookie_branch_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			self.is_cookie_give_goblin = true
