	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('highschool_1_1_cookie_branch_2'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_cookie_give_goblin then

			CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('throw', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false))

		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.timid_goblin,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_timid_goblin_3', skip = true})

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.6))

		-- 식사가 끝나기전 먼저 고블린한테 아이템 습득되도록
		drop_item.ConsumeTarget = self.timid_goblin
		drop_item:Fly()

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.4))

		eat_sfx:FadeOut(0.2)

		character_util.remove_anim(self.timid_goblin)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.timid_goblin)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.timid_goblin,
			{key = 'highschool_1_1_timid_goblin_4', skip = true})

		self.timid_goblin.SpineController:Shake(0.04, 2)
		self.timid_goblin.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		self.timid_goblin.SpineController:PulseColor(CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 0.3, 2);
		self.timid_goblin.SpineController:DamageSquish(1.3, 0.7, 1, 2);
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2.0))

		character_util.remove_anim(self.timid_goblin)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.timid_goblin)

	else

		self.talk_ogre_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,

		user_party:ResetControllers()

local local_class = newclass('JungpaStudioPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = JungpaStudio @
		Comment = 퀘스트 종료 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller)
    self.controller = controller
    self.jungpaGatekeeper1 = nil
    self.jungpaGatekeeper2 = nil
    self.jungpaOld = nil
    self.jungpaGatekeeper1Name = "jungpa_gatekeeper_1"
    self.jungpaGatekeeper2Name = "jungpa_gatekeeper_2"
    self.talkName = "jungpa_studio_talk"
end

function local_class:enter()
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

    if stage.Name == "china_1_3" then
        local board = get_field_object("board_end_0")
        board.Interactable.Message = game_string:Format("jungpa_studio_oneline_7", user.Name)

        self.jungpaGatekeeper1 = get_character(self.jungpaGatekeeper1Name)
        self.jungpaGatekeeper2 = get_character(self.jungpaGatekeeper2Name)
    elseif stage.Name == "substage_6_6" then
        for i=0, 1 do
            local name = string.format("board_end_%d", i)
            local board = get_field_object(name)
            board.Interactable.Message = game_string:Format("jungpa_studio_oneline_7", user.Name)
        end
        self.jungpaOld = get_character("jungpa_old")
        if self.controller.starting_grade >= 0 then
            self.jungpaOld.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
            self.jungpaOld.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
            self.jungpaOld.Position = vector(0.5, 0, 17)
        end
    end

    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    return
end

function local_class:exit()
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
    self.jungpaGatekeeper1 = nil
    self.jungpaGatekeeper2 = nil

    if stage.Name == "substage_6_6" then
        self.jungpaOld.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
    end

    self.jungpaOld = nil
    self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if e.Target == self.jungpaGatekeeper1 or e.Target == self.jungpaGatekeeper2 then
            speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, self.talkName)
        elseif e.Target == self.jungpaOld then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.starttest, self))
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:starttest()
    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:start_test())

    local waitForBranch = true
    local start = false

    local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("jungpa_studio_15"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
        Callback = function()
            waitForBranch = false
            start = true
        end})
    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("jungpa_studio_19"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
        Callback = function()
            waitForBranch = false
        end
    })

    local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
    choice_state.Branchs = branches
    choice_state.Talker = user_party_leader
    ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

    while waitForBranch do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if start then
        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:start_test_2())

        local i = 1
        while true do
            if user_party.Count == 1 then
                break;
            end

            character_util.convert_to_npc(user_party[i])
        end

        self.jungpaOld.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
        self.jungpaOld.Interactable.Talk = "jungpa_studio_16"
    else
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.jungpaOld, {key = "jungpa_studio_20", skip = true})
    end

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

    self.jungpaGatekeeper2.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

    self.substageMap = get_field_object(self.substageName).FieldObjectBehaviour

    return true
end

function local_class:start()

    quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.jungpaGatekeeper2)
end

function local_class:exit()

    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
    self.jungpaGatekeeper1 = nil
    self.jungpaGatekeeper2 = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and e.Zone.Name == self.zoneName then
            if not self.seeEvent then
                self.seeEvent = true
                coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                        util.cs_generator(self.controller.scene.enter_studio, self.controller.scene))
            end
        end
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if e.Target == self.jungpaGatekeeper1 or e.Target == self.jungpaGatekeeper2 then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_open, self))
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:quest_open()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.jungpaGatekeeper1)
    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.jungpaGatekeeper2)

    local pos = vector(-81.5, 0, 54)
    character_util.align_party(pos, "down")

    local isAccepted = false
    local waitForBranch = true

    if not self.skipRequest then
        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:quest_open())
        self.skipRequest = true
    end

    CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.ProcessQuestRequest(nil, self.quest_spec.QuestId, function(accepted_in)
        waitForBranch = false
        isAccepted = accepted_in
    end, false)

    while (waitForBranch) do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if isAccepted then
        floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
        coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestAcceptEvent(false, false))
        -- coroutine.yield(self.substageMap:OpenStage())
        -- quest와 엮인 서브스테이지는 Quests 시트의 Pre/ProgressOpenStages를 이용해서 열고 클라단에서는 연출만 보여주도록 수정
        yield_return_func(CS.Oak.SubStageLogic.ExecuteOpenSubStage, self.substageName, "jungpa_studio_substage_narration")
        coroutine.yield(quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller))
    else
        coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestDeclineEvent())

        quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.jungpaGatekeeper1)
        quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.jungpaGatekeeper2)
    end

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

function local_class:start()

        quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(self.jungpaGatekeeper1)
        quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(self.jungpaGatekeeper2)

        self.jungpaOld.Position = vector(0.5, 0, 17)
    end

function local_class:exit()

    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
    self.jungpaGatekeeper1 = nil
    self.jungpaGatekeeper2 = nil
    if stage.Name == "substage_6_6" then
        self.jungpaOld.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
        self.jungpaOld =nil
    end

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if e.Target == self.jungpaOld then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.starttest, self))
        end
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
            if e.Zone.Name == "ENDING" and self.innerProgress == 5 then
                self.innerProgress = 6
                coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear, self))
            end
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.before_test, self, e))
        end

function local_class:before_test(e)
    for i=1, 4 do
        local eventName = string.format("EVENT%d", i)
        if e.Zone.Name == eventName and self.innerProgress == i then
            self.innerProgress = i + 1

            local leader = user_party_leader
            leader.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

            local scene_name = string.format("before_test_%d", i)
            lua_helper.call_nullable(self.controller.scene, scene_name, self.controller.scene)
            break
        end
    end
end

function local_class:starttest()
    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:start_test())

    local waitForBranch = true
    local start = false

    local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("jungpa_studio_15"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
        Callback = function()
            waitForBranch = false
            start = true
        end})
    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("jungpa_studio_19"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
        Callback = function()
            waitForBranch = false
        end

    choice_state.Branchs = branches
    choice_state.Talker = user_party_leader
    ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

    while waitForBranch do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if start then
        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:start_test_1())

        local i = 1
        while true do
            if user_party.Count == 1 then
                break;
            end

            character_util.convert_to_npc(user_party[i])
        end

        self.jungpaOld.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
        self.innerProgress = 1
    else
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.jungpaOld, {key = "jungpa_studio_20", skip = true})
    end

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == 'highschool_1_2' then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent), 'on_event')

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_name)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.last_hit_effect_name)

		self.kendo_leader = get_character(self.kendo_leader_name)

		character_util.set_position(self.kendo_leader, stage.Field:GetMarker(self.kendo_leader_marker).position)

		self.rotye = get_character(self.rotye_name)

		-- 웨이브 전투 적 설정
		for i = 1, self.wave_battle_monster_whole_num do
			local c = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.wave_battle_name, i))
			table.insert(self.wave_battle_list, c)
		end

		local left_wave_start = vector(-9, 1, 80)
		local right_wave_start = vector(8, 1, 80)

		for i = 1, #self.wave_battle_list do
			if i <= #self.wave_battle_list / 2 then
				character_util.set_position(
						self.wave_battle_list[i], left_wave_start + vector(0, 0, -(i - 1)))
				character_util.set_direction(self.wave_battle_list[i], CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
			else
				character_util.set_position(
						self.wave_battle_list[i], right_wave_start +
								vector(0, 0, -(i - #self.wave_battle_list / 2 - 1)))
				character_util.set_direction(self.wave_battle_list[i], CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
			end
		end

		-- 보스전 이후 캐릭터 설정
		local genie = get_character(self.genie_name)
		character_util.set_position(genie, vector(77, 0.4, 127.8))
		character_util.set_direction(genie, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
		genie:SetAnimation("seat", true)

		local anderson = get_character(self.anderson_name)
		character_util.set_position(anderson, vector(35, 0, 126.5))
		character_util.set_direction(anderson, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

		for i = 1, self.soccer_staff_num do
			local c = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.soccer_staff_name, i))

			character_util.set_position(c,vector(38, 0, 127) +
					vector(unity_class.mathf.Floor((i-1) / 2), 0, -((i-1) % 2)))
			character_util.set_direction(c, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
			c:SetAnimation("cast", true)
			c:SetEmotion("tired", true)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == 'highschool_1_2' then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
				self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.kendo_leader)

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name == 'highschool_1_2' then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent))

		self.wave_battle_list = nil
		self.kendo_leader = nil
		self.rotye = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent) then
		self:on_stage_control_start_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.wave_battle_zone_name then
		if not self.see_wave_battle then
			self.see_wave_battle = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_wave_battle, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.boaa_battle_zone_name then
		if not self.see_boss_battle then
			self.see_boss_battle = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_battle_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.wave_battle_group_name_1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_wave_battle_1, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.wave_battle_group_name_2 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_wave_battle_2, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.wave_battle_group_name_3 then
		for i = 1, self.wave_battle_gate_num do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(
					string.format("%s%d", self.wave_battle_gate_name, i )))
		end
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_battle_end_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_control_start_event(e)
	character_util.set_direction(self.kendo_leader, CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
end

-- 웨이브 1번 전투 시작
function local_class:start_wave_battle()
	for i = 1, self.wave_battle_gate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(
				string.format("%s%d", self.wave_battle_gate_name, i )))
	end

	-- bgm_transition: Field(ondemand/highschool/preload:bgm_highschool_main) -> Combat(bgm_battle_normal)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'combat'
	})

	-- 3번의 웨이브 동안 bgm이 전투로 고정되도록 필드 bgm을 비워서 자동으로 돌아가지 않도록 함.
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

	-- 팡파레 나오지 않도록 설정
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false


	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.wave_battle_convert_monster, self, 0))
end

-- 웨이브 2번 전투 시작
function local_class:progress_wave_battle_1()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.wave_battle_convert_monster, self, 1))
end

-- 웨이브 3번 전투 시작
function local_class:progress_wave_battle_2()
	-- 비워두었던 필드 bgm 원복
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({
		name = 'ondemand/highschool/preload:bgm_highschool_main', state = 'field'
	})

	-- 팡파레 나오도록 원복
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.wave_battle_convert_monster, self, 2))
end

-- 웨이브 전투에서 2층에 있던 NPC가 내려와 몬스터가 됨
function local_class:wave_battle_convert_monster(mod)
	-- 몬스터가 점프하는 소리 추가

	local monster_list = {}

	for i = 1, #self.wave_battle_list do
		if i % 3 == mod then
			local c = self.wave_battle_list[i]

			character_util.jump(c, 1, 0.5)

			if i <= #self.wave_battle_list / 2 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
								c, c.Position + vector(2, -1, 0), 0.5, nil, false, true))
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
								c, c.Position + vector(-2, -1, 0), 0.5, nil, false, true))
			end

			table.insert(monster_list, c)
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	for i = 1, #monster_list do
		character_util.set_direction(monster_list[i], CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		if mod == 0 then
			character_util.convert_to_monster(monster_list[i], self.wave_battle_group_name_1)
		elseif mod == 1 then
			character_util.convert_to_monster(monster_list[i], self.wave_battle_group_name_2)
		else
			character_util.convert_to_monster(monster_list[i], self.wave_battle_group_name_3)
		end

		command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster_list[i], user_party_leader, "battle")
	end
end

		Type = progress @

		Comment = 인싸들을 너드로 만들어버리고 사라지는 마리안 @
		Index = 10 @
		NextSections = 11 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller

	self.met_marian = false

	self.nerd_smoke_name = self.controller.nerd_gas_effect_name
	self.rope_effect_name = 'rope_trap'
	self.explosion_effect_name = 'FX_explosion_boss'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.controller.high_school2_stage_name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

		local rotye = get_character("rotye")
		rotye.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.high_school3_stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.nerd_smoke_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.rope_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.explosion_effect_name)
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.high_school3_stage_name then
		return
	end

	local insiders = {
		get_character('insider_1'),
		get_character('insider_2'),
		get_character('insider_3'),
	}

	for _, insider in ipairs(insiders) do
		local tie_state = CS.Oak.CharacterRopeTrappedState(insider,
				character_util.get_direction('down'), insider.Position)
		message_system:SendSync(insider, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(tie_state))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name == self.controller.high_school2_stage_name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'found_marian' and not self.met_marian then
			self.met_marian = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.nerd_marian_intro_event, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character("rotye")) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character("rotye"), { key = 'kanterbury_highschool_main_s10_18' })

	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('KanterburyHighSchoolMainSection12')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = KanterburyHighSchoolMain @
		Comment = 아이언 티탄 얼굴 인증 이벤트 @
		Index = 11 @
		NextSections = 12 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.verify_states = {
		none = 1,
		verifying = 2,
	}

	self.verify_state = self.verify_states.none
	self.tint_key = 'face_verification'

	self.verify_door_name = 'door_school_3'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.high_school3_stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.name ~= self.controller.high_school3_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.verify_door_name))
end

function local_class:exit()

	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'face_verification' and self.verify_state == self.verify_states.none then
			self.verify_state = self.verify_states.verifying
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.face_verification_event, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:face_verification_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.align_party(vector(-0.5, 0, 29), 'down')

	local interphone = get_field_object('verify_interphone')

	-- 틴트 되기 전에 먼저 조건 체크하여 티탄 머리의 색 저장
	local leader_action_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	local verify_result = leader_action_state ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(leader_action_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) and
			leader_action_state.HoldTarget.Name == 'iron_teatan_head'

	local renderer = nil
	local origin_color = nil

	if verify_result == true then
		local head = leader_action_state.HoldTarget
		local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(head.Transform, 'break_iron_teatans_head')
		renderer = mesh:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
		origin_color = renderer.material.color
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_broadcast_01')

	-- 보안 인증을 시작합니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(interphone, {key = 'marian_door_check_face', skip = true})

	field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_class.color.black, 0.5, 0.65)
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.5)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	if verify_result == true then
		self:iron_teatan_head_tint(leader_action_state.HoldTarget)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_broadcast_01')

		-- 인증 성공.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(interphone, {key = 'marian_door_check_success_1', skip = true})

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.verify_door_name, false))

		-- 어서오십시오, 가장 강력한 챔피언.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(interphone, {key = 'marian_door_check_success_2', skip = true})

		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	else
		self:leader_tint()
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_broadcast_01')

		-- 인증 실패.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(interphone, { key = 'marian_door_check_fail_1', skip = true })

		-- 나약한 살덩어리의 입장을 불허합니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(interphone, { key = 'marian_door_check_fail_2', skip = true })

		-- 강력한 강철의 얼굴을 보여주세요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(interphone, { key = 'marian_door_check_fail_3', skip = true })

		self.verify_state = self.verify_states.none
	end

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 1)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)

	-- 티탄 머리를 들고있을 경우 틴트 되기 전 색으로 되돌림
	if verify_result == true then
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local fade_time = 1

		local start_color = renderer.material.color

		local end_color = origin_color

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fade_time do
			local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time
			local current_color = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_color, end_color, normalized)
			renderer.material.color = current_color

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

	-- 티탄 머리를 안들고올경우 그냥 대기
	else
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:iron_teatan_head_tint(head)
	local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(head.Transform, 'break_iron_teatans_head')
	local renderer = mesh:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
	local origin_color = renderer.material.color

	for _ = 1, 3 do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_blink_01')
		renderer.material.color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0, 0, 0, 0.75)
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.1))
		renderer.material.color = origin_color
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.1))
	end

	renderer.material.color = origin_color
end

function local_class:leader_tint()
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_blink_01')
		user_party.Leader.SpineController:AddColor(self.tint_key, unity_class.color.black, 0.45, 0)
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.1))
		user_party.Leader.SpineController:AddColor(self.tint_key, unity_class.color.white, 0.45, 0)
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.1))
	end

	user_party_leader.SpineController:ResetAllColors()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('KanterburyHighSchoolMainSection13')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = KanterburyHighSchoolMain @
		Comment = 아이언티탄 마리안과 전투 ~ 마리안이 다시 합류 하기까지 @
		Index = 12 @
		NextSections = 13 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 1,
		fighting = 2, -- 마리안과 싸우는 중
		marian_win = 3, -- 마리안이 플레이어한테 이김
		marian_defeat = 4 -- 마리안이 플레이어한테 짐
	}

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.marian_png = 'teatan_hero.png'

	self.wave_monsters_prefix = 'boss_'
	self.wave_monsters_count = 6
	self.wave_count = 6
	self.timer_second = 60
	self.tint_key = 'iron_teatan_power_off'
	self.zaco_appear_height = 14
	self.power_off_duration = 8
	self.power_source_name = 'iron_teatan_power_source'

	self.power_off_start_time = nil
	self.reserved_power_off_sec = nil

	self.timer_start_time = nil
	self.reserved_timer_sec = nil

	self.wave_spawn_routine = nil
	self.power_off_routine = nil

	self.current_wave = 0
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.high_school3_stage_name then
		return true;
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_s_bombarrow_explosion')

	-- 타이밍이 중요한 sfx 미리 프리로드함
	music_player:PreloadSfx('01_break_crystal_01')

	local iron_teatan = get_character('iron_teatan')
	character_util.convert_to_npc(iron_teatan)
	--iron_teatan.LockedDirection = character_util.get_direction('down')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.high_school3_stage_name then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, self.wave_count do
		for j = 1, self.wave_monsters_count do
			local c = self:get_wave_monster(i, j)
			c.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
			c.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end

	local iron_teatan = get_character('iron_teatan')
	iron_teatan.LockedDirection = character_util.get_direction('down')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))

	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and  e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'boss_room' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.fighting
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.iron_teatan_marian_intro, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == ('wave' .. self.current_wave) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fighting then
			self.power_off_start_time = CS.GameTime.ServerTime
			self.power_off_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.iron_teatan_power_off, self, self.power_off_duration))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		local iron_teatan = get_character('iron_teatan')

		if iron_teatan ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, iron_teatan) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fighting then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.marian_defeat
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_iron_teatan, self))
		elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fighting and lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, e.FieldObject) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_player_dead, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fighting and lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, e.FieldObject) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_player_revive, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent) and e.TimerId == CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer and e.IsComplete == true then

		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fighting then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_timer_over, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

-- 아이언 티탄의 전기 충전이 캔슬될때 불리는 루틴
function local_class:iron_teatan_power_off(duration)
	local marian = get_character('marian')
	local iron_teatan = get_character('iron_teatan')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_iron_teatan_head_break_01')

	-- 크윽, 충전이…!!
	marian:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(marian, {key = 'nerd_iron_teatan_charge_cancel', portraitname = self.marian_png})

	-- 전력공급 차단
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create(self.power_source_name))

	-- 화면 어둡게 하고
	field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_class.color.black, 0.5, 0.6)

	-- 아이언 티탄 때릴수있게
	iron_teatan.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local wave_spawnable = self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fighting and self.current_wave + 1 <= self.wave_count
	if wave_spawnable == true then

		self:iron_teatan_power_on()

		self.wave_spawn_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.zaco_wave_appear, self))
	end
end

function local_class:iron_teatan_power_on()
	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 0.5)

	local iron_teatan = get_character('iron_teatan')
	iron_teatan.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NoneAttackableDamagedBehaviour.Instance

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(self.power_source_name))
end

-- 시간이 오버 되면 불리는 루틴
function local_class:on_timer_over()
	local marian = get_character('marian')
	local iron_teatan = get_character('iron_teatan')

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.marian_win

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self:stop_timer()
	self:stop_power_off()
	stop_coroutine(self.wave_spawn_routine)


	-- 전투 중지하고 살아있는 자코들은 신나서 흔들흔들
	iron_teatan.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true

	for i = 1, self.wave_count do
		for j = 1, self.wave_monsters_count do
			local monster = self:get_wave_monster(i, j)
			if not monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
				character_util.set_position(monster, monster.Position)
				monster:SetEmotion('smile', true)
				monster:SetAnimation('success', true)
				monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
			end
		end
	end
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	-- 전투 시작 전 필드 bgm을 비웠으므로 ForceEndBattles()을 호출해도 Combat State 일것임.
	-- bgm_transition: Combat(bgm_battle_normal) -> Muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'muted'
	})

	camera_util.move_async(iron_teatan.Position, 1)

	local die_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01'
	})

	-- 보스 터지는 이펙트 붙여줌
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss'):Instantiate(iron_teatan.Position)

	-- 마리안 주변 곳곳에서 너드 가스 펑펑
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.nerd_gas_explosion, self))

	-- 카메라 계속 떨림
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 99)

	-- 캬하하하하하하! 세상은 대 너드 시대를 맞는다!
	marian:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(marian, {key = 'nerd_iron_teatan_charge_over', bubble_type = 'shout', portraitname = self.marian_png })

	-- 이펙트가 터질떄까지 대기
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(4.75))

	die_sfx:FadeOut()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	screen_util.custom_game_over_async()

	-- 조금 대기하고 화면 보여줌
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
end

-- 아이언 티탄 주변 곳곳에서 너드 가스가 터지는 연출
function local_class:nerd_gas_explosion()
	local iron_teatan = get_character('iron_teatan')
	local preset_name = self.controller.nerd_gas_effect_name
	local pos_array = {
		iron_teatan.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2,
		iron_teatan.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2,
		iron_teatan.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2 + unity_class.vector3.left * 2,
		iron_teatan.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2 + unity_class.vector3.right * 2,
		iron_teatan.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2 + unity_class.vector3.right * 2,
		iron_teatan.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2 + unity_class.vector3.left * 2,
		iron_teatan.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 2,

function local_class:zaco_wave_appear()
	local center_pos = field:GetMarker('boss_room_center').position
	local radius = 5
	local duration = 0.75
	local prev_seg = 0

	self.current_wave = self.current_wave + 1

	local wait_routines = {}
	local segment = (unity_class.mathf.PI * 2) / self.wave_monsters_count
	for i = 1, self.wave_monsters_count do
		local theta = unity_class.random.Range(prev_seg, segment * i)
		local appear_pos = center_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * radius * unity_class.mathf.Sin(theta) +
				unity_class.vector3.right * radius * unity_class.mathf.Cos(theta)
		local wave_str = 'wave' .. self.current_wave
		local num_str = '_' .. i
		local zaco_name = self.wave_monsters_prefix .. wave_str .. num_str
		local zaco = get_character(zaco_name)

		wait_routines[i] = util.cs_generator(self.zaco_appear, self, zaco, appear_pos, duration)
		prev_seg = segment * i
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_all(table.unpack(wait_routines)))
end

function local_class:zaco_appear(zaco, pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	zaco.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.look_at(zaco, user_party_leader)

	while (time_passed <= duration) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local ip = screen_util.get_interpolations('ease_in_quad')
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(ip(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.zaco_appear_height, 0, progress)

		zaco.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, cur_y)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	zaco.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos)
	zaco.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(zaco, user_party_leader, 'battle')
end

function local_class:start_timer(duration)

	self.timer_start_time = CS.GameTime.ServerTime
	local game_timer = CS.Oak.InGameTimer.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, duration)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAddEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, game_timer))
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStartEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, true, unity_class.color.red))
end

function local_class:stop_timer()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRemoveEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStopEvent.Instance)
end

function local_class:stop_power_off()

end

function local_class:on_player_dead()
	self:stop_timer()
	self:stop_power_off()
	stop_coroutine(self.wave_spawn_routine)

	self.reserved_timer_sec = self.timer_second - (CS.GameTime.ServerTime:ToUnixTimeSeconds() - self.timer_start_time:ToUnixTimeSeconds())
end

-- 플레이어가 부활했을때 불리는 루틴
function local_class:on_player_revive()

	if self.reserved_timer_sec ~= nil and self.reserved_timer_sec  > 0 then
		self:start_timer(self.reserved_timer_sec)
	else
		-- 타이머 남은 시간이 없으면 마리안 승 처리
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_timer_over, self))
		return
	end

	local current_zacos = self:get_wave_monsters(self.current_wave)
	local current_wave_alive = false
	for _, zaco in ipairs(current_zacos) do
		if not zaco.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			current_wave_alive = true
			break
		end
	end

	if current_wave_alive then
		for _, zaco in ipairs(current_zacos) do
			if not zaco.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				zaco.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
				zaco.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(zaco.Position)
				command_util.execute_monster_notice(zaco, user_party_leader, 'battle')
			end
		end
	else
		self.reserved_power_off_sec = self.power_off_duration -
				(CS.GameTime.ServerTime:ToUnixTimeSeconds() - self.power_off_start_time:ToUnixTimeSeconds())
		self.reserved_power_off_sec = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.reserved_power_off_sec, 0)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.iron_teatan_power_off, self, self.reserved_power_off_sec))
	end
end

function local_class:invader_crystal_bounce(crystal)
	crystal.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local cb = function ()
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_clang_01')
	end

	local y_calc = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(3, 9, 0, 2, cb)
	while not y_calc:IsDone() do

		y_calc:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local cur_pos = crystal.position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1 * unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Max(y_calc:GetDistance(), 0)

		cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(cur_pos, cur_y)

		crystal.position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	y_calc:Dispose()
end

return local_class

function local_class:throw_chalk(duration)
	local item_placeholder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
	item_placeholder.ItemId = 20077 --Old Sword Piece #4
	item_placeholder.NotForInventory = true

	local chalk = CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(self.sohee.Position,
			item_placeholder, false, CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.DontFindLooter, 0.5)

	chalk.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90,
			unity_class.vector3(1, 0, 0)) * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-95, unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 1))
	chalk.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90,
			unity_class.vector3(1, 0, 0)) * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-95, unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 1))

	local duration = duration
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = chalk.SpriteTransform.position
	local end_pos = user_party_leader.Position

local local_class = newclass('KanterburyHighSchoolMainSection16')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = KanterburyHighSchoolMain @
		Comment = 인싸 소히와의 전투 ~ 다시 파티로 합류하는 소히 까지 @
		Index = 15 @
		NextSections = 16 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'highschool_1_4'

	self.section_inner_progress = 0
	self.is_say_jjindda = false

	self.sohee = nil

	self.rolling_type = CS.Oak.RollingNumberEaseType.Linear
	self.rolling_duration = 1

	-- 4 스테이지의 RequirePoints
	self.sohee_popularity = 0
	self.my_popularity = 0
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 4 스테이지의 RequirePoints
	self.sohee_popularity = 4800
	-- 외전일 경우 그냥 상수값
	self.my_popularity = 5000

	local chapter_id = self.controller.quest_progress.Spec.QuestChapter.ChapterId
	if not CS.Oak.EventDataHelper.IsLiveEventPast(chapter_id) then
		-- 현재 내 이벤트 포인트
		self.my_popularity = CS.Oak.UserEvent.Me.LiveEvents[chapter_id].Points:GetDecrypted()
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_objects, self))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end
end

function local_class:exit()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("highschool")

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name and lua_helper.type_compare(self.sohee.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
		self.sohee.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
	self.sohee = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

---[[ on event func
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'cafeteria_zone' and self.section_inner_progress == 0 then
		self.section_inner_progress = 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.cafeteria_intro, self))
	elseif zone_name == 'test_pass_zone' and not self.is_say_jjindda then
		self.is_say_jjindda = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.jjindda, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.sohee)
			and self.section_inner_progress == 1 then
		self.section_inner_progress = 2
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.before_fight_sohee, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'boss' and self.section_inner_progress == 2 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.after_fight_sohee, self))
	end
end

function local_class:player_move()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_jump_01')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.jump(user_party[i], 1, 0.5)
		user_party[i]:SetAnimation("cast", true)
		user_party[i]:SetEmotion("surprise", true)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i]:SetEmotion("tired", true)

		if user_party_leader.Position.x < -0.5 then
			character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

			if user_party_leader.Position.x > -2 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(user_party[i],
						vector(-2, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z + CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * i), 0.5, nil, false, true))
			end
		elseif user_party_leader.Position.x >= -0.5 then
			character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], CS.Oak.Direction.Left)

			if user_party_leader.Position.x < 1 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(user_party[i],
						vector(1, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z + CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * i), 0.5, nil, false, true))
			end
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i]:RemoveAnimation()
		user_party[i]:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

			break
		else

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(admiral, {key = "highschool_ms_18_boss_start_8", skip = true})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(admiral, {key = "highschool_ms_18_boss_start_11", skip = true})

	branches:Add({

	character_util.set_anim(admiral, { name = "dualgun_attack_right", loop = false })

	character_util.set_anim(kidnapper1, { name = "run" })

	local escape_waypoint2 = center_pos - vector(0, 0, 6)
	local first_duration =  (escape_start_pos - escape_waypoint1).magnitude / escape_speed
	local second_duration = (escape_waypoint2 - escape_waypoint1).magnitude / escape_speed

	time_passed = 0

local local_class = newclass('KanterburyHighSchoolMainSection19')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = KanterburyHighSchoolMain @
		Comment = 전 사천왕들을 구해주는 마리나 ~ 엔딩까지 @
		Index = 18 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.npcs_marker = "npcs_pos_"

	self.npcs_pair_max = 10

	self.is_searching_junkie_list = false

	self.victim_pos_vectors = {
		vector(1, 0, 0),
		vector(2, 0, 0),
		vector(-2, 0, 0),
		vector(-1, 0, -1),
		vector(0, 0, -1),
		vector(0, 0, 1),
		vector(1, 0, 1),
		vector(2, 0, 0),
		vector(0, 0, 1),
		vector(-1, 0, 0)
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == "highschool_1_6" then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

		self.crystals = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)
		self.crystal_components = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.StageItem)
		self.crystal_attachers = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.IFieldObject)
		self.junkies = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.IFieldObject)
		self.field_junkies = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.IFieldObject)

		self:set_ground(3.0, false)

		self:set_npcs()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == "highschool_1_6" then
		self.greet_launched = false
		self.ground_greet_launched = false
		self.active_section = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.crystal_routine, self))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.junkie_routine, self))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name == "highschool_1_6" then
		self.active_section = false
		self:clear_crystals()
		self.junkies:Clear()
		self.field_junkies:Clear()

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party[0]) and e.Zone.Name == "rotye_greet" then
			if not self.greet_launched then
				self.greet_launched = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.greet_routine, self))
			end
		elseif e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party[0]) and e.Zone.Name == "ground_greet" then
			if not self.ground_greet_launched then
				self.ground_greet_launched = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ground_greet_routine, self))
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == "boss" then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending_routine, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	while self.is_searching_junkie_list do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_searching_junkie_list = true

	local try_cure = false

	for i = 0, self.field_junkies.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.field_junkies[i], e.Target) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.cure_junkie, self, self.field_junkies[i]))
			try_cure = true
			break
		end
	end

	if not try_cure then
		self.is_searching_junkie_list = false
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.active_section = false
	if self.crystals ~= nil then
		self:clear_crystals()
		self.junkies:Clear()
		self.field_junkies:Clear()
	end
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.origin_leader = nil
	self.victim_pos_vectors = nil
end

function local_class:opening_routine()
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular(0, screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 0, loop_count do
		user_party[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	self.origin_leader = user_party[0]

	local admiral = get_character("admiral")

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.HidePreviousParty = false
	CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToManualCharacter(admiral, param)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	--music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)

		name = 'ondemand/highschool/audio:bgm_world_map_03', state = 'field'
	})

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))

	local rotye = get_character("rotye")
	rotye.Position = field:GetMarker("rotye_pos").position
	rotye.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	self.origin_leader.Position = field:GetMarker("rotye_victim_pos").position
	self.origin_leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	--marker = field:GetMarker("ground_center")
	--marker.position = vector(-28.5, 0, 23.5)
	--marker.position = vector(-47.5, 0, 104)

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry, marker.position, marker.direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_teatan_robot_emerge_01')

function local_class:set_npcs()
	for i = 1, self.npcs_pair_max do

		local marker_pos = field:GetMarker(string.format("%s%d",
				self.npcs_marker, i)).position

		local victim = get_character(string.format("%s%d", "victim_", i))
		local addict = get_character(string.format("%s%d", "addict_", i))

		character_util.set_position(addict, marker_pos)
		character_util.set_position(victim, marker_pos + self.victim_pos_vectors[i])

		self:add_crystal(addict)
		if addict.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			addict.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end

		victim.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		if i % 2 == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(victim, "right")
		else
			character_util.set_direction(victim, "left")
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(victim, {name = "damaged"})
		character_util.set_anim(victim, {name = "prostrate"})

		character_util.set_emotion(addict, {name = "smile"})
		character_util.set_anim(addict, {name = "hold_loop", upper = true})

function local_class:add_crystal(attacher)
	if self.crystal_attachers.Count > 0 then
		for i = 0, self.crystal_attachers.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(attacher, self.crystal_attachers[i]) then
				return
			end
		end
	end

	local size_factor = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.time.time * 2) * 0.1 + 0.9
	self.crystal_attachers:Add(attacher)
	local crystal = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('stage_item'):Instantiate(attacher.Position + vector(0, 1.6, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, attacher.Transform)
	self.crystals:Add(crystal)
	local stage_item = crystal:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageItem))
	stage_item:SetItem("invader_crystal")

	stage_item.ShadowActive = false
	stage_item.Item.localScale = vector(size_factor, size_factor, size_factor)
	self.crystal_components:Add(stage_item)
	self.junkies:Add(attacher)

end

function local_class:remove_crystal(attacher)
	local remove_index = -1
	if self.crystal_attachers.Count > 0 then
		for i = 0, self.crystal_attachers.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(attacher, self.crystal_attachers[i]) then
				remove_index = i
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if remove_index >= 0 then
		self.crystals[remove_index]:Dispose()
		self.crystals:RemoveAt(remove_index)
		self.crystal_attachers:RemoveAt(remove_index)
		self.crystal_components:RemoveAt(remove_index)
		self.junkies:RemoveAt(remove_index)
	end
end

function local_class:cure_junkie(junkie)

	self.field_junkies:Remove(junkie)

	self.is_searching_junkie_list = false

	junkie.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	character_util.remove_anim(junkie, true)

	local admiral = get_character("admiral")

	if admiral.Position.x > junkie.Position.x then
		character_util.set_direction(junkie, "right")
	else
		character_util.set_direction(junkie, "left")
	end

	character_util.set_anim(admiral, { name = "katana_attack3", scale = 20, loop = false, mix_duration = 0.05 })

	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	junkie:Shake(0.1, 0.2)

	local hit_pos = junkie.Position + vector(0, 1.5, 0)
	local hit_dir = (hit_pos - admiral.Position).normalized

	local hit_effect = CS.Oak.BasicSwordHitEffect.Create(hit_pos, hit_dir)
	hit_effect:Hit(admiral, junkie)
	hit_effect:PlayHitSfx(admiral, junkie)
	hit_effect:Dispose()

	character_util.set_emotion(junkie, {name = "damaged"})
	character_util.set_anim(junkie, {name = "damaged"})

	self:remove_crystal(junkie)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.remove_anim(admiral)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.set_anim(junkie, {name = "dead", loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01'})
end

function local_class:crystal_routine()
	while self.active_section do

		local size_factor = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.time.time * 2) * 0.1 + 0.9
		if self.crystals.Count > 0 then
			for i = 0, self.crystals.Count - 1 do
				local rand = math.pi * 2 * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value
				self.crystal_components[i].Item.localScale = vector(size_factor, size_factor, size_factor)
				self.crystal_components[i].Item.localPosition = vector(unity_class.mathf.Cos(rand), unity_class.mathf.Sin(rand),0) * 0.05
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:clear_crystals()
	if self.crystals.Count > 0 then
		for i = 0, self.crystals.Count - 1 do
			self.crystals[i]:Dispose()
		end
	end

	self.crystals:Clear()
	self.crystal_attachers:Clear()
	self.crystal_components:Clear()
end

function local_class:junkie_routine()
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local change_time = 0.1

	local dirs = {
		"right", "up", "left", "down"
	}

	for i = 0, self.field_junkies.Count - 1 do
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
		character_util.set_direction(self.field_junkies[i], dirs[rand])
	end

	while self.active_section do
		if unity_class.time.time - start_time >= change_time and not self.is_searching_junkie_list then
			self.is_searching_junkie_list = true
			start_time = unity_class.time.time

			for i = 0, self.field_junkies.Count - 1 do
				local dir = self.field_junkies[i].Direction
				local dir_num = 1

				if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					dir_num = 4
				elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
					dir_num = 2
				elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
					dir_num = 1
				elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
					dir_num = 3
				end

				character_util.set_direction(self.field_junkies[i], dirs[dir_num])
			end

			self.is_searching_junkie_list = false
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:set_ground(enemy_dist, for_ending)
	local ground_center = field:GetMarker("ground_center").position

	-- 운동장 이벤트 배치
	local streamer = get_character("streamer")
	local kendo_leader = get_character("kendo_leader")
	local battleball_leader = get_character("battleball_leader")

	local ground_victims = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ICharacter)
	ground_victims:Add(get_character("ground_victim_1"))
	ground_victims:Add(get_character("ground_victim_2"))
	ground_victims:Add(get_character("ground_victim_3"))
	ground_victims:Add(get_character("ground_victim_4"))
	ground_victims:Add(get_character("ground_victim_5"))
	ground_victims:Add(get_character("ground_victim_6"))

	local ground_attackers = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ICharacter)
	ground_attackers:Add(get_character("ground_attacker_1"))
	ground_attackers:Add(get_character("ground_attacker_2"))
	ground_attackers:Add(get_character("ground_attacker_3"))
	ground_attackers:Add(get_character("ground_attacker_4"))
	ground_attackers:Add(get_character("ground_attacker_5"))
	ground_attackers:Add(get_character("ground_attacker_6"))
	ground_attackers:Add(get_character("ground_attacker_7"))
	ground_attackers:Add(get_character("ground_attacker_8"))
	ground_attackers:Add(get_character("ground_attacker_9"))
	ground_attackers:Add(get_character("ground_attacker_10"))

	local elite_dist = 2.5
	local victim_dist = 1.0
	local victim_angle = 30
	local enemy_angle = 45

	local left_center = ground_center - vector(elite_dist, 0 , 0)
	local right_center = ground_center + vector(elite_dist, 0, 0)

	ground_victims[0].Position = left_center + unity_class.vector3.right * victim_dist
	ground_victims[1].Position = left_center + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(victim_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * (unity_class.vector3.right * victim_dist)
	ground_victims[2].Position = left_center + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-victim_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * (unity_class.vector3.right * victim_dist)

	ground_victims[3].Position = right_center + unity_class.vector3.left * victim_dist
	ground_victims[4].Position = right_center + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(victim_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * (unity_class.vector3.left * victim_dist)
	ground_victims[5].Position = right_center + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-victim_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * (unity_class.vector3.left * victim_dist)

	for i =0, 5 do
		if i >= 3 then
			ground_victims[i].Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		else
			ground_victims[i].Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end

		if for_ending then
			if i>= 3 then
				character_util.set_anim(ground_victims[i], { name = "song" })
				character_util.set_emotion(ground_victims[i], { name = "smile" })
			else
				character_util.set_anim(ground_victims[i], { name = "success" })
				character_util.set_emotion(ground_victims[i], { name = "awesome" })
			end
			ground_victims[i]:CancelShake()
		else
			character_util.set_anim(ground_victims[i], { name = "cast" })
			character_util.set_emotion(ground_victims[i], { name = "damaged" })
			ground_victims[i]:Shake(0.06, 100000)
		end
		ground_victims[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		ground_victims[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	for i = 0, 9 do
		if not for_ending then
			local center = left_center
			local dir = unity_class.vector3.left
			local direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			if i >= 5 then
				center = right_center
				dir = unity_class.vector3.right
				direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			end

			ground_attackers[i].Direction = direction
			character_util.set_anim(ground_attackers[i], { name = "jingak" })
			character_util.set_emotion(ground_attackers[i], { name = "smile" })
			local angle_index = i % 5
			local angle = - enemy_angle + (2 * enemy_angle / 4.0) * angle_index
			ground_attackers[i].Position = center + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * (dir * enemy_dist)
			self:add_crystal(ground_attackers[i])
		else
			ground_attackers[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			self:remove_crystal(ground_attackers[i])
		end
	end

	streamer.Position = ground_center + vector(elite_dist, 0, 0.75)
	if for_ending then
		streamer.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		character_util.set_emotion(streamer, { name = "smile" })
		character_util.set_anim(streamer, { name = "hurt" })
	else
		streamer.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		character_util.set_emotion(streamer, { name = "attack" })
		character_util.set_anim(streamer, { name = "idle" })
	end

	battleball_leader.Position = ground_center + vector(elite_dist, 0, -0.75)
	if for_ending then
		battleball_leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		character_util.set_emotion(battleball_leader, { name = "smile" })
		character_util.set_anim(battleball_leader, { name = "prostrate" })
	else
		battleball_leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		character_util.set_emotion(battleball_leader, { name = "attack" })
		character_util.set_anim(battleball_leader, { name = "idle" })
	end

	kendo_leader.Position = ground_center + vector(-elite_dist, 0, 0)
	if for_ending then
		kendo_leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		character_util.set_emotion(kendo_leader, { name = "smile" })
		character_util.set_anim(kendo_leader, { name = "idle" })
	else
		kendo_leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		character_util.set_emotion(kendo_leader, { name = "attack" })
		character_util.set_anim(kendo_leader, { name = "bomb_idle" })
	end
end

function local_class:remove_npcs()
	for i = 1, self.npcs_pair_max do
		local victim = get_character(string.format("%s%d", "victim_", i))
		local addict = get_character(string.format("%s%d", "addict_", i))

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(victim)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(addict)

		character_util.set_position(victim, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_position(addict, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end
end
